vulg: primum quidem sermonem feci de omnibus o Theophile quae coepit Iesus facere et docere
clem: Primum quidem sermonem feci de omnibus, o Theophile, qu cpit Jesus facere et docere
tr: τον μεν πρωτον λογον εποιησαμην περι παντων ω θεοφιλε ων ηρξατο ο ιησους ποιειν τε και διδασκειν
kjv: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

vulg: usque in diem qua praecipiens apostolis per Spiritum Sanctum quos elegit adsumptus est
clem: usque in diem qua prcipiens Apostolis per Spiritum Sanctum, quos elegit, assumptus est:
tr: αχρι ης ημερας εντειλαμενος τοις αποστολοις δια πνευματος αγιου ους εξελεξατο ανεληφθη
kjv: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:

vulg: quibus et praebuit se ipsum vivum post passionem suam in multis argumentis per dies quadraginta apparens eis et loquens de regno Dei
clem: quibus et prbuit seipsum vivum post passionem suam in multis argumentis, per dies quadraginta apparens eis, et loquens de regno Dei.
tr: οις και παρεστησεν εαυτον ζωντα μετα το παθειν αυτον εν πολλοις τεκμηριοις δι ημερων τεσσαρακοντα οπτανομενος αυτοις και λεγων τα περι της βασιλειας του θεου
kjv: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

vulg: et convescens praecepit eis ab Hierosolymis ne discederent sed expectarent promissionem Patris quam audistis per os meum
clem: Et convescens, prcepit eis ab Jerosolymis ne discederent, sed exspectarent promissionem Patris, quam audistis (inquit) per os meum:
tr: και συναλιζομενος  μετ αυτων  παρηγγειλεν αυτοις απο ιεροσολυμων μη χωριζεσθαι αλλα περιμενειν την επαγγελιαν του πατρος ην ηκουσατε μου
kjv: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.

vulg: quia Iohannes quidem baptizavit aqua vos autem baptizabimini Spiritu Sancto non post multos hos dies
clem: quia Joannes quidem baptizavit aqua, vos autem baptizabimini Spiritu Sancto non post multos hos dies.
tr: οτι ιωαννης μεν εβαπτισεν υδατι υμεις δε βαπτισθησεσθε εν πνευματι αγιω ου μετα πολλας ταυτας ημερας
kjv: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.

vulg: igitur qui convenerant interrogabant eum dicentes Domine si in tempore hoc restitues regnum Israhel
clem: Igitur qui convenerant, interrogabant eum, dicentes: Domine, si in tempore hoc restitues regnum Isral?
tr: οι μεν ουν συνελθοντες επηρωτων αυτον λεγοντες κυριε ει εν τω χρονω τουτω αποκαθιστανεις την βασιλειαν τω ισραηλ
kjv: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?

vulg: dixit autem eis non est vestrum nosse tempora vel momenta quae Pater posuit in sua potestate
clem: Dixit autem eis: Non est vestrum nosse tempora vel momenta qu Pater posuit in sua potestate:
tr: ειπεν δε προς αυτους ουχ υμων εστιν γνωναι χρονους η καιρους ους ο πατηρ εθετο εν τη ιδια εξουσια
kjv: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.

vulg: sed accipietis virtutem supervenientis Spiritus Sancti in vos et eritis mihi testes in Hierusalem et in omni Iudaea et Samaria et usque ad ultimum terrae
clem: sed accipietis virtutem supervenientis Spiritus Sancti in vos, et eritis mihi testes in Jerusalem, et in omni Juda, et Samaria, et usque ad ultimum terr.
tr: αλλα ληψεσθε δυναμιν επελθοντος του αγιου πνευματος εφ υμας και εσεσθε μοι μαρτυρες εν τε ιερουσαλημ και εν παση τη ιουδαια και σαμαρεια και εως εσχατου της γης
kjv: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

vulg: et cum haec dixisset videntibus illis elevatus est et nubes suscepit eum ab oculis eorum
clem: Et cum hc dixisset, videntibus illis, elevatus est: et nubes suscepit eum ab oculis eorum.
tr: και ταυτα ειπων βλεποντων αυτων επηρθη και νεφελη υπελαβεν αυτον απο των οφθαλμων αυτων
kjv: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

vulg: cumque intuerentur in caelum eunte illo ecce duo viri adstiterunt iuxta illos in vestibus albis
clem: Cumque intuerentur in clum euntem illum, ecce duo viri astiterunt juxta illos in vestibus albis,
tr: και ως ατενιζοντες ησαν εις τον ουρανον πορευομενου αυτου και ιδου ανδρες δυο παρειστηκεισαν αυτοις εν εσθητι λευκη
kjv: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

vulg: qui et dixerunt viri galilaei quid statis aspicientes in caelum hic Iesus qui adsumptus est a vobis in caelum sic veniet quemadmodum vidistis eum euntem in caelum
clem: qui et dixerunt: Viri Galili, quid statis aspicientes in clum? Hic Jesus, qui assumptus est a vobis in clum, sic veniet quemadmodum vidistis eum euntem in clum.
tr: οι και ειπον ανδρες γαλιλαιοι τι εστηκατε εμβλεποντες εις τον ουρανον ουτος ο ιησους ο αναληφθεις αφ υμων εις τον ουρανον ουτως ελευσεται ον τροπον εθεασασθε αυτον πορευομενον εις τον ουρανον
kjv: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

vulg: tunc reversi sunt Hierosolymam a monte qui vocatur Oliveti qui est iuxta Hierusalem sabbati habens iter
clem: Tunc reversi sunt Jerosolymam a monte qui vocatur Oliveti, qui est juxta Jerusalem, sabbati habens iter.
tr: τοτε υπεστρεψαν εις ιερουσαλημ απο ορους του καλουμενου ελαιωνος ο εστιν εγγυς ιερουσαλημ σαββατου εχον οδον
kjv: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.

vulg: et cum introissent in cenaculum ascenderunt ubi manebant Petrus et Iohannes Iacobus et Andreas Philippus et Thomas Bartholomeus et Mattheus Iacobus Alphei et Simon Zelotes et Iudas Iacobi
clem: Et cum introissent in cnaculum, ascenderunt ubi manebant Petrus, et Joannes, Jacobus, et Andreas, Philippus, et Thomas, Bartholomus, et Matthus, Jacobus Alphi, et Simon Zelotes, et Judas Jacobi.
tr: και οτε εισηλθον ανεβησαν εις το υπερωον ου ησαν καταμενοντες ο τε πετρος και ιακωβος και ιωαννης και ανδρεας φιλιππος και θωμας βαρθολομαιος και ματθαιος ιακωβος αλφαιου και σιμων ο ζηλωτης και ιουδας ιακωβου
kjv: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.

vulg: hii omnes erant perseverantes unianimiter in oratione cum mulieribus et Maria matre Iesu et fratribus eius
clem: Hi omnes erant perseverantes unanimiter in oratione cum mulieribus, et Maria matre Jesu, et fratribus ejus.
tr: ουτοι παντες ησαν προσκαρτερουντες ομοθυμαδον τη προσευχη και τη δεησει συν γυναιξιν και μαρια τη μητρι του ιησου και συν τοις αδελφοις αυτου
kjv: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

vulg: et in diebus illis exsurgens Petrus in medio fratrum dixit erat autem turba nominum simul fere centum viginti
clem: In diebus illis, exsurgens Petrus in medio fratrum, dixit (erat autem turba hominum simul, fere centum viginti):
tr: και εν ταις ημεραις ταυταις αναστας πετρος εν μεσω των μαθητων ειπεν ην τε οχλος ονοματων επι το αυτο ως εκατον εικοσιν
kjv: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)

vulg: viri fratres oportet impleri scripturam quam praedixit Spiritus Sanctus per os David de Iuda qui fuit dux eorum qui conprehenderunt Iesum
clem: Viri fratres, oportet impleri Scripturam quam prdixit Spiritus Sanctus per os David de Juda, qui fuit dux eorum qui comprehenderunt Jesum:
tr: ανδρες αδελφοι εδει πληρωθηναι την γραφην ταυτην ην προειπεν το πνευμα το αγιον δια στοματος δαβιδ περι ιουδα του γενομενου οδηγου τοις συλλαβουσιν τον ιησουν
kjv: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.

vulg: quia connumeratus erat in nobis et sortitus est sortem ministerii huius
clem: qui connumeratus erat in nobis, et sortitus est sortem ministerii hujus.
tr: οτι κατηριθμημενος ην συν ημιν και ελαχεν τον κληρον της διακονιας ταυτης
kjv: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.

vulg: et hic quidem possedit agrum de mercede iniquitatis et suspensus crepuit medius et diffusa sunt omnia viscera eius
clem: Et hic quidem possedit agrum de mercede iniquitatis, et suspensus crepuit medius: et diffusa sunt omnia viscera ejus.
tr: ουτος μεν ουν εκτησατο χωριον εκ του μισθου της αδικιας και πρηνης γενομενος ελακησεν μεσος και εξεχυθη παντα τα σπλαγχνα αυτου
kjv: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

vulg: et notum factum est omnibus habitantibus Hierusalem ita ut appellaretur ager ille lingua eorum Acheldemach hoc est ager Sanguinis
clem: Et notum factum est omnibus habitantibus Jerusalem, ita ut appellaretur ager ille, lingua eorum, Haceldama, hoc est, ager sanguinis.
tr: και γνωστον εγενετο πασιν τοις κατοικουσιν ιερουσαλημ ωστε κληθηναι το χωριον εκεινο τη ιδια διαλεκτω αυτων ακελδαμα τουτ εστιν χωριον αιματος
kjv: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

vulg: scriptum est enim in libro Psalmorum fiat commoratio eius deserta et non sit qui inhabitet in ea et episcopatum eius accipiat alius
clem: Scriptum est enim in libro Psalmorum: Fiat commoratio eorum deserta, et non sit qui inhabitet in ea: et episcopatum ejus accipiat alter.
tr: γεγραπται γαρ εν βιβλω ψαλμων γενηθητω η επαυλις αυτου ερημος και μη εστω ο κατοικων εν αυτη και την επισκοπην αυτου λαβοι ετερος
kjv: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.

vulg: oportet ergo ex his viris qui nobiscum congregati sunt in omni tempore quo intravit et exivit inter nos Dominus Iesus
clem: Oportet ergo ex his viris qui nobiscum sunt congregati in omni tempore quo intravit et exivit inter nos Dominus Jesus,
tr: δει ουν των συνελθοντων ημιν ανδρων εν παντι χρονω εν ω εισηλθεν και εξηλθεν εφ ημας ο κυριος ιησους
kjv: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

vulg: incipiens a baptismate Iohannis usque in diem qua adsumptus est a nobis testem resurrectionis eius nobiscum fieri unum ex istis
clem: incipiens a baptismate Joannis usque in diem qua assumptus est a nobis, testem resurrectionis ejus nobiscum fieri unum ex istis.
tr: αρξαμενος απο του βαπτισματος ιωαννου εως της ημερας ης ανεληφθη αφ ημων μαρτυρα της αναστασεως αυτου γενεσθαι συν ημιν ενα τουτων
kjv: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.

vulg: et statuerunt duos Ioseph qui vocabatur Barsabban qui cognominatus est Iustus et Matthiam
clem: Et statuerunt duos, Joseph, qui vocabatur Barsabas, qui cognominatus est Justus, et Mathiam.
tr: και εστησαν δυο ιωσηφ τον καλουμενον βαρσαβαν ος επεκληθη ιουστος και ματθιαν
kjv: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

vulg: et orantes dixerunt tu Domine qui corda nosti omnium ostende quem elegeris ex his duobus unum
clem: Et orantes dixerunt: Tu Domine, qui corda nosti omnium, ostende quem elegeris ex his duobus unum,
tr: και προσευξαμενοι ειπον συ κυριε καρδιογνωστα παντων αναδειξον εκ τουτων των δυο ενα ον  ον ενα  εξελεξω
kjv: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,

vulg: accipere locum ministerii huius et apostolatus de quo praevaricatus est Iudas ut abiret in locum suum
clem: accipere locum ministerii hujus et apostolatus, de quo prvaricatus est Judas ut abiret in locum suum.
tr: λαβειν τον κληρον της διακονιας ταυτης και αποστολης εξ ης παρεβη ιουδας πορευθηναι εις τον τοπον τον ιδιον
kjv: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.

vulg: et dederunt sortes eis et cecidit sors super Matthiam et adnumeratus est cum undecim apostolis
clem: Et dederunt sortes eis, et cecidit sors super Mathiam: et annumeratus est cum undecim Apostolis.
tr: και εδωκαν κληρους αυτων και επεσεν ο κληρος επι ματθιαν και συγκατεψηφισθη μετα των ενδεκα αποστολων
kjv: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

vulg: et cum conplerentur dies pentecostes erant omnes pariter in eodem loco
clem: Et cum complerentur dies Pentecostes, erant omnes pariter in eodem loco:
tr: και εν τω συμπληρουσθαι την ημεραν της πεντηκοστης ησαν απαντες ομοθυμαδον επι το αυτο
kjv: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

vulg: et factus est repente de caelo sonus tamquam advenientis spiritus vehementis et replevit totam domum ubi erant sedentes
clem: et factus est repente de clo sonus, tamquam advenientis spiritus vehementis, et replevit totam domum ubi erant sedentes.
tr: και εγενετο αφνω εκ του ουρανου ηχος ωσπερ φερομενης πνοης βιαιας και επληρωσεν ολον τον οικον ου ησαν καθημενοι
kjv: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

vulg: et apparuerunt illis dispertitae linguae tamquam ignis seditque supra singulos eorum
clem: Et apparuerunt illis dispertit lingu tamquam ignis, seditque supra singulos eorum:
tr: και ωφθησαν αυτοις διαμεριζομεναι γλωσσαι ωσει πυρος εκαθισεν τε εφ ενα εκαστον αυτων
kjv: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.

vulg: et repleti sunt omnes Spiritu Sancto et coeperunt loqui aliis linguis prout Spiritus Sanctus dabat eloqui illis
clem: et repleti sunt omnes Spiritu Sancto, et cperunt loqui variis linguis, prout Spiritus Sanctus dabat eloqui illis.
tr: και επλησθησαν απαντες πνευματος αγιου και ηρξαντο λαλειν ετεραις γλωσσαις καθως το πνευμα εδιδου αυτοις αποφθεγγεσθαι
kjv: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

vulg: erant autem in Hierusalem habitantes Iudaei viri religiosi ex omni natione quae sub caelo sunt
clem: Erant autem in Jerusalem habitantes Judi, viri religiosi ex omni natione qu sub clo est.
tr: ησαν δε εν ιερουσαλημ κατοικουντες ιουδαιοι ανδρες ευλαβεις απο παντος εθνους των υπο τον ουρανον
kjv: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

vulg: facta autem hac voce convenit multitudo et mente confusa est quoniam audiebat unusquisque lingua sua illos loquentes
clem: Facta autem hac voce, convenit multitudo, et mente confusa est, quoniam audiebat unusquisque lingua sua illos loquentes.
tr: γενομενης δε της φωνης ταυτης συνηλθεν το πληθος και συνεχυθη οτι ηκουον εις εκαστος τη ιδια διαλεκτω λαλουντων αυτων
kjv: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.

vulg: stupebant autem omnes et mirabantur dicentes nonne omnes ecce isti qui loquuntur Galilaei sunt
clem: Stupebant autem omnes, et mirabantur, dicentes: Nonne ecce omnes isti qui loquuntur, Galili sunt?
tr: εξισταντο δε παντες και εθαυμαζον λεγοντες προς αλληλους ουκ ιδου παντες ουτοι εισιν οι λαλουντες γαλιλαιοι
kjv: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?

vulg: et quomodo nos audivimus unusquisque lingua nostra in qua nati sumus
clem: et quomodo nos audivimus unusquisque linguam nostram in qua nati sumus?
tr: και πως ημεις ακουομεν εκαστος τη ιδια διαλεκτω ημων εν η εγεννηθημεν
kjv: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?

vulg: Parthi et Medi et Elamitae et qui habitant Mesopotamiam et Iudaeam et Cappadociam Pontum et Asiam
clem: Parthi, et Medi, et lamit, et qui habitant Mespotamiam, Judam, et Cappadociam, Pontum, et Asiam,
tr: παρθοι και μηδοι και ελαμιται και οι κατοικουντες την μεσοποταμιαν ιουδαιαν τε και καππαδοκιαν ποντον και την ασιαν
kjv: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

vulg: Frygiam et Pamphiliam Aegyptum et partes Lybiae quae est circa Cyrenen et advenae romani
clem: Phrygiam, et Pamphyliam, gyptum, et partes Liby qu est circa Cyrenen: et adven Romani,
tr: φρυγιαν τε και παμφυλιαν αιγυπτον και τα μερη της λιβυης της κατα κυρηνην και οι επιδημουντες ρωμαιοι ιουδαιοι τε και προσηλυτοι
kjv: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

vulg: Iudaei quoque et proselyti Cretes et Arabes audivimus loquentes eos nostris linguis magnalia Dei
clem: Judi quoque, et Proselyti, Cretes, et Arabes: audivimus eos loquentes nostris linguis magnalia Dei.
tr: κρητες και αραβες ακουομεν λαλουντων αυτων ταις ημετεραις γλωσσαις τα μεγαλεια του θεου
kjv: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

vulg: stupebant autem omnes et mirabantur ad invicem dicentes quidnam hoc vult esse
clem: Stupebant autem omnes, et mirabantur ad invicem, dicentes: Quidnam vult hoc esse?
tr: εξισταντο δε παντες και διηπορουν αλλος προς αλλον λεγοντες τι αν θελοι τουτο ειναι
kjv: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

vulg: alii autem inridentes dicebant quia musto pleni sunt isti
clem: Alii autem irridentes dicebant: Quia musto pleni sunt isti.
tr: ετεροι δε χλευαζοντες ελεγον οτι γλευκους μεμεστωμενοι εισιν
kjv: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

vulg: stans autem Petrus cum undecim levavit vocem suam et locutus est eis viri iudaei et qui habitatis Hierusalem universi hoc vobis notum sit et auribus percipite verba mea
clem: Stans autem Petrus cum undecim, levavit vocem suam, et locutus est eis: Viri Judi, et qui habitatis Jerusalem universi, hoc vobis notum sit, et auribus percipite verba mea.
tr: σταθεις δε πετρος συν τοις ενδεκα επηρεν την φωνην αυτου και απεφθεγξατο αυτοις ανδρες ιουδαιοι και οι κατοικουντες ιερουσαλημ απαντες τουτο υμιν γνωστον εστω και ενωτισασθε τα ρηματα μου
kjv: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

vulg: non enim sicut vos aestimatis hii ebrii sunt cum sit hora diei tertia
clem: Non enim, sicut vos stimatis, hi ebrii sunt, cum sit hora diei tertia:
tr: ου γαρ ως υμεις υπολαμβανετε ουτοι μεθυουσιν εστιν γαρ ωρα τριτη της ημερας
kjv: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.

vulg: sed hoc est quod dictum est per prophetam Iohel
clem: sed hoc est quod dictum est per prophetam Jol:
tr: αλλα τουτο εστιν το ειρημενον δια του προφητου ιωηλ
kjv: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;

vulg: et erit in novissimis diebus dicit Dominus effundam de Spiritu meo super omnem carnem et prophetabunt filii vestri et filiae vestrae et iuvenes vestri visiones videbunt et seniores vestri somnia somniabunt
clem: [Et erit in novissimis diebus, dicit Dominus, effundam de Spiritu meo super omnem carnem: et prophetabunt filii vestri et fili vestr, et juvenes vestri visiones videbunt, et seniores vestri somnia somniabunt.
tr: και εσται εν ταις εσχαταις ημεραις λεγει ο θεος εκχεω απο του πνευματος μου επι πασαν σαρκα και προφητευσουσιν οι υιοι υμων και αι θυγατερες υμων και οι νεανισκοι υμων ορασεις οψονται και οι πρεσβυτεροι υμων ενυπνια ενυπνιασθησονται
kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

vulg: et quidem super servos meos et super ancillas meas in diebus illis effundam de Spiritu meo et prophetabunt
clem: Et quidem super servos meos, et super ancillas meas, in diebus illis effundam de Spiritu meo, et prophetabunt:
tr: και γε επι τους δουλους μου και επι τας δουλας μου εν ταις ημεραις εκειναις εκχεω απο του πνευματος μου και προφητευσουσιν
kjv: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

vulg: et dabo prodigia in caelo sursum et signa in terra deorsum sanguinem et ignem et vaporem fumi
clem: et dabo prodigia in clo sursum, et signa in terra deorsum, sanguinem, et ignem, et vaporem fumi:
tr: και δωσω τερατα εν τω ουρανω ανω και σημεια επι της γης κατω αιμα και πυρ και ατμιδα καπνου
kjv: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

vulg: sol convertetur in tenebras et luna in sanguinem antequam veniat dies Domini magnus et manifestus
clem: sol convertetur in tenebras, et luna in sanguinem, antequam veniat dies Domini magnus et manifestus.
tr: ο ηλιος μεταστραφησεται εις σκοτος και η σεληνη εις αιμα πριν η ελθειν την ημεραν κυριου την μεγαλην και επιφανη
kjv: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and notable day of the Lord come:

vulg: et erit omnis quicumque invocaverit nomen Domini salvus erit
clem: Et erit: omnis quicumque invocaverit nomen Domini, salvus erit.]
tr: και εσται πας ος αν επικαλεσηται το ονομα κυριου σωθησεται
kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

vulg: viri israhelitae audite verba haec Iesum Nazarenum virum adprobatum a Deo in vobis virtutibus et prodigiis et signis quae fecit per illum Deus in medio vestri sicut vos scitis
clem: Viri Isralit, audite verba hc: Jesum Nazarenum, virum approbatum a Deo in vobis, virtutibus, et prodigiis, et signis, qu fecit Deus per illum in medio vestri, sicut et vos scitis:
tr: ανδρες ισραηλιται ακουσατε τους λογους τουτους ιησουν τον ναζωραιον ανδρα απο του θεου αποδεδειγμενον εις υμας δυναμεσιν και τερασιν και σημειοις οις εποιησεν δι αυτου ο θεος εν μεσω υμων καθως και αυτοι οιδατε
kjv: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

vulg: hunc definito consilio et praescientia Dei traditum per manus iniquorum adfigentes interemistis
clem: hunc, definito consilio et prscientia Dei traditum, per manus iniquorum affligentes interemistis:
tr: τουτον τη ωρισμενη βουλη και προγνωσει του θεου εκδοτον λαβοντες δια χειρων ανομων προσπηξαντες ανειλετε
kjv: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

vulg: quem Deus suscitavit solutis doloribus inferni iuxta quod inpossibile erat teneri illum ab eo
clem: quem Deus suscitavit, solutis doloribus inferni, juxta quod impossibile erat teneri illum ab eo.
tr: ον ο θεος ανεστησεν λυσας τας ωδινας του θανατου καθοτι ουκ ην δυνατον κρατεισθαι αυτον υπ αυτου
kjv: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

vulg: David enim dicit in eum providebam Dominum coram me semper quoniam a dextris meis est ne commovear
clem: David enim dicit in eum: [Providebam Dominum in conspectu meo semper: quoniam a dextris est mihi, ne commovear:
tr: δαβιδ γαρ λεγει εις αυτον προωρωμην τον κυριον ενωπιον μου δια παντος οτι εκ δεξιων μου εστιν ινα μη σαλευθω
kjv: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

vulg: propter hoc laetatum est cor meum et exultavit lingua mea insuper et caro mea requiescet in spe
clem: propter hoc ltatum est cor meum, et exsultavit lingua mea, insuper et caro mea requiescet in spe:
tr: δια τουτο ευφρανθη η καρδια μου και ηγαλλιασατο η γλωσσα μου ετι δε και η σαρξ μου κατασκηνωσει επ ελπιδι
kjv: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:

vulg: quoniam non derelinques animam meam in inferno neque dabis Sanctum tuum videre corruptionem
clem: quoniam non derelinques animam meam in inferno, nec dabis sanctum tuum videre corruptionem.
tr: οτι ουκ εγκαταλειψεις την ψυχην μου εις αδου ουδε δωσεις τον οσιον σου ιδειν διαφθοραν
kjv: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

vulg: notas fecisti mihi vias vitae replebis me iucunditate cum facie tua
clem: Notas mihi fecisti vias vit: et replebis me jucunditate cum facie tua.]
tr: εγνωρισας μοι οδους ζωης πληρωσεις με ευφροσυνης μετα του προσωπου σου
kjv: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.

vulg: viri fratres liceat audenter dicere ad vos de patriarcha David quoniam et defunctus est et sepultus est et sepulchrum eius est apud nos usque in hodiernum diem
clem: Viri fratres, liceat audenter dicere ad vos de patriarcha David, quoniam defunctus est, et sepultus: et sepulchrum ejus est apud nos usque in hodiernum diem.
tr: ανδρες αδελφοι εξον ειπειν μετα παρρησιας προς υμας περι του πατριαρχου δαβιδ οτι και ετελευτησεν και εταφη και το μνημα αυτου εστιν εν ημιν αχρι της ημερας ταυτης
kjv: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.

vulg: propheta igitur cum esset et sciret quia iureiurando iurasset illi Deus de fructu lumbi eius sedere super sedem eius
clem: Propheta igitur cum esset, et sciret quia jurejurando jurasset illi Deus de fructu lumbi ejus sedere super sedem ejus:
tr: προφητης ουν υπαρχων και ειδως οτι ορκω ωμοσεν αυτω ο θεος εκ καρπου της οσφυος αυτου το κατα σαρκα αναστησειν τον χριστον καθισαι επι του θρονου αυτου
kjv: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;

vulg: providens locutus est de resurrectione Christi quia neque derelictus est in inferno neque caro eius vidit corruptionem
clem: providens locutus est de resurrectione Christi, quia neque derelictus est in inferno, neque caro ejus vidit corruptionem.
tr: προιδων ελαλησεν περι της αναστασεως του χριστου οτι ου κατελειφθη η ψυχη αυτου εις αδου ουδε η σαρξ αυτου ειδεν διαφθοραν
kjv: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.

vulg: hunc Iesum resuscitavit Deus cui omnes nos testes sumus
clem: Hunc Jesum resuscitavit Deus, cujus omnes nos testes sumus.
tr: τουτον τον ιησουν ανεστησεν ο θεος ου παντες ημεις εσμεν μαρτυρες
kjv: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

vulg: dextera igitur Dei exaltatus et promissione Spiritus Sancti accepta a Patre effudit hunc quem vos videtis et audistis
clem: Dextera igitur Dei exaltatus, et promissione Spiritus Sancti accepta a Patre, effudit hunc, quem vos videtis et auditis.
tr: τη δεξια ουν του θεου υψωθεις την τε επαγγελιαν του αγιου πνευματος λαβων παρα του πατρος εξεχεεν τουτο ο νυν υμεις βλεπετε και ακουετε
kjv: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.

vulg: non enim David ascendit in caelos dicit autem ipse dixit Dominus Domino meo sede a dextris meis
clem: Non enim David ascendit in clum: dixit autem ipse: [Dixit Dominus Domino meo: Sede a dextris meis,
tr: ου γαρ δαβιδ ανεβη εις τους ουρανους λεγει δε αυτος ειπεν ο κυριος τω κυριω μου καθου εκ δεξιων μου
kjv: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

vulg: donec ponam inimicos tuos scabillum pedum tuorum
clem: donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum.]
tr: εως αν θω τους εχθρους σου υποποδιον των ποδων σου
kjv: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.

vulg: certissime ergo sciat omnis domus Israhel quia et Dominum eum et Christum Deus fecit hunc Iesum quem vos crucifixistis
clem: Certissime sciat ergo omnis domus Isral, quia et Dominum eum et Christum fecit Deus hunc Jesum, quem vos crucifixistis.
tr: ασφαλως ουν γινωσκετω πας οικος ισραηλ οτι και κυριον και χριστον αυτον ο θεος εποιησεν τουτον τον ιησουν ον υμεις εσταυρωσατε
kjv: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made the same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

vulg: his auditis conpuncti sunt corde et dixerunt ad Petrum et ad reliquos apostolos quid faciemus viri fratres
clem: His autem auditis, compuncti sunt corde, et dixerunt ad Petrum et ad reliquos Apostolos: Quid faciemus, viri fratres?
tr: ακουσαντες δε κατενυγησαν τη καρδια ειπον τε προς τον πετρον και τους λοιπους αποστολους τι ποιησομεν ανδρες αδελφοι
kjv: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?

vulg: Petrus vero ad illos paenitentiam inquit agite et baptizetur unusquisque vestrum in nomine Iesu Christi in remissionem peccatorum vestrorum et accipietis donum Sancti Spiritus
clem: Petrus vero ad illos: Pnitentiam, inquit, agite, et baptizetur unusquisque vestrum in nomine Jesu Christi in remissionem peccatorum vestrorum: et accipietis donum Spiritus Sancti.
tr: πετρος δε εφη προς αυτους μετανοησατε και βαπτισθητω εκαστος υμων επι τω ονοματι ιησου χριστου εις αφεσιν αμαρτιων και ληψεσθε την δωρεαν του αγιου πνευματος
kjv: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

vulg: vobis enim est repromissio et filiis vestris et omnibus qui longe sunt quoscumque advocaverit Dominus Deus noster
clem: Vobis enim est repromissio, et filiis vestris, et omnibus qui longe sunt, quoscumque advocaverit Dominus Deus noster.
tr: υμιν γαρ εστιν η επαγγελια και τοις τεκνοις υμων και πασιν τοις εις μακραν οσους αν προσκαλεσηται κυριος ο θεος ημων
kjv: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.

vulg: aliis etiam verbis pluribus testificatus est et exhortabatur eos dicens salvamini a generatione ista prava
clem: Aliis etiam verbis plurimis testificatus est, et exhortabatur eos, dicens: Salvamini a generatione ista prava.
tr: ετεροις τε λογοις πλειοσιν διεμαρτυρετο και παρεκαλει λεγων σωθητε απο της γενεας της σκολιας ταυτης
kjv: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.

vulg: qui ergo receperunt sermonem eius baptizati sunt et adpositae sunt in illa die animae circiter tria milia
clem: Qui ergo receperunt sermonem ejus, baptizati sunt: et apposit sunt in die illa anim circiter tria millia.
tr: οι μεν ουν ασμενως αποδεξαμενοι τον λογον αυτου εβαπτισθησαν και προσετεθησαν τη ημερα εκεινη ψυχαι ωσει τρισχιλιαι
kjv: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

vulg: erant autem perseverantes in doctrina apostolorum et communicatione fractionis panis et orationibus
clem: Erant autem perseverantes in doctrina Apostolorum, et communicatione fractionis panis, et orationibus.
tr: ησαν δε προσκαρτερουντες τη διδαχη των αποστολων και τη κοινωνια και τη κλασει του αρτου και ταις προσευχαις
kjv: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

vulg: fiebat autem omni animae timor multa quoque prodigia et signa per apostolos fiebant in Hierusalem et metus erat magnus in universis
clem: Fiebat autem omni anim timor: multa quoque prodigia et signa per Apostolos in Jerusalem fiebant, et metus erat magnus in universis.
tr: εγενετο δε παση ψυχη φοβος πολλα τε τερατα και σημεια δια των αποστολων εγινετο
kjv: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.

vulg: omnes etiam qui credebant erant pariter et habebant omnia communia
clem: Omnes etiam qui credebant, erant pariter, et habebant omnia communia.
tr: παντες δε οι πιστευοντες ησαν επι το αυτο και ειχον απαντα κοινα
kjv: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

vulg: possessiones et substantias vendebant et dividebant illa omnibus prout cuique opus erat
clem: Possessiones et substantias vendebant, et dividebant illa omnibus, prout cuique opus erat.
tr: και τα κτηματα και τας υπαρξεις επιπρασκον και διεμεριζον αυτα πασιν καθοτι αν τις χρειαν ειχεν
kjv: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

vulg: cotidie quoque perdurantes unianimiter in templo et frangentes circa domos panem sumebant cibum cum exultatione et simplicitate cordis
clem: Quotidie quoque perdurantes unanimiter in templo, et frangentes circa domos panem, sumebant cibum cum exsultatione et simplicitate cordis,
tr: καθ ημεραν τε προσκαρτερουντες ομοθυμαδον εν τω ιερω κλωντες τε κατ οικον αρτον μετελαμβανον τροφης εν αγαλλιασει και αφελοτητι καρδιας
kjv: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,

vulg: conlaudantes Deum et habentes gratiam ad omnem plebem Dominus autem augebat qui salvi fierent cotidie in id ipsum
clem: collaudantes Deum et habentes gratiam ad omnem plebem. Dominus autem augebat qui salvi fierent quotidie in idipsum.
tr: αινουντες τον θεον και εχοντες χαριν προς ολον τον λαον ο δε κυριος προσετιθει τους σωζομενους καθ ημεραν τη εκκλησια
kjv: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

vulg: Petrus autem et Iohannes ascendebant in templum ad horam orationis nonam
clem: Petrus autem et Joannes ascendebant in templum ad horam orationis nonam.
tr: επι το αυτο δε πετρος και ιωαννης ανεβαινον εις το ιερον επι την ωραν της προσευχης την εννατην
kjv: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.

vulg: et quidam vir qui erat claudus ex utero matris suae baiulabatur quem ponebant cotidie ad portam templi quae dicitur Speciosa ut peteret elemosynam ab introeuntibus in templum
clem: Et quidam vir, qui erat claudus ex utero matris su, bajulabatur: quem ponebant quotidie ad portam templi, qu dicitur Speciosa, ut peteret eleemosynam ab intrountibus in templum.
tr: και τις ανηρ χωλος εκ κοιλιας μητρος αυτου υπαρχων εβασταζετο ον ετιθουν καθ ημεραν προς την θυραν του ιερου την λεγομενην ωραιαν του αιτειν ελεημοσυνην παρα των εισπορευομενων εις το ιερον
kjv: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

vulg: is cum vidisset Petrum et Iohannem incipientes introire in templum rogabat ut elemosynam acciperet
clem: Is cum vidisset Petrum et Joannem incipientes introire in templum, rogabat ut eleemosynam acciperet.
tr: ος ιδων πετρον και ιωαννην μελλοντας εισιεναι εις το ιερον ηρωτα ελεημοσυνην λαβειν
kjv: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.

vulg: intuens autem in eum Petrus cum Iohanne dixit respice in nos
clem: Intuens autem in eum Petrus cum Joanne, dixit: Respice in nos.
tr: ατενισας δε πετρος εις αυτον συν τω ιωαννη ειπεν βλεψον εις ημας
kjv: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.

vulg: at ille intendebat in eos sperans se aliquid accepturum ab eis
clem: At ille intendebat in eos, sperans se aliquid accepturum ab eis.
tr: ο δε επειχεν αυτοις προσδοκων τι παρ αυτων λαβειν
kjv: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.

vulg: Petrus autem dixit argentum et aurum non est mihi quod autem habeo hoc tibi do in nomine Iesu Christi Nazareni surge et ambula
clem: Petrus autem dixit: Argentum et aurum non est mihi: quod autem habeo, hoc tibi do: in nomine Jesu Christi Nazareni surge, et ambula.
tr: ειπεν δε πετρος αργυριον και χρυσιον ουχ υπαρχει μοι ο δε εχω τουτο σοι διδωμι εν τω ονοματι ιησου χριστου του ναζωραιου εγειραι και περιπατει
kjv: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

vulg: et adprehensa ei manu dextera adlevavit eum et protinus consolidatae sunt bases eius et plantae
clem: Et apprehensa manu ejus dextera, allevavit eum, et protinus consolidat sunt bases ejus et plant.
tr: και πιασας αυτον της δεξιας χειρος ηγειρεν παραχρημα δε εστερεωθησαν αυτου αι βασεις και τα σφυρα
kjv: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.

vulg: et exiliens stetit et ambulabat et intravit cum illis in templum ambulans et exiliens et laudans Dominum
clem: Et exiliens stetit, et ambulabat: et intravit cum illis in templum ambulans, et exiliens, et laudans Deum.
tr: και εξαλλομενος εστη και περιεπατει και εισηλθεν συν αυτοις εις το ιερον περιπατων και αλλομενος και αινων τον θεον
kjv: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

vulg: et vidit omnis populus eum ambulantem et laudantem Deum
clem: Et vidit omnis populus eum ambulantem et laudantem Deum.
tr: και ειδεν αυτον πας ο λαος περιπατουντα και αινουντα τον θεον
kjv: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

vulg: cognoscebant autem illum quoniam ipse erat qui ad elemosynam sedebat ad Speciosam portam templi et impleti sunt stupore et extasi in eo quod contigerat illi
clem: Cognoscebant autem illum, quod ipse erat qui ad eleemosynam sedebat ad Speciosam portam templi: et impleti sunt stupore et extasi in eo quod contingerat illi.
tr: επεγινωσκον τε αυτον οτι ουτος ην ο προς την ελεημοσυνην καθημενος επι τη ωραια πυλη του ιερου και επλησθησαν θαμβους και εκστασεως επι τω συμβεβηκοτι αυτω
kjv: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.

vulg: cum teneret autem Petrum et Iohannem concurrit omnis populus ad eos ad porticum qui appellatur Salomonis stupentes
clem: Cum teneret autem Petrum et Joannem, cucurrit omnis populus ad eos ad porticum qu appellatur Salomonis, stupentes.
tr: κρατουντος δε του ιαθεντος χωλου τον πετρον και ιωαννην συνεδραμεν προς αυτους πας ο λαος επι τη στοα τη καλουμενη σολομωντος εκθαμβοι
kjv: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

vulg: videns autem Petrus respondit ad populum viri israhelitae quid miramini in hoc aut nos quid intuemini quasi nostra virtute aut pietate fecerimus hunc ambulare
clem: Videns autem Petrus, respondit ad populum: Viri Isralit, quid miramini in hoc, aut nos quid intuemini, quasi nostra virtute aut potestate fecerimus hunc ambulare?
tr: ιδων δε πετρος απεκρινατο προς τον λαον ανδρες ισραηλιται τι θαυμαζετε επι τουτω η ημιν τι ατενιζετε ως ιδια δυναμει η ευσεβεια πεποιηκοσιν του περιπατειν αυτον
kjv: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

vulg: Deus Abraham et Deus Isaac et Deus Iacob Deus patrum nostrorum glorificavit Filium suum Iesum quem vos quidem tradidistis et negastis ante faciem Pilati iudicante illo dimitti
clem: Deus Abraham, et Deus Isaac, et Deus Jacob, Deus patrum nostrorum glorificavit filium suum Jesum, quem vos quidem tradidistis, et negastis ante faciem Pilati, judicante illo dimitti.
tr: ο θεος αβρααμ και ισαακ και ιακωβ ο θεος των πατερων ημων εδοξασεν τον παιδα αυτου ιησουν ον υμεις παρεδωκατε και ηρνησασθε αυτον κατα προσωπον πιλατου κριναντος εκεινου απολυειν
kjv: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

vulg: vos autem sanctum et iustum negastis et petistis virum homicidam donari vobis
clem: Vos autem sanctum et justum negastis, et petistis virum homicidam donari vobis:
tr: υμεις δε τον αγιον και δικαιον ηρνησασθε και ητησασθε ανδρα φονεα χαρισθηναι υμιν
kjv: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;

vulg: auctorem vero vitae interfecistis quem Deus suscitavit a mortuis cuius nos testes sumus
clem: auctorem vero vit interfecistis, quem Deus suscitavit a mortuis, cujus nos testes sumus.
tr: τον δε αρχηγον της ζωης απεκτεινατε ον ο θεος ηγειρεν εκ νεκρων ου ημεις μαρτυρες εσμεν
kjv: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

vulg: et in fide nominis eius hunc quem videtis et nostis confirmavit nomen eius et fides quae per eum est dedit integram sanitatem istam in conspectu omnium vestrum
clem: Et in fide nominis ejus, hunc quem vos vidistis et nostis, confirmavit nomen ejus: et fides, qu per eum est, dedit integram sanitatem istam in conspectu omnium vestrum.
tr: και επι τη πιστει του ονοματος αυτου τουτον ον θεωρειτε και οιδατε εστερεωσεν το ονομα αυτου και η πιστις η δι αυτου εδωκεν αυτω την ολοκληριαν ταυτην απεναντι παντων υμων
kjv: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

vulg: et nunc fratres scio quia per ignorantiam fecistis sicut et principes vestri
clem: Et nunc, fratres, scio quia per ignorantiam fecistis, sicut et principes vestri.
tr: και νυν αδελφοι οιδα οτι κατα αγνοιαν επραξατε ωσπερ και οι αρχοντες υμων
kjv: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.

vulg: Deus autem quae praenuntiavit per os omnium prophetarum pati Christum suum implevit sic
clem: Deus autem, qu prnuntiavit per os omnium prophetarum, pati Christum suum, sic implevit.
tr: ο δε θεος α προκατηγγειλεν δια στοματος παντων των προφητων αυτου παθειν τον χριστον επληρωσεν ουτως
kjv: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.

vulg: paenitemini igitur et convertimini ut deleantur vestra peccata
clem: Pnitemini igitur et convertimini, ut deleantur peccata vestra:
tr: μετανοησατε ουν και επιστρεψατε εις το εξαλειφθηναι υμων τας αμαρτιας οπως αν ελθωσιν καιροι αναψυξεως απο προσωπου του κυριου
kjv: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord.

vulg: ut cum venerint tempora refrigerii a conspectu Domini et miserit eum qui praedicatus est vobis Iesum Christum
clem: ut cum venerint tempora refrigerii a conspectu Domini, et miserit eum qui prdicatus est vobis, Jesum Christum,
tr: και αποστειλη τον προκεκηρυγμενον υμιν ιησουν χριστον
kjv: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:

vulg: quem oportet caelum quidem suscipere usque in tempora restitutionis omnium quae locutus est Deus per os sanctorum suorum a saeculo prophetarum
clem: quem oportet quidem clum suscipere usque in tempora restitutionis omnium qu locutus est Deus per os sanctorum suorum a sculo prophetarum.
tr: ον δει ουρανον μεν δεξασθαι αχρι χρονων αποκαταστασεως παντων ων ελαλησεν ο θεος δια στοματος παντων αγιων αυτου προφητων απ αιωνος
kjv: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

vulg: Moses quidem dixit quia prophetam vobis suscitabit Dominus Deus vester de fratribus vestris tamquam me ipsum audietis iuxta omnia quaecumque locutus fuerit vobis
clem: Moyses quidem dixit: Quoniam prophetam suscitabit vobis Dominus Deus vester de fratribus vestris, tamquam me: ipsum audietis juxta omnia qucumque locutus fuerit vobis.
tr: μωσης μεν γαρ προς τους πατερας ειπεν οτι προφητην υμιν αναστησει κυριος ο θεος υμων εκ των αδελφων υμων ως εμε αυτου ακουσεσθε κατα παντα οσα αν λαληση προς υμας
kjv: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.

vulg: erit autem omnis anima quae non audierit prophetam illum exterminabitur de plebe
clem: Erit autem: omnis anima qu non audierit prophetam illum, exterminabitur de plebe.
tr: εσται δε πασα ψυχη ητις αν μη ακουση του προφητου εκεινου εξολοθρευθησεται εκ του λαου
kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

vulg: et omnes prophetae a Samuhel et deinceps qui locuti sunt et adnuntiaverunt dies istos
clem: Et omnes prophet, a Samuel et deinceps, qui locuti sunt, annuntiaverunt dies istos.
tr: και παντες δε οι προφηται απο σαμουηλ και των καθεξης οσοι ελαλησαν και προκατηγγειλαν τας ημερας ταυτας
kjv: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.

vulg: vos estis filii prophetarum et testamenti quod disposuit Deus ad patres vestros dicens ad Abraham et in semine tuo benedicentur omnes familiae terrae
clem: Vos estis filii prophetarum, et testamenti quod disposuit Deus ad patres nostros, dicens ad Abraham: Et in semine tuo benedicentur omnes famili terr.
tr: υμεις εστε υιοι των προφητων και της διαθηκης ης διεθετο ο θεος προς τους πατερας ημων λεγων προς αβρααμ και τω σπερματι σου ενευλογηθησονται πασαι αι πατριαι της γης
kjv: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

vulg: vobis primum Deus suscitans Filium suum misit eum benedicentem vobis ut convertat se unusquisque a nequitia sua
clem: Vobis primum Deus suscitans filium suum, misit eum benedicentem vobis: ut convertat se unusquisque a nequitia sua.
tr: υμιν πρωτον ο θεος αναστησας τον παιδα αυτου ιησουν απεστειλεν αυτον ευλογουντα υμας εν τω αποστρεφειν εκαστον απο των πονηριων υμων
kjv: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.

vulg: loquentibus autem illis ad populum supervenerunt sacerdotes et magistratus templi et Sadducaei
clem: Loquentibus autem illis ad populum, supervenerunt sacerdotes, et magistratus templi, et sadduci,
tr: λαλουντων δε αυτων προς τον λαον επεστησαν αυτοις οι ιερεις και ο στρατηγος του ιερου και οι σαδδουκαιοι
kjv: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,

vulg: dolentes quod docerent populum et adnuntiarent in Iesu resurrectionem ex mortuis
clem: dolentes quod docerent populum, et annuntiarent in Jesu resurrectionem ex mortuis:
tr: διαπονουμενοι δια το διδασκειν αυτους τον λαον και καταγγελλειν εν τω ιησου την αναστασιν την εκ νεκρων
kjv: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

vulg: et iniecerunt in eis manus et posuerunt eos in custodiam in crastinum erat enim iam vespera
clem: et injecerunt in eos manus, et posuerunt eos in custodiam in crastinum: erat enim jam vespera.
tr: και επεβαλον αυτοις τας χειρας και εθεντο εις τηρησιν εις την αυριον ην γαρ εσπερα ηδη
kjv: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.

vulg: multi autem eorum qui audierant verbum crediderunt et factus est numerus virorum quinque milia
clem: Multi autem eorum qui audierant verbum, crediderunt: et factus est numerus virorum quinque millia.
tr: πολλοι δε των ακουσαντων τον λογον επιστευσαν και εγενηθη ο αριθμος των ανδρων ωσει χιλιαδες πεντε
kjv: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.

vulg: factum est autem in crastinum ut congregarentur principes eorum et seniores et scribae in Hierusalem
clem: Factum est autem in crastinum, ut congregarentur principes eorum, et seniores, et scrib, in Jerusalem:
tr: εγενετο δε επι την αυριον συναχθηναι αυτων τους αρχοντας και πρεσβυτερους και γραμματεις
kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,

vulg: et Annas princeps sacerdotum et Caiphas et Iohannes et Alexander et quotquot erant de genere sacerdotali
clem: et Annas princeps sacerdotum, et Caiphas, et Joannes, et Alexander, et quotquot erant de genere sacerdotali.
tr: εις ιερουσαλημ (4:6) και ανναν τον αρχιερεα και καιαφαν και ιωαννην και αλεξανδρον και οσοι ησαν εκ γενους αρχιερατικου
kjv: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.

vulg: et statuentes eos in medio interrogabant in qua virtute aut in quo nomine fecistis hoc vos
clem: Et statuentes eos in medio, interrogabant: In qua virtute, aut in quo nomine fecistis hoc vos?
tr: και στησαντες αυτους εν τω μεσω επυνθανοντο εν ποια δυναμει η εν ποιω ονοματι εποιησατε τουτο υμεις
kjv: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?

vulg: tunc Petrus repletus Spiritu Sancto dixit ad eos principes populi et seniores
clem: Tunc repletus Spiritu Sancto Petrus, dixit ad eos: Principes populi, et seniores, audite:
tr: τοτε πετρος πλησθεις πνευματος αγιου ειπεν προς αυτους αρχοντες του λαου και πρεσβυτεροι του ισραηλ
kjv: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

vulg: si nos hodie diiudicamur in benefacto hominis infirmi in quo iste salvus factus est
clem: si nos hodie dijudicamur in benefacto hominis infirmi, in quo iste salvus factus est,
tr: ει ημεις σημερον ανακρινομεθα επι ευεργεσια ανθρωπου ασθενους εν τινι  ουτος σεσωσται
kjv: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;

vulg: notum sit omnibus vobis et omni plebi Israhel quia in nomine Iesu Christi Nazareni quem vos crucifixistis quem Deus suscitavit a mortuis in hoc iste adstat coram vobis sanus
clem: notum sit omnibus vobis, et omni plebi Isral, quia in nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi Nazareni, quem vos crucifixistis, quem Deus suscitavit a mortuis, in hoc iste astat coram vobis sanus.
tr: γνωστον εστω πασιν υμιν και παντι τω λαω ισραηλ οτι εν τω ονοματι ιησου χριστου του ναζωραιου ον υμεις εσταυρωσατε ον ο θεος ηγειρεν εκ νεκρων εν τουτω ουτος παρεστηκεν ενωπιον υμων υγιης
kjv: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

vulg: hic est lapis qui reprobatus est a vobis aedificantibus qui factus est in caput anguli
clem: Hic est lapis qui reprobatus est a vobis dificantibus, qui factus est in caput anguli:
tr: ουτος εστιν ο λιθος ο εξουθενηθεις υφ υμων των οικοδομουντων ο γενομενος εις κεφαλην γωνιας
kjv: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

vulg: et non est in alio aliquo salus nec enim nomen aliud est sub caelo datum hominibus in quo oportet nos salvos fieri
clem: et non est in alio aliquo salus. Nec enim aliud nomen est sub clo datum hominibus, in quo oporteat nos salvos fieri.
tr: και ουκ εστιν εν αλλω ουδενι η σωτηρια ουτε γαρ ονομα εστιν ετερον υπο τον ουρανον το δεδομενον εν ανθρωποις εν ω δει σωθηναι ημας
kjv: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

vulg: videntes autem Petri constantiam et Iohannis conperto quod homines essent sine litteris et idiotae admirabantur et cognoscebant eos quoniam cum Iesu fuerant
clem: Videntes autem Petri constantiam, et Joannis, comperto quod homines essent sine litteris, et idiot, admirabantur, et cognoscebant eos quoniam cum Jesu fuerant:
tr: θεωρουντες δε την του πετρου παρρησιαν και ιωαννου και καταλαβομενοι οτι ανθρωποι αγραμματοι εισιν και ιδιωται εθαυμαζον επεγινωσκον τε αυτους οτι συν τω ιησου ησαν
kjv: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

vulg: hominem quoque videntes stantem cum eis qui curatus fuerat nihil poterant contradicere
clem: hominem quoque videntes stantem cum eis, qui curatus fuerat, nihil poterant contradicere.
tr: τον δε ανθρωπον βλεποντες συν αυτοις εστωτα τον τεθεραπευμενον ουδεν ειχον αντειπειν
kjv: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

vulg: iusserunt autem eos foras extra concilium secedere et conferebant ad invicem
clem: Jusserunt autem eos foras extra concilium secedere: et conferebant ad invicem,
tr: κελευσαντες δε αυτους εξω του συνεδριου απελθειν συνεβαλον προς αλληλους
kjv: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

vulg: dicentes quid faciemus hominibus istis quoniam quidem notum signum factum est per eos omnibus habitantibus in Hierusalem manifestum et non possumus negare
clem: dicentes: Quid faciemus hominibus istis? quoniam quidem notum signum factum est per eos omnibus habitantibus Jerusalem: manifestum est, et non possumus negare.
tr: λεγοντες τι ποιησομεν τοις ανθρωποις τουτοις οτι μεν γαρ γνωστον σημειον γεγονεν δι αυτων πασιν τοις κατοικουσιν ιερουσαλημ φανερον και ου δυναμεθα αρνησασθαι
kjv: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.

vulg: sed ne amplius divulgetur in populum comminemur eis ne ultra loquantur in nomine hoc ulli hominum
clem: Sed ne amplius divulgetur in populum, comminemur eis ne ultra loquantur in nomine hoc ulli hominum.
tr: αλλ ινα μη επι πλειον διανεμηθη εις τον λαον απειλη απειλησωμεθα αυτοις μηκετι λαλειν επι τω ονοματι τουτω μηδενι ανθρωπων
kjv: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

vulg: et vocantes eos denuntiaverunt ne omnino loquerentur neque docerent in nomine Iesu
clem: Et vocantes eos, denuntiaverunt ne omnino loquerentur neque docerent in nomine Jesu.
tr: και καλεσαντες αυτους παρηγγειλαν αυτοις το καθολου μη φθεγγεσθαι μηδε διδασκειν επι τω ονοματι του ιησου
kjv: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

vulg: Petrus vero et Iohannes respondentes dixerunt ad eos si iustum est in conspectu Dei vos potius audire quam Deum iudicate
clem: Petrus vero et Joannes respondentes, dixerunt ad eos: Si justum est in conspectu Dei vos potius audire quam Deum, judicate.
tr: ο δε πετρος και ιωαννης αποκριθεντες προς αυτους ειπον ει δικαιον εστιν ενωπιον του θεου υμων ακουειν μαλλον η του θεου κρινατε
kjv: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

vulg: non enim possumus quae vidimus et audivimus non loqui
clem: Non enim possumus qu vidimus et audivimus non loqui.
tr: ου δυναμεθα γαρ ημεις α ειδομεν και ηκουσαμεν μη λαλειν
kjv: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

vulg: at illi comminantes dimiserunt eos non invenientes quomodo punirent eos propter populum quia omnes clarificabant Deum in eo quod acciderat
clem: At illi comminantes dimiserunt eos, non invenientes quomodo punirent eos propter populum: quia omnes clarificabant id quod factum fuerat in eo quod acciderat.
tr: οι δε προσαπειλησαμενοι απελυσαν αυτους μηδεν ευρισκοντες το πως κολασωνται αυτους δια τον λαον οτι παντες εδοξαζον τον θεον επι τω γεγονοτι
kjv: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.

vulg: annorum enim erat amplius quadraginta homo in quo factum erat signum istud sanitatis
clem: Annorum enim erat amplius quadraginta homo, in quo factum fuerat signum istud sanitatis.
tr: ετων γαρ ην πλειονων τεσσαρακοντα ο ανθρωπος εφ ον εγεγονει το σημειον τουτο της ιασεως
kjv: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.

vulg: dimissi autem venerunt ad suos et adnuntiaverunt eis quanta ad eos principes sacerdotum et seniores dixissent
clem: Dimissi autem venerunt ad suos, et annuntiaverunt eis quanta ad eos principes sacerdotum et seniores dixissent.
tr: απολυθεντες δε ηλθον προς τους ιδιους και απηγγειλαν οσα προς αυτους οι αρχιερεις και οι πρεσβυτεροι ειπον
kjv: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.

vulg: qui cum audissent unianimiter levaverunt vocem ad Deum et dixerunt Domine tu qui fecisti caelum et terram et mare et omnia quae in eis sunt
clem: Qui cum audissent, unanimiter levaverunt vocem ad Deum, et dixerunt: Domine, tu es qui fecisti clum et terram, mare et omnia qu in eis sunt:
tr: οι δε ακουσαντες ομοθυμαδον ηραν φωνην προς τον θεον και ειπον δεσποτα συ ο θεος ο ποιησας τον ουρανον και την γην και την θαλασσαν και παντα τα εν αυτοις
kjv: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

vulg: qui Spiritu Sancto per os patris nostri David pueri tui dixisti quare fremuerunt gentes et populi meditati sunt inania
clem: qui Spiritu Sancto per os patris nostri David pueri tui dixisti: [Quare fremuerunt gentes, et populi meditati sunt inania?
tr: ο δια στοματος δαβιδ του παιδος σου ειπων ινα τι εφρυαξαν εθνη και λαοι εμελετησαν κενα
kjv: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?

vulg: adstiterunt reges terrae et principes convenerunt in unum adversus Dominum et adversus Christum eius
clem: Astiterunt reges terr, et principes convenerunt in unum adversus Dominum, et adversus Christum ejus.]
tr: παρεστησαν οι βασιλεις της γης και οι αρχοντες συνηχθησαν επι το αυτο κατα του κυριου και κατα του χριστου αυτου
kjv: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.

vulg: convenerunt enim vere in civitate ista adversus sanctum puerum tuum Iesum quem unxisti Herodes et Pontius Pilatus cum gentibus et populis Israhel
clem: Convenerunt enim vere in civitate ista adversus sanctum puerum tuum Jesum, quem unxisti, Herodes et Pontius Pilatus, cum gentibus et populis Isral,
tr: συνηχθησαν γαρ επ αληθειας επι τον αγιον παιδα σου ιησουν ον εχρισας ηρωδης τε και ποντιος πιλατος συν εθνεσιν και λαοις ισραηλ
kjv: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,

vulg: facere quae manus tua et consilium decreverunt fieri
clem: facere qu manus tua et consilium tuum decreverunt fieri.
tr: ποιησαι οσα η χειρ σου και η βουλη σου προωρισεν γενεσθαι
kjv: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.

vulg: et nunc Domine respice in minas eorum et da servis tuis cum omni fiducia loqui verbum tuum
clem: Et nunc, Domine, respice in minas eorum, et da servis tuis cum omni fiducia loqui verbum tuum,
tr: και τα νυν κυριε επιδε επι τας απειλας αυτων και δος τοις δουλοις σου μετα παρρησιας πασης λαλειν τον λογον σου
kjv: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

vulg: in eo cum manum tuam extendas sanitates et signa et prodigia fieri per nomen sancti Filii tui Iesu
clem: in eo quod manum tuam extendas ad sanitates, et signa, et prodigia fieri per nomen sancti filii tui Jesu.
tr: εν τω την χειρα σου εκτεινειν σε εις ιασιν και σημεια και τερατα γινεσθαι δια του ονοματος του αγιου παιδος σου ιησου
kjv: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.

vulg: et cum orassent motus est locus in quo erant congregati et repleti sunt omnes Spiritu Sancto et loquebantur verbum Dei cum fiducia
clem: Et cum orassent, motus est locus in quo erant congregati: et repleti sunt omnes Spiritu Sancto, et loquebantur verbum Dei cum fiducia.
tr: και δεηθεντων αυτων εσαλευθη ο τοπος εν ω ησαν συνηγμενοι και επλησθησαν απαντες πνευματος αγιου και ελαλουν τον λογον του θεου μετα παρρησιας
kjv: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

vulg: multitudinis autem credentium erat cor et anima una nec quisquam eorum quae possidebant aliquid suum esse dicebat sed erant illis omnia communia
clem: Multitudinis autem credentium erat cor unum et anima una: nec quisquam eorum qu possidebat, aliquid suum esse dicebat, sed erant illis omnia communia.
tr: του δε πληθους των πιστευσαντων ην η καρδια και η ψυχη μια και ουδε  ουδ   εις τι των υπαρχοντων  αυτω ελεγεν ιδιον ειναι αλλ ην 1510 αυτοις απαντα κοινα
kjv: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

vulg: et virtute magna reddebant apostoli testimonium resurrectionis Iesu Christi Domini et gratia magna erat in omnibus illis
clem: Et virtute magna reddebant Apostoli testimonium resurrectionis Jesu Christi Domini nostri: et gratia magna erat in omnibus illis.
tr: και μεγαλη δυναμει απεδιδουν το μαρτυριον οι αποστολοι της αναστασεως του κυριου ιησου χαρις τε μεγαλη ην επι παντας αυτους
kjv: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

vulg: neque enim quisquam egens erat inter illos quotquot enim possessores agrorum aut domorum erant vendentes adferebant pretia eorum quae vendebant
clem: Neque enim quisquam egens erat inter illos. Quotquot enim possessores agrorum aut domorum erant, vendentes afferebant pretia eorum qu vendebant,
tr: ουδε γαρ ενδεης τις υπηρχεν εν αυτοις οσοι γαρ κτητορες χωριων η οικιων υπηρχον πωλουντες εφερον τας τιμας των πιπρασκομενων
kjv: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

vulg: et ponebant ante pedes apostolorum dividebantur autem singulis prout cuique opus erat
clem: et ponebant ante pedes Apostolorum. Dividebatur autem singulis prout cuique opus erat.
tr: και ετιθουν παρα τους ποδας των αποστολων διεδιδοτο δε εκαστω καθοτι αν τις χρειαν ειχεν
kjv: And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

vulg: Ioseph autem qui cognominatus est Barnabas ab apostolis quod est interpretatum Filius consolationis Levites Cyprius genere
clem: Joseph autem, qui cognominatus est Barnabas ab Apostolis (quod est interpretatum, Filius consolationis), Levites, Cyprius genere,
tr: ιωσης δε ο επικληθεις βαρναβας υπο των αποστολων ο εστιν μεθερμηνευομενον υιος παρακλησεως λευιτης κυπριος τω γενει
kjv: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,

vulg: cum haberet agrum vendidit illum et adtulit pretium et posuit ante pedes apostolorum
clem: cum haberet agrum, vendidit eum, et attulit pretium, et posuit ante pedes Apostolorum.
tr: υπαρχοντος αυτω αγρου πωλησας ηνεγκεν το χρημα και εθηκεν παρα τους ποδας των αποστολων
kjv: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

vulg: vir autem quidam nomine Ananias cum Saffira uxore sua vendidit agrum
clem: Vir autem quidam nomine Ananias, cum Saphira uxore suo vendidit agrum,
tr: ανηρ δε τις ανανιας ονοματι συν σαπφειρη τη γυναικι αυτου επωλησεν κτημα
kjv: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

vulg: et fraudavit de pretio agri conscia uxore sua et adferens partem quandam ad pedes apostolorum posuit
clem: et fraudavit de pretio agri, conscia uxore sua: et afferens partem quamdam, ad pedes Apostolorum posuit.
tr: και ενοσφισατο απο της τιμης συνειδυιας και της γυναικος αυτου και ενεγκας μερος τι παρα τους ποδας των αποστολων εθηκεν
kjv: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

vulg: dixit autem Petrus Anania cur temptavit Satanas cor tuum mentiri te Spiritui Sancto et fraudare de pretio agri
clem: Dixit autem Petrus: Anania, cur tentavit Satanas cor tuum, mentiri te Spiritui Sancto, et fraudare de pretio agri?
tr: ειπεν δε πετρος ανανια δια τι επληρωσεν ο σατανας την καρδιαν σου ψευσασθαι σε το πνευμα το αγιον και νοσφισασθαι απο της τιμης του χωριου
kjv: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

vulg: nonne manens tibi manebat et venundatum in tua erat potestate quare posuisti in corde tuo hanc rem non es mentitus hominibus sed Deo
clem: nonne manens tibi manebat, et venundatum in tua erat potestate? quare posuisti in corde tuo hanc rem? non es mentitus hominibus, sed Deo.
tr: ουχι μενον σοι εμενεν και πραθεν εν τη ση εξουσια υπηρχεν τι οτι εθου εν τη καρδια σου το πραγμα τουτο ουκ εψευσω ανθρωποις αλλα τω θεω
kjv: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.

vulg: audiens autem Ananias haec verba cecidit et exspiravit et factus est timor magnus in omnes qui audierant
clem: Audiens autem Ananias hc verba, cecidit, et expiravit. Et factus est timor magnus super omnes qui audierunt.
tr: ακουων δε ανανιας τους λογους τουτους πεσων εξεψυξεν και εγενετο φοβος μεγας επι παντας τους ακουοντας ταυτα
kjv: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

vulg: surgentes autem iuvenes amoverunt eum et efferentes sepelierunt
clem: Surgentes autem juvenes amoverunt eum, et efferentes sepelierunt.
tr: ανασταντες δε οι νεωτεροι συνεστειλαν αυτον και εξενεγκαντες εθαψαν
kjv: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.

vulg: factum est autem quasi horarum trium spatium et uxor ipsius nesciens quod factum fuerat introiit
clem: Factum est autem quasi horarum trium spatium, et uxor ipsius, nesciens quod factum fuerat, introivit.
tr: εγενετο δε ως ωρων τριων διαστημα και η γυνη αυτου μη ειδυια το γεγονος εισηλθεν
kjv: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

vulg: respondit autem ei Petrus dic mihi si tanti agrum vendidistis at illa dixit etiam tanti
clem: Dixit autem ei Petrus: Dic mihi mulier, si tanti agrum vendidistis? At illa dixit: Etiam tanti.
tr: απεκριθη δε αυτη ο πετρος ειπε μοι ει τοσουτου το χωριον απεδοσθε η δε ειπεν ναι τοσουτου
kjv: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

vulg: Petrus autem ad eam quid utique convenit vobis temptare Spiritum Domini ecce pedes eorum qui sepelierunt virum tuum ad ostium et efferent te
clem: Petrus autem ad eam: Quid utique convenit vobis tentare Spiritum Domini? Ecce pedes eorum qui sepelierunt virum tuum ad ostium, et efferent te.
tr: ο δε πετρος ειπεν προς αυτην τι οτι συνεφωνηθη υμιν πειρασαι το πνευμα κυριου ιδου οι ποδες των θαψαντων τον ανδρα σου επι τη θυρα και εξοισουσιν σε
kjv: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.

vulg: confestim cecidit ante pedes eius et exspiravit intrantes autem iuvenes invenerunt illam mortuam et extulerunt et sepelierunt ad virum suum
clem: Confestim cecidit ante pedes ejus, et expiravit. Intrantes autem juvenes invenerunt illam mortuam: et extulerunt, et sepelierunt ad virum suum.
tr: επεσεν δε παραχρημα παρα τους ποδας αυτου και εξεψυξεν εισελθοντες δε οι νεανισκοι ευρον αυτην νεκραν και εξενεγκαντες εθαψαν προς τον ανδρα αυτης
kjv: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.

vulg: et factus est timor magnus in universa ecclesia et in omnes qui audierunt haec
clem: Et factus est timor magnus in universa ecclesia, et in omnes qui audierunt hc.
tr: και εγενετο φοβος μεγας εφ ολην την εκκλησιαν και επι παντας τους ακουοντας ταυτα
kjv: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.

vulg: per manus autem apostolorum fiebant signa et prodigia multa in plebe et erant unianimiter omnes in porticu Salomonis
clem: Per manus autem Apostolorum fiebant signa et prodigia multa in plebe. Et erant unanimiter omnes in porticu Salomonis.
tr: δια δε των χειρων των αποστολων εγενετο  εγινετο  σημεια και τερατα εν τω λαω πολλα και ησαν ομοθυμαδον απαντες εν τη στοα σολομωντος
kjv: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

vulg: ceterorum autem nemo audebat coniungere se illis sed magnificabat eos populus
clem: Ceterorum autem nemo audebat se conjungere illis: sed magnificabat eos populus.
tr: των δε λοιπων ουδεις ετολμα κολλασθαι αυτοις αλλ εμεγαλυνεν αυτους ο λαος
kjv: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.

vulg: magis autem augebatur credentium in Domino multitudo virorum ac mulierum
clem: Magis autem augebatur credentium in Domino multitudo virorum ac mulierum,
tr: μαλλον δε προσετιθεντο πιστευοντες τω κυριω πληθη ανδρων τε και γυναικων
kjv: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)

vulg: ita ut in plateas eicerent infirmos et ponerent in lectulis et grabattis ut veniente Petro saltim umbra illius obumbraret quemquam eorum
clem: ita ut in plateas ejicerent infirmos, et ponerent in lectulis et grabatis, ut, veniente Petro, saltem umbra illius obumbraret quemquam illorum, et liberarentur ab infirmitatibus suis.
tr: ωστε κατα τας πλατειας εκφερειν τους ασθενεις και τιθεναι επι κλινων και κραββατων ινα ερχομενου πετρου καν η σκια επισκιαση τινι αυτων
kjv: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

vulg: concurrebat autem et multitudo vicinarum civitatum Hierusalem adferentes aegros et vexatos ab spiritibus inmundis qui curabantur omnes
clem: Concurrebat autem et multitudo vicinarum civitatum Jerusalem, afferentes gros, et vexatos a spiritibus immundis: qui curabantur omnes.
tr: συνηρχετο δε και το πληθος των περιξ πολεων εις ιερουσαλημ φεροντες ασθενεις και οχλουμενους υπο πνευματων ακαθαρτων οιτινες εθεραπευοντο απαντες
kjv: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

vulg: exsurgens autem princeps sacerdotum et omnes qui cum illo erant quae est heresis Sadducaeorum repleti sunt zelo
clem: Exsurgens autem princeps sacerdotum, et omnes qui cum illo erant (qu est hresis sadducorum), repleti sunt zelo:
tr: αναστας δε ο αρχιερευς και παντες οι συν αυτω η ουσα αιρεσις των σαδδουκαιων επλησθησαν ζηλου
kjv: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

vulg: et iniecerunt manus in apostolos et posuerunt illos in custodia publica
clem: et injecerunt manus in Apostolos, et posuerunt eos in custodia publica.
tr: και επεβαλον τας χειρας αυτων επι τους αποστολους και εθεντο αυτους εν τηρησει δημοσια
kjv: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.

vulg: angelus autem Domini per noctem aperiens ianuas carceris et educens eos dixit
clem: Angelus autem Domini per noctem aperiens januas carceris, et educens eos, dixit:
tr: αγγελος δε κυριου δια της νυκτος ηνοιξεν τας θυρας της φυλακης εξαγαγων τε αυτους ειπεν
kjv: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,

vulg: ite et stantes loquimini in templo plebi omnia verba vitae huius
clem: Ite, et stantes loquimini in templo plebi omnia verba vit hujus.
tr: πορευεσθε και σταθεντες λαλειτε εν τω ιερω τω λαω παντα τα ρηματα της ζωης ταυτης
kjv: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

vulg: qui cum audissent intraverunt diluculo in templum et docebant adveniens autem princeps sacerdotum et qui cum eo erant convocaverunt concilium et omnes seniores filiorum Israhel et miserunt in carcerem ut adducerentur
clem: Qui cum audissent, intraverunt diluculo in templum, et docebant. Adveniens autem princeps sacerdotum, et qui cum eo erant, convocaverunt concilium, et omnes seniores filiorum Isral: et miserunt ad carcerem ut adducerentur.
tr: ακουσαντες δε εισηλθον υπο τον ορθρον εις το ιερον και εδιδασκον παραγενομενος δε ο αρχιερευς και οι συν αυτω συνεκαλεσαν το συνεδριον και πασαν την γερουσιαν των υιων ισραηλ και απεστειλαν εις το δεσμωτηριον αχθηναι αυτους
kjv: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

vulg: cum venissent autem ministri et aperto carcere non invenissent illos reversi nuntiaverunt
clem: Cum autem venissent ministri, et aperto carcere non invenissent illos, reversi nuntiaverunt,
tr: οι δε υπηρεται παραγενομενοι ουχ ευρον αυτους εν τη φυλακη αναστρεψαντες δε απηγγειλαν
kjv: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned and told,

vulg: dicentes carcerem quidem invenimus clausum cum omni diligentia et custodes stantes ad ianuas aperientes autem neminem intus invenimus
clem: dicentes: Carcerem quidem invenimus clausum cum omni diligentia, et custodes stantes ante januas: aperientes autem neminem intus invenimus.
tr: λεγοντες οτι το μεν δεσμωτηριον ευρομεν κεκλεισμενον εν παση ασφαλεια και τους φυλακας εξω εστωτας προ των θυρων ανοιξαντες δε εσω ουδενα ευρομεν
kjv: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

vulg: ut audierunt autem hos sermones magistratus templi et principes sacerdotum ambigebant de illis quidnam fieret
clem: Ut autem audierunt hos sermones magistratus templi et principes sacerdotum, ambigebant de illis quidnam fieret.
tr: ως δε ηκουσαν τους λογους τουτους ο τε ιερευς και ο στρατηγος του ιερου και οι αρχιερεις διηπορουν περι αυτων τι αν γενοιτο τουτο
kjv: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.

vulg: adveniens autem quidam nuntiavit eis quia ecce viri quos posuistis in carcere sunt in templo stantes et docentes populum
clem: Adveniens autem quidam, nuntiavit eis: Quia ecce viri quos posuistis in carcerem, sunt in templo, stantes et docentes populum.
tr: παραγενομενος δε τις απηγγειλεν αυτοις λεγων οτι ιδου οι ανδρες ους εθεσθε εν τη φυλακη εισιν εν τω ιερω εστωτες και διδασκοντες τον λαον
kjv: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

vulg: tunc abiit magistratus cum ministris et adduxit illos sine vi timebant enim populum ne lapidarentur
clem: Tunc abiit magistratus cum ministris, et adduxit illos sine vi: timebant enim populum ne lapidarentur.
tr: τοτε απελθων ο στρατηγος συν τοις υπηρεταις ηγαγεν αυτους ου μετα βιας εφοβουντο γαρ τον λαον ινα μη λιθασθωσιν
kjv: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.

vulg: et cum adduxissent illos statuerunt in concilio et interrogavit eos princeps sacerdotum
clem: Et cum adduxissent illos, statuerunt in concilio: et interrogavit eos princeps sacerdotum,
tr: αγαγοντες δε αυτους εστησαν εν τω συνεδριω και επηρωτησεν αυτους ο αρχιερευς
kjv: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,

vulg: dicens praecipiendo praecepimus vobis ne doceretis in nomine isto et ecce replestis Hierusalem doctrina vestra et vultis inducere super nos sanguinem hominis istius
clem: dicens: Prcipiendo prcepimus vobis ne doceretis in nomine isto, et ecce replestis Jerusalem doctrina vestra: et vultis inducere super nos sanguinem hominis istius.
tr: λεγων ου παραγγελια παρηγγειλαμεν υμιν μη διδασκειν επι τω ονοματι τουτω και ιδου πεπληρωκατε την ιερουσαλημ της διδαχης υμων και βουλεσθε επαγαγειν εφ ημας το αιμα του ανθρωπου τουτου
kjv: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.

vulg: respondens autem Petrus et apostoli dixerunt oboedire oportet Deo magis quam hominibus
clem: Respondens autem Petrus et Apostoli, dixerunt: Obedire oportet Deo magis quam hominibus.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο πετρος και οι αποστολοι ειπον πειθαρχειν δει θεω μαλλον η ανθρωποις
kjv: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

vulg: Deus patrum nostrorum suscitavit Iesum quem vos interemistis suspendentes in ligno
clem: Deus patrum nostrorum suscitavit Jesum, quem vos interemistis, suspendentes in ligno.
tr: ο θεος των πατερων ημων ηγειρεν ιησουν ον υμεις διεχειρισασθε κρεμασαντες επι ξυλου
kjv: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.

vulg: hunc Deus principem et salvatorem exaltavit dextera sua ad dandam paenitentiam Israhel et remissionem peccatorum
clem: Hunc principem et salvatorem Deus exaltavit dextera sua ad dandam pnitentiam Israli, et remissionem peccatorum:
tr: τουτον ο θεος αρχηγον και σωτηρα υψωσεν τη δεξια αυτου δουναι μετανοιαν τω ισραηλ και αφεσιν αμαρτιων
kjv: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

vulg: et nos sumus testes horum verborum et Spiritus Sanctus quem dedit Deus omnibus oboedientibus sibi
