clem: et nos sumus testes horum verborum, et Spiritus Sanctus, quem dedit Deus omnibus obedientibus sibi.
tr: και ημεις εσμεν αυτου μαρτυρες των ρηματων τουτων και το πνευμα δε το αγιον ο εδωκεν ο θεος τοις πειθαρχουσιν αυτω
kjv: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

vulg: haec cum audissent dissecabantur et cogitabant interficere illos
clem: Hc cum audissent, dissecabantur, et cogitabant interficere illos.
tr: οι δε ακουσαντες διεπριοντο και εβουλευοντο ανελειν αυτους
kjv: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.

vulg: surgens autem quidam in concilio Pharisaeus nomine Gamalihel legis doctor honorabilis universae plebi iussit foras ad breve homines fieri
clem: Surgens autem quidam in concilio pharisus, nomine Gamaliel, legis doctor, honorabilis univers plebi, jussit foras ad breve homines fieri,
tr: αναστας δε τις εν τω συνεδριω φαρισαιος ονοματι γαμαλιηλ νομοδιδασκαλος τιμιος παντι τω λαω εκελευσεν εξω βραχυ τι τους αποστολους ποιησαι
kjv: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

vulg: dixitque ad illos viri israhelitae adtendite vobis super hominibus istis quid acturi sitis
clem: dixitque ad illos: Viri Isralit, attendite vobis super hominibus istis quid acturi sitis.
tr: ειπεν τε προς αυτους ανδρες ισραηλιται προσεχετε εαυτοις επι τοις ανθρωποις τουτοις τι μελλετε πρασσειν
kjv: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.

vulg: ante hos enim dies extitit Theodas dicens esse se aliquem cui consensit virorum numerus circiter quadringentorum qui occisus est et omnes quicumque credebant ei dissipati sunt et redactus est ad nihilum
clem: Ante hos enim dies extitit Theodas, dicens se esse aliquem, cui consensit numerus virorum circiter quadringentorum: qui occisus est, et omnes qui credebant ei, dissipati sunt, et redacti ad nihilum.
tr: προ γαρ τουτων των ημερων ανεστη θευδας λεγων ειναι τινα εαυτον ω προσεκολληθη αριθμος ανδρων ωσει τετρακοσιων ος ανηρεθη και παντες οσοι επειθοντο αυτω διελυθησαν και εγενοντο εις ουδεν
kjv: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.

vulg: post hunc extitit Iudas Galilaeus in diebus professionis et avertit populum post se et ipse periit et omnes quotquot consenserunt ei dispersi sunt
clem: Post hunc extitit Judas Galilus in diebus professionis, et avertit populum post se: et ipse periit, et omnes quotquot consenserunt ei, dispersi sunt.
tr: μετα τουτον ανεστη ιουδας ο γαλιλαιος εν ταις ημεραις της απογραφης και απεστησεν λαον ικανον οπισω αυτου κακεινος απωλετο και παντες οσοι επειθοντο αυτω διεσκορπισθησαν
kjv: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

vulg: et nunc itaque dico vobis discedite ab hominibus istis et sinite illos quoniam si est ex hominibus consilium hoc aut opus dissolvetur
clem: Et nunc itaque dico vobis, discedite ab hominibus istis, et sinite illos: quoniam si est ex hominibus consilium hoc aut opus, dissolvetur:
tr: και τα νυν λεγω υμιν αποστητε απο των ανθρωπων τουτων και εασατε αυτους οτι εαν η εξ ανθρωπων η βουλη αυτη η το εργον τουτο καταλυθησεται
kjv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:

vulg: si vero ex Deo est non poteritis dissolvere eos ne forte et Deo repugnare inveniamini consenserunt autem illi
clem: si vero ex Deo est, non poteritis dissolvere illud, ne forte et Deo repugnare inveniamini. Consenserunt autem illi.
tr: ει δε εκ θεου εστιν ου δυνασθε καταλυσαι αυτο μηποτε και θεομαχοι ευρεθητε
kjv: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

vulg: et convocantes apostolos caesis denuntiaverunt ne loquerentur in nomine Iesu et dimiserunt eos
clem: Et convocantes Apostolos, csis denuntiaverunt ne omnino loquerentur in nomine Jesu, et dimiserunt eos.
tr: επεισθησαν δε αυτω και προσκαλεσαμενοι τους αποστολους δειραντες παρηγγειλαν μη λαλειν επι τω ονοματι του ιησου και απελυσαν αυτους
kjv: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

vulg: et illi quidem ibant gaudentes a conspectu concilii quoniam digni habiti sunt pro nomine Iesu contumeliam pati
clem: Et illi quidem ibant gaudentes a conspectu concilii, quoniam digni habiti sunt pro nomine Jesu contumeliam pati.
tr: οι μεν ουν επορευοντο χαιροντες απο προσωπου του συνεδριου οτι υπερ του ονοματος αυτου κατηξιωθησαν ατιμασθηναι
kjv: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

vulg: omni autem die in templo et circa domos non cessabant docentes et evangelizantes Christum Iesum
clem: Omni autem die non cessabant in templo et circa domos, docentes et evangelizantes Christum Jesum.
tr: πασαν τε ημεραν εν τω ιερω και κατ οικον ουκ επαυοντο διδασκοντες και ευαγγελιζομενοι ιησουν τον χριστον
kjv: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.

vulg: in diebus autem illis crescente numero discipulorum factus est murmur Graecorum adversus Hebraeos eo quod dispicerentur in ministerio cotidiano viduae eorum
clem: In diebus illis, crescente numero discipulorum, factum est murmur Grcorum adversus Hebros, eo quod despicerentur in ministerio quotidiano vidu eorum.
tr: εν δε ταις ημεραις ταυταις πληθυνοντων των μαθητων εγενετο γογγυσμος των ελληνιστων προς τους εβραιους οτι παρεθεωρουντο εν τη διακονια τη καθημερινη αι χηραι αυτων
kjv: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

vulg: convocantes autem duodecim multitudinem discipulorum dixerunt non est aequum nos derelinquere verbum Dei et ministrare mensis
clem: Convocantes autem duodecim multitudinem discipulorum, dixerunt: Non est quum nos derelinquere verbum Dei, et ministrare mensis.
tr: προσκαλεσαμενοι δε οι δωδεκα το πληθος των μαθητων ειπον ουκ αρεστον εστιν ημας καταλειψαντας τον λογον του θεου διακονειν τραπεζαις
kjv: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

vulg: considerate ergo fratres viros ex vobis boni testimonii septem plenos Spiritu et sapientia quos constituamus super hoc opus
clem: Considerate ergo, fratres, viros ex vobis boni testimonii septem, plenos Spiritu Sancto et sapientia, quos constituamus super hoc opus.
tr: επισκεψασθε ουν αδελφοι ανδρας εξ υμων μαρτυρουμενους επτα πληρεις πνευματος αγιου και σοφιας ους καταστησομεν επι της χρειας ταυτης
kjv: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

vulg: nos vero orationi et ministerio verbi instantes erimus
clem: Nos vero orationi et ministerio verbi instantes erimus.
tr: ημεις δε τη προσευχη και τη διακονια του λογου προσκαρτερησομεν
kjv: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

vulg: et placuit sermo coram omni multitudine et elegerunt Stephanum virum plenum fide et Spiritu Sancto et Philippum et Prochorum et Nicanorem et Timonem et Parmenam et Nicolaum advenam Antiochenum
clem: Et placuit sermo coram omni multitudine. Et elegerunt Stephanum, virum plenum fide et Spiritu Sancto, et Philippum, et Prochorum, et Nicanorem, et Timonem, et Parmenam, et Nicolaum advenam Antiochenum.
tr: και ηρεσεν ο λογος ενωπιον παντος του πληθους και εξελεξαντο στεφανον ανδρα πληρη πιστεως και πνευματος αγιου και φιλιππον και προχορον και νικανορα και τιμωνα και παρμεναν και νικολαον προσηλυτον αντιοχεα
kjv: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

vulg: hos statuerunt ante conspectum apostolorum et orantes inposuerunt eis manus
clem: Hos statuerunt ante conspectum Apostolorum: et orantes imposuerunt eis manus.
tr: ους εστησαν ενωπιον των αποστολων και προσευξαμενοι επεθηκαν αυτοις τας χειρας
kjv: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

vulg: et verbum Dei crescebat et multiplicabatur numerus discipulorum in Hierusalem valde multa etiam turba sacerdotum oboediebat fidei
clem: Et verbum Domini crescebat, et multiplicabatur numerus discipulorum in Jerusalem valde: multa etiam turba sacerdotum obediebat fidei.
tr: και ο λογος του θεου ηυξανεν και επληθυνετο ο αριθμος των μαθητων εν ιερουσαλημ σφοδρα πολυς τε οχλος των ιερεων υπηκουον τη πιστει
kjv: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

vulg: Stephanus autem plenus gratia et fortitudine faciebat prodigia et signa magna in populo
clem: Stephanus autem plenus gratia et fortitudine, faciebat prodigia et signa magna in populo.
tr: στεφανος δε πληρης πιστεως και δυναμεως εποιει τερατα και σημεια μεγαλα εν τω λαω
kjv: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

vulg: surrexerunt autem quidam de synagoga quae appellatur Libertinorum et Cyrenensium et Alexandrinorum et eorum qui erant a Cilicia et Asia disputantes cum Stephano
clem: Surrexerunt autem quidam de synagoga qu appellatur Libertinorum, et Cyrenensium, et Alexandrinorum, et eorum qui erant a Cilicia, et Asia, disputantes cum Stephano:
tr: ανεστησαν δε τινες των εκ της συναγωγης της λεγομενης λιβερτινων και κυρηναιων και αλεξανδρεων και των απο κιλικιας και ασιας συζητουντες τω στεφανω
kjv: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

vulg: et non poterant resistere sapientiae et Spiritui quo loquebatur
clem: et non poterant resistere sapienti, et Spiritui qui loquebatur.
tr: και ουκ ισχυον αντιστηναι τη σοφια και τω πνευματι ω ελαλει
kjv: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.

vulg: tunc submiserunt viros qui dicerent se audisse eum dicentem verba blasphemiae in Mosen et Deum
clem: Tunc summiserunt viros, qui dicerent se audivisse eum dicentem verba blasphemi in Moysen et in Deum.
tr: τοτε υπεβαλον ανδρας λεγοντας οτι ακηκοαμεν αυτου λαλουντος ρηματα βλασφημα εις μωσην και τον θεον
kjv: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.

vulg: commoverunt itaque plebem et seniores et scribas et concurrentes rapuerunt eum et adduxerunt in concilium
clem: Commoverunt itaque plebem, et seniores, et scribas: et concurrentes rapuerunt eum, et adduxerunt in concilium,
tr: συνεκινησαν τε τον λαον και τους πρεσβυτερους και τους γραμματεις και επισταντες συνηρπασαν αυτον και ηγαγον εις το συνεδριον
kjv: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,

vulg: et statuerunt testes falsos dicentes homo iste non cessat loqui verba adversus locum sanctum et legem
clem: et statuerunt falsos testes, qui dicerent: Homo iste non cessat loqui verba adversus locum sanctum, et legem:
tr: εστησαν τε μαρτυρας ψευδεις λεγοντας ο ανθρωπος ουτος ου παυεται ρηματα βλασφημα λαλων κατα του τοπου του αγιου τουτου και του νομου
kjv: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

vulg: audivimus enim eum dicentem quoniam Iesus Nazarenus hic destruet locum istum et mutabit traditiones quas tradidit nobis Moses
clem: audivimus enim eum dicentem quoniam Jesus Nazarenus hic destruet locum istum, et mutabit traditiones quas tradidit nobis Moyses.
tr: ακηκοαμεν γαρ αυτου λεγοντος οτι ιησους ο ναζωραιος ουτος καταλυσει τον τοπον τουτον και αλλαξει τα εθη α παρεδωκεν ημιν μωυσης
kjv: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.

vulg: et intuentes eum omnes qui sedebant in concilio viderunt faciem eius tamquam faciem angeli
clem: Et intuentes eum omnes qui sedebant in concilio, viderunt faciem ejus tamquam faciem angeli.
tr: και ατενισαντες εις αυτον απαντες οι καθεζομενοι εν τω συνεδριω ειδον το προσωπον αυτου ωσει προσωπον αγγελου
kjv: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.

vulg: dixit autem princeps sacerdotum si haec ita se habent
clem: Dixit autem princeps sacerdotum: Si hc ita se habent?
tr: ειπεν δε ο αρχιερευς ει αρα ταυτα ουτως εχει
kjv: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

vulg: qui ait viri fratres et patres audite Deus gloriae apparuit patri nostro Abraham cum esset in Mesopotamiam priusquam moraretur in Charram
clem: Qui ait: Viri fratres et patres, audite: Deus glori apparuit patri nostro Abrah cum esset in Mesopotamia, priusquam moraretur in Charan,
tr: ο δε εφη ανδρες αδελφοι και πατερες ακουσατε ο θεος της δοξης ωφθη τω πατρι ημων αβρααμ οντι εν τη μεσοποταμια πριν η κατοικησαι αυτον εν χαρραν
kjv: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

vulg: et dixit ad illum exi de terra tua et de cognatione tua et veni in terram quam tibi monstravero
clem: et dixit ad illum: Exi de terra tua, et de cognatione tua, et veni in terram quam monstravero tibi.
tr: και ειπεν προς αυτον εξελθε εκ της γης σου και εκ της συγγενειας σου και δευρο εις γην ην αν σοι δειξω
kjv: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.

vulg: tunc exiit de terra Chaldeorum et habitavit in Charram et inde postquam mortuus est pater eius transtulit illum in terram istam in qua nunc vos habitatis
clem: Tunc exiit de terra Chaldorum, et habitavit in Charan. Et inde, postquam mortuus est pater ejus, transtulit illum in terram istam, in qua nunc vos habitatis.
tr: τοτε εξελθων εκ γης χαλδαιων κατωκησεν εν χαρραν κακειθεν μετα το αποθανειν τον πατερα αυτου μετωκισεν αυτον εις την γην ταυτην εις ην υμεις νυν κατοικειτε
kjv: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.

vulg: et non dedit illi hereditatem in ea nec passum pedis et repromisit dare illi eam in possessionem et semini eius post ipsum cum non haberet filium
clem: Et non dedit illi hreditatem in ea, nec passum pedis: sed repromisit dare illi eam in possessionem, et semini ejus post ipsum, cum non haberet filium.
tr: και ουκ εδωκεν αυτω κληρονομιαν εν αυτη ουδε βημα ποδος και επηγγειλατο αυτω δουναι εις κατασχεσιν αυτην και τω σπερματι αυτου μετ αυτον ουκ οντος αυτω τεκνου
kjv: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.

vulg: locutus est autem Deus quia erit semen eius accola in terra aliena et servituti eos subicient et male tractabunt eos annis quadringentis
clem: Locutus est autem ei Deus: Quia erit semen ejus accola in terra aliena, et servituti eos subjicient, et male tractabunt eos annis quadringentis:
tr: ελαλησεν δε ουτως ο θεος οτι εσται το σπερμα αυτου παροικον εν γη αλλοτρια και δουλωσουσιν αυτο και κακωσουσιν ετη τετρακοσια
kjv: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.

vulg: et gentem cui servierint iudicabo ego dixit Deus et post haec exibunt et deservient mihi in loco isto
clem: et gentem cui servierint, judicabo ego, dixit Dominus: et post hc exibunt, et servient mihi in loco isto.
tr: και το εθνος ω εαν δουλευσωσιν κρινω εγω ειπεν ο θεος και μετα ταυτα εξελευσονται και λατρευσουσιν μοι εν τω τοπω τουτω
kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

vulg: et dedit illi testamentum circumcisionis et sic genuit Isaac et circumcidit eum die octava et Isaac Iacob et Iacob duodecim patriarchas
clem: Et dedit illi testamentum circumcisionis: et sic genuit Isaac, et circumcidit eum die octavo: et Isaac, Jacob: et Jacob, duodecim patriarchas.
tr: και εδωκεν αυτω διαθηκην περιτομης και ουτως εγεννησεν τον ισαακ και περιετεμεν αυτον τη ημερα τη ογδοη και ο ισαακ τον ιακωβ και ο ιακωβ τους δωδεκα πατριαρχας
kjv: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.

vulg: et patriarchae aemulantes Ioseph vendiderunt in Aegyptum et erat Deus cum eo
clem: Et patriarch mulantes, Joseph vendiderunt in gyptum: et erat Deus cum eo,
tr: και οι πατριαρχαι ζηλωσαντες τον ιωσηφ απεδοντο εις αιγυπτον και ην ο θεος μετ αυτου
kjv: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,

vulg: et eripuit eum ex omnibus tribulationibus eius et dedit ei gratiam et sapientiam in conspectu Pharaonis regis Aegypti et constituit eum praepositum super Aegyptum et super omnem domum suam
clem: et eripuit eum ex omnibus tribulationibus ejus, et dedit ei gratiam et sapientiam in conspectu pharaonis regis gypti: et constituit eum prpositum super gyptum, et super omnem domum suam.
tr: και εξειλετο αυτον εκ πασων των θλιψεων αυτου και εδωκεν αυτω χαριν και σοφιαν εναντιον φαραω βασιλεως αιγυπτου και κατεστησεν αυτον ηγουμενον επ αιγυπτον και ολον τον οικον αυτου
kjv: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

vulg: venit autem fames in universam Aegyptum et Chanaan et tribulatio magna et non inveniebant cibos patres nostri
clem: Venit autem fames in universam gyptum et Chanaan, et tribulatio magna: et non inveniebant cibos patres nostri.
tr: ηλθεν δε λιμος εφ ολην την γην αιγυπτου και χανααν και θλιψις μεγαλη και ουχ ευρισκον χορτασματα οι πατερες ημων
kjv: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.

vulg: cum audisset autem Iacob esse frumentum in Aegypto misit patres nostros primum
clem: Cum audisset autem Jacob esse frumentum in gypto, misit patres nostros primum:
tr: ακουσας δε ιακωβ οντα σιτα εν αιγυπτω εξαπεστειλεν τους πατερας ημων πρωτον
kjv: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.

vulg: et in secundo cognitus est Ioseph a fratribus suis et manifestatum est Pharaoni genus eius
clem: et in secundo cognitus est Joseph a fratribus suis, et manifestatum est Pharaoni genus ejus.
tr: και εν τω δευτερω ανεγνωρισθη ιωσηφ τοις αδελφοις αυτου και φανερον εγενετο τω φαραω το γενος του ιωσηφ
kjv: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.

vulg: mittens autem Ioseph accersivit Iacob patrem suum et omnem cognationem in animabus septuaginta quinque
clem: Mittens autem Joseph, accersivit Jacob patrem suum et omnem cognationem suam, in animabus septuaginta quinque.
tr: αποστειλας δε ιωσηφ μετεκαλεσατο τον πατερα αυτου ιακωβ και πασαν την συγγενειαν αυτου εν ψυχαις εβδομηκοντα πεντε
kjv: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.

vulg: et descendit Iacob in Aegyptum et defunctus est ipse et patres nostri
clem: Et descendit Jacob in gyptum: et defunctus est ipse, et patres nostri.
tr: κατεβη δε ιακωβ εις αιγυπτον και ετελευτησεν αυτος και οι πατερες ημων
kjv: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,

vulg: et translati sunt in Sychem et positi sunt in sepulchro quod emit Abraham pretio argenti a filiis Emmor filii Sychem
clem: Et translati sunt in Sichem, et positi sunt in sepulchro, quod emit Abraham pretio argenti a filiis Hemor filii Sichem.
tr: και μετετεθησαν εις συχεμ  σιχεμ  και ετεθησαν εν τω μνηματι ο ωνησατο αβρααμ τιμης αργυριου παρα των υιων εμμορ  εμορ  του συχεμ σιχεμ
kjv: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.

vulg: cum adpropinquaret autem tempus repromissionis quam confessus erat Deus Abrahae crevit populus et multiplicatus est in Aegypto
clem: Cum autem appropinquaret tempus promissionis quam confessus erat Deus Abrah, crevit populus, et multiplicatus est in gypto,
tr: καθως δε ηγγιζεν ο χρονος της επαγγελιας ης ωμοσεν ο θεος τω αβρααμ ηυξησεν ο λαος και επληθυνθη εν αιγυπτω
kjv: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

vulg: quoadusque surrexit rex alius in Aegypto qui non sciebat Ioseph
clem: quoadusque surrexit alius rex in gypto, qui non sciebat Joseph.
tr: αχρις ου ανεστη βασιλευς ετερος ος ουκ ηδει τον ιωσηφ
kjv: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.

vulg: hic circumveniens genus nostrum adflixit patres ut exponerent infantes suos ne vivificarentur
clem: Hic circumveniens genus nostrum, afflixit patres nostros ut exponerent infantes suos, ne vivificarentur.
tr: ουτος κατασοφισαμενος το γενος ημων εκακωσεν τους πατερας ημων του ποιειν εκθετα τα βρεφη αυτων εις το μη ζωογονεισθαι
kjv: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.

vulg: eodem tempore natus est Moses et fuit gratus Deo qui nutritus est tribus mensibus in domo patris sui
clem: Eodem tempore natus est Moyses, et fuit gratus Deo: qui nutritus est tribus mensibus in domo patris sui.
tr: εν ω καιρω εγεννηθη μωσης και ην αστειος τω θεω ος ανετραφη μηνας τρεις εν τω οικω του πατρος αυτου
kjv: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:

vulg: exposito autem illo sustulit eum filia Pharaonis et enutrivit eum sibi in filium
clem: Exposito autem illo, sustulit eum filia Pharaonis, et nutrivit eum sibi in filium.
tr: εκτεθεντα δε αυτον ανειλετο αυτον η θυγατηρ φαραω και ανεθρεψατο αυτον εαυτη εις υιον
kjv: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

vulg: et eruditus est Moses omni sapientia Aegyptiorum et erat potens in verbis et in operibus suis
clem: Et eruditus est Moyses omni sapientia gyptiorum, et erat potens in verbis et in operibus suis.
tr: και επαιδευθη μωσης παση σοφια αιγυπτιων ην δε δυνατος εν λογοις και εν εργοις
kjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.

vulg: cum autem impleretur ei quadraginta annorum tempus ascendit in cor eius ut visitaret fratres suos filios Israhel
clem: Cum autem impleretur ei quadraginta annorum tempus, ascendit in cor ejus ut visitaret fratres suos filios Isral.
tr: ως δε επληρουτο αυτω τεσσαρακονταετης χρονος ανεβη επι την καρδιαν αυτου επισκεψασθαι τους αδελφους αυτου τους υιους ισραηλ
kjv: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.

vulg: et cum vidisset quendam iniuriam patientem vindicavit illum et fecit ultionem ei qui iniuriam sustinebat percusso Aegyptio
clem: Et cum vidisset quemdam injuriam patientem, vindicavit illum, et fecit ultionem ei qui injuriam sustinebat, percusso gyptio.
tr: και ιδων τινα αδικουμενον ημυνατο και εποιησεν εκδικησιν τω καταπονουμενω παταξας τον αιγυπτιον
kjv: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

vulg: existimabat autem intellegere fratres quoniam Deus per manum ipsius daret salutem illis at illi non intellexerunt
clem: Existimabat autem intelligere fratres, quoniam Deus per manum ipsius daret salutem illis: at illi non intellexerunt.
tr: ενομιζεν δε συνιεναι τους αδελφους αυτου οτι ο θεος δια χειρος αυτου διδωσιν αυτοις σωτηριαν οι δε ου συνηκαν
kjv: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

vulg: sequenti vero die apparuit illis litigantibus et reconciliabat eos in pacem dicens viri fratres estis ut quid nocetis alterutrum
clem: Sequenti vero die apparuit illis litigantibus: et reconciliabat eos in pace, dicens: Viri, fratres estis: ut quid nocetis alterutrum?
tr: τη τε  δε  επιουση ημερα ωφθη αυτοις μαχομενοις και συνηλασεν αυτους εις ειρηνην ειπων ανδρες αδελφοι εστε υμεις ινα τι αδικειτε αλληλους
kjv: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?

vulg: qui autem iniuriam faciebat proximo reppulit eum dicens quis te constituit principem et iudicem super nos
clem: Qui autem injuriam faciebat proximo, repulit eum, dicens: Quis te constituit principem et judicem super nos?
tr: ο δε αδικων τον πλησιον απωσατο αυτον ειπων τις σε κατεστησεν αρχοντα και δικαστην εφ ημας
kjv: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?

vulg: numquid interficere me tu vis quemadmodum interfecisti heri Aegyptium
clem: Numquid interficere me tu vis, quemadmodum interfecisti heri gyptium?
tr: μη ανελειν με συ θελεις ον τροπον ανειλες χθες τον αιγυπτιον
kjv: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?

vulg: fugit autem Moses in verbo isto et factus est advena in terra Madiam ubi generavit filios duos
clem: Fugit autem Moyses in verbo isto: et factus est advena in terra Madian, ubi generavit filios duos.
tr: εφυγεν δε μωσης εν τω λογω τουτω και εγενετο παροικος εν γη μαδιαμ ου εγεννησεν υιους δυο
kjv: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.

vulg: et expletis annis quadraginta apparuit illi in deserto montis Sina angelus in igne flammae rubi
clem: Et expletis annis quadraginta, apparuit illi in deserto montis Sina angelus in igne flamm rubi.
tr: και πληρωθεντων ετων τεσσαρακοντα ωφθη αυτω εν τη ερημω του ορους σινα αγγελος κυριου εν φλογι πυρος βατου
kjv: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.

vulg: Moses autem videns admiratus est visum et accedente illo ut consideraret facta est vox Domini
clem: Moyses autem videns, admiratus est visum. Et accedente illo ut consideraret, facta est ad eum vox Domini, dicens:
tr: ο δε μωσης ιδων εθαυμασεν το οραμα προσερχομενου δε αυτου κατανοησαι εγενετο φωνη κυριου προς αυτον
kjv: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,

vulg: ego Deus patrum tuorum Deus Abraham et Deus Isaac et Deus Iacob tremefactus autem Moses non audebat considerare
clem: Ego sum Deus patrum tuorum, Deus Abraham, Deus Isaac, et Deus Jacob. Tremefactus autem Moyses, non audebat considerare.
tr: εγω ο θεος των πατερων σου ο θεος αβρααμ και ο θεος ισαακ και ο θεος ιακωβ εντρομος δε γενομενος μωσης ουκ ετολμα κατανοησαι
kjv: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

vulg: dixit autem illi Dominus solve calciamentum pedum tuorum locus enim in quo stas terra sancta est
clem: Dixit autem illi Dominus: Solve calceamentum pedum tuorum: locus enim in quo stas, terra sancta est.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτω ο κυριος λυσον το υποδημα των ποδων σου ο γαρ τοπος εν ω εστηκας γη αγια εστιν
kjv: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.

vulg: videns vidi adflictionem populi mei qui est in Aegypto et gemitum eorum audivi et descendi liberare eos et nunc veni et mittam te in Aegyptum
clem: Videns vidi afflictionem populi mei qui est in gypto, et gemitum eorum audivi, et descendi liberare eos. Et nunc veni, et mittam te in gyptum.
tr: ιδων ειδον την κακωσιν του λαου μου του εν αιγυπτω και του στεναγμου αυτων ηκουσα και κατεβην εξελεσθαι αυτους και νυν δευρο αποστελω σε εις αιγυπτον
kjv: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.

vulg: hunc Mosen quem negaverunt dicentes quis te constituit principem et iudicem hunc Deus principem et redemptorem misit cum manu angeli qui apparuit illi in rubo
clem: Hunc Moysen, quem negaverunt, dicentes: Quis te constituit principem et judicem? hunc Deus principem et redemptorem misit, cum manu angeli qui apparuit illi in rubo.
tr: τουτον τον μωυσην ον ηρνησαντο ειποντες τις σε κατεστησεν αρχοντα και δικαστην τουτον ο θεος αρχοντα και λυτρωτην απεστειλεν εν χειρι αγγελου του οφθεντος αυτω εν τη βατω
kjv: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

vulg: hic eduxit illos faciens prodigia et signa in terra Aegypti et in Rubro mari et in deserto annis quadraginta
clem: Hic eduxit illos faciens prodigia et signa in terra gypti, et in rubro mari, et in deserto annis quadraginta.
tr: ουτος εξηγαγεν αυτους ποιησας τερατα και σημεια εν γη αιγυπτου και εν ερυθρα θαλασση και εν τη ερημω ετη τεσσαρακοντα
kjv: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.

vulg: hic est Moses qui dixit filiis Israhel prophetam vobis suscitabit Deus de fratribus vestris tamquam me
clem: Hic est Moyses, qui dixit filiis Isral: Prophetam suscitabit vobis Deus de fratribus vestris, tamquam me: ipsum audietis.
tr: ουτος εστιν ο μωυσης ο ειπων τοις υιοις ισραηλ προφητην υμιν αναστησει κυριος ο θεος υμων εκ των αδελφων υμων ως εμε αυτου ακουσεσθε
kjv: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.

vulg: hic est qui fuit in ecclesia in solitudine cum angelo qui loquebatur ei in monte Sina et cum patribus nostris qui accepit verba vitae dare nobis
clem: Hic est qui fuit in ecclesia in solitudine cum angelo, qui loquebatur ei in monte Sina, et cum patribus nostris: qui accepit verba vit dare nobis.
tr: ουτος εστιν ο γενομενος εν τη εκκλησια εν τη ερημω μετα του αγγελου του λαλουντος αυτω εν τω ορει σινα και των πατερων ημων ος εδεξατο λογια ζωντα δουναι ημιν
kjv: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:

vulg: cui noluerunt oboedire patres nostri sed reppulerunt et aversi sunt cordibus suis in Aegyptum
clem: Cui noluerunt obedire patres nostri: sed repulerunt, et aversi sunt cordibus suis in gyptum,
tr: ω ουκ ηθελησαν υπηκοοι γενεσθαι οι πατερες ημων αλλ απωσαντο και εστραφησαν ταις καρδιαις αυτων εις αιγυπτον
kjv: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,

vulg: dicentes ad Aaron fac nobis deos qui praecedant nos Moses enim hic qui eduxit nos de terra Aegypti nescimus quid factum sit ei
clem: dicentes ad Aaron: Fac nobis deos qui prcedant nos: Moyses enim hic, qui eduxit nos de terra gypti, nescimus quid factum sit ei.
tr: ειποντες τω ααρων ποιησον ημιν θεους οι προπορευσονται ημων ο γαρ μωσης ουτος ος εξηγαγεν ημας εκ γης αιγυπτου ουκ οιδαμεν τι γεγονεν αυτω
kjv: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

vulg: et vitulum fecerunt in illis diebus et obtulerunt hostiam simulacro et laetabantur in operibus manuum suarum
clem: Et vitulum fecerunt in diebus illis, et obtulerunt hostiam simulacro, et ltabantur in operibus manuum suarum.
tr: και εμοσχοποιησαν εν ταις ημεραις εκειναις και ανηγαγον θυσιαν τω ειδωλω και ευφραινοντο εν τοις εργοις των χειρων αυτων
kjv: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

vulg: convertit autem Deus et tradidit eos servire militiae caeli sicut scriptum est in libro Prophetarum numquid victimas aut hostias obtulistis mihi annis quadraginta in deserto domus Israhel
clem: Convertit autem Deus, et tradidit eos servire militi cli, sicut scriptum est in libro prophetarum: [Numquid victimas et hostias obtulistis mihi annis quadraginta in deserto, domus Isral?
tr: εστρεψεν δε ο θεος και παρεδωκεν αυτους λατρευειν τη στρατια του ουρανου καθως γεγραπται εν βιβλω των προφητων μη σφαγια και θυσιας προσηνεγκατε μοι ετη τεσσαρακοντα εν τη ερημω οικος ισραηλ
kjv: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?

vulg: et suscepistis tabernaculum Moloch et sidus dei vestri Rempham figuras quas fecistis adorare eas et transferam vos trans Babylonem
clem: Et suscepistis tabernaculum Moloch, et sidus dei vestri Rempham, figuras quas fecistis adorare eas: et transferam vos trans Babylonem.]
tr: και ανελαβετε την σκηνην του μολοχ και το αστρον του θεου υμων ρεμφαν τους τυπους ους εποιησατε προσκυνειν αυτοις και μετοικιω υμας επεκεινα βαβυλωνος
kjv: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

vulg: tabernaculum testimonii fuit patribus nostris in deserto sicut disposuit loquens ad Mosen ut faceret illud secundum formam quam viderat
clem: Tabernaculum testimonii fuit cum patribus nostris in deserto, sicut disposuit illis Deus loquens ad Moysen, ut faceret illud secundum formam quam viderat.
tr: η σκηνη του μαρτυριου ην εν   τοις πατρασιν ημων εν τη ερημω καθως διεταξατο ο λαλων τω μωση ποιησαι αυτην κατα τον τυπον ον εωρακει
kjv: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.

vulg: quod et induxerunt suscipientes patres nostri cum Iesu in possessionem gentium quas expulit Deus a facie patrum nostrorum usque in diebus David
clem: Quod et induxerunt, suscipientes patres nostri cum Jesu in possessionem gentium quas expulit Deus a facie patrum nostrorum, usque in diebus David,
tr: ην και εισηγαγον διαδεξαμενοι οι πατερες ημων μετα ιησου εν τη κατασχεσει των εθνων ων εξωσεν ο θεος απο προσωπου των πατερων ημων εως των ημερων δαβιδ
kjv: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;

vulg: qui invenit gratiam ante Deum et petiit ut inveniret tabernaculum Deo Iacob
clem: qui invenit gratiam ante Deum, et petiit ut inveniret tabernaculum Deo Jacob.
tr: ος ευρεν χαριν ενωπιον του θεου και ητησατο ευρειν σκηνωμα τω θεω ιακωβ
kjv: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

vulg: Salomon autem aedificavit illi domum
clem: Salomon autem dificavit illi domum.
tr: σολομων δε ωκοδομησεν αυτω οικον
kjv: But Solomon built him an house.

vulg: sed non Excelsus in manufactis habitat sicut propheta dicit
clem: Sed non Excelsus in manufactis habitat, sicut propheta dicit:
tr: αλλ ουχ ο υψιστος εν χειροποιητοις ναοις κατοικει καθως ο προφητης λεγει
kjv: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,

vulg: caelum mihi sedis est terra autem scabillum pedum meorum quam domum aedificabitis mihi dicit Dominus aut quis locus requietionis meae est
clem: [Clum mihi sedes est: terra autem scabellum pedum meorum. Quam domum dificabitis mihi? dicit Dominus: aut quis locus requietionis me est?
tr: ο ουρανος μοι θρονος η δε γη υποποδιον των ποδων μου ποιον οικον οικοδομησετε μοι λεγει κυριος η τις τοπος της καταπαυσεως μου
kjv: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?

vulg: nonne manus mea fecit haec omnia
clem: Nonne manus mea fecit hc omnia?]
tr: ουχι η χειρ μου εποιησεν ταυτα παντα
kjv: Hath not my hand made all these things?

vulg: dura cervice et incircumcisi cordibus et auribus vos semper Spiritui Sancto resistitis sicut patres vestri et vos
clem: Dura cervice, et incircumcisis cordibus et auribus, vos semper Spiritui Sancto resistitis: sicut patres vestri, ita et vos.
tr: σκληροτραχηλοι και απεριτμητοι τη καρδια και τοις ωσιν υμεις αει τω πνευματι τω αγιω αντιπιπτετε ως οι πατερες υμων και υμεις
kjv: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.

vulg: quem prophetarum non sunt persecuti patres vestri et occiderunt eos qui praenuntiabant de adventu Iusti cuius vos nunc proditores et homicidae fuistis
clem: Quem prophetarum non sunt persecuti patres vestri? et occiderunt eos qui prnuntiabant de adventu Justi, cujus vos nunc proditores et homicid fuistis:
tr: τινα των προφητων ουκ εδιωξαν οι πατερες υμων και απεκτειναν τους προκαταγγειλαντας περι της ελευσεως του δικαιου ου νυν υμεις προδοται και φονεις γεγενησθε
kjv: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:

vulg: qui accepistis legem in dispositionem angelorum et non custodistis
clem: qui accepistis legem in dispositione angelorum, et non custodistis.
tr: οιτινες ελαβετε τον νομον εις διαταγας αγγελων και ουκ εφυλαξατε
kjv: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.

vulg: audientes autem haec dissecabantur cordibus suis et stridebant dentibus in eum
clem: Audientes autem hc, dissecabantur cordibus suis, et stridebant dentibus in eum.
tr: ακουοντες δε ταυτα διεπριοντο ταις καρδιαις αυτων και εβρυχον τους οδοντας επ αυτον
kjv: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.

vulg: cum autem esset plenus Spiritu Sancto intendens in caelum vidit gloriam Dei et Iesum stantem a dextris Dei et ait ecce video caelos apertos et Filium hominis a dextris stantem Dei
clem: Cum autem esset plenus Spiritu Sancto, intendens in clum, vidit gloriam Dei, et Jesum stantem a dextris Dei. Et ait: Ecce video clos apertos, et Filium hominis stantem a dextris Dei.
tr: υπαρχων δε πληρης πνευματος αγιου ατενισας εις τον ουρανον ειδεν δοξαν θεου και ιησουν εστωτα εκ δεξιων του θεου
kjv: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

vulg: exclamantes autem voce magna continuerunt aures suas et impetum fecerunt unianimiter in eum
clem: Exclamantes autem voce magna continuerunt aures suas, et impetum fecerunt unanimiter in eum.
tr: και ειπεν ιδου θεωρω τους ουρανους ανεωγμενους και τον υιον του ανθρωπου εκ δεξιων εστωτα του θεου
kjv: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

vulg: et eicientes eum extra civitatem lapidabant et testes deposuerunt vestimenta sua secus pedes adulescentis qui vocabatur Saulus
clem: Et ejicientes eum extra civitatem, lapidabant: et testes deposuerunt vestimenta sua secus pedes adolescentis qui vocabatur Saulus.
tr: κραξαντες δε φωνη μεγαλη συνεσχον τα ωτα αυτων και ωρμησαν ομοθυμαδον επ αυτον
kjv: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,

vulg: et lapidabant Stephanum invocantem et dicentem Domine Iesu suscipe spiritum meum
clem: Et lapidabant Stephanum invocantem, et dicentem: Domine Jesu, suscipe spiritum meum.
tr: και εκβαλοντες εξω της πολεως ελιθοβολουν και οι μαρτυρες απεθεντο τα ιματια αυτων παρα τους ποδας νεανιου καλουμενου σαυλου
kjv: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.

vulg: positis autem genibus clamavit voce magna Domine ne statuas illis hoc peccatum et cum hoc dixisset obdormivit Saulus autem erat consentiens neci eius
clem: Positis autem genibus, clamavit voce magna, dicens: Domine, ne statuas illis hoc peccatum. Et cum hoc dixisset, obdormivit in Domino. Saulus autem erat consentiens neci ejus.
tr: και ελιθοβολουν τον στεφανον επικαλουμενον και λεγοντα κυριε ιησου δεξαι το πνευμα μου
kjv: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

tr: θεις δε τα γονατα εκραξεν φωνη μεγαλη κυριε μη στησης αυτοις την αμαρτιαν ταυτην και τουτο ειπων εκοιμηθη
kjv: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

vulg: facta est autem in illa die persecutio magna in ecclesia quae erat Hierosolymis et omnes dispersi sunt per regiones Iudaeae et Samariae praeter apostolos
clem: Facta est autem in illa die persecutio magna in ecclesia qu erat Jerosolymis, et omnes dispersi sunt per regiones Jud et Samari prter Apostolos.
tr: σαυλος δε ην συνευδοκων τη αναιρεσει αυτου εγενετο δε εν εκεινη τη ημερα διωγμος μεγας επι την εκκλησιαν την εν ιεροσολυμοις παντες τε διεσπαρησαν κατα τας χωρας της ιουδαιας και σαμαρειας πλην των αποστολων
kjv: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.

vulg: curaverunt autem Stephanum viri timorati et fecerunt planctum magnum super illum
clem: Curaverunt autem Stephanum viri timorati, et fecerunt planctum magnum super eum.
tr: συνεκομισαν δε τον στεφανον ανδρες ευλαβεις και εποιησαντο κοπετον μεγαν επ αυτω
kjv: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.

vulg: Saulus vero devastabat ecclesiam per domos intrans et trahens viros ac mulieres tradebat in custodiam
clem: Saulus autem devastabat ecclesiam per domos intrans, et trahens viros ac mulieres, tradebat in custodiam.
tr: σαυλος δε ελυμαινετο την εκκλησιαν κατα τους οικους εισπορευομενος συρων τε ανδρας και γυναικας παρεδιδου εις φυλακην
kjv: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

vulg: igitur qui dispersi erant pertransiebant evangelizantes verbum
clem: Igitur qui dispersi erant pertransibant, evangelizantes verbum Dei.
tr: οι μεν ουν διασπαρεντες διηλθον ευαγγελιζομενοι τον λογον
kjv: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.

vulg: Philippus autem descendens in civitatem Samariae praedicabat illis Christum
clem: Philippus autem descendens in civitatem Samari, prdicabant illis Christum.
tr: φιλιππος δε κατελθων εις πολιν της σαμαρειας εκηρυσσεν αυτοις τον χριστον
kjv: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.

vulg: intendebant autem turbae his quae a Philippo dicebantur unianimiter audientes et videntes signa quae faciebat
clem: Intendebant autem turb his qu a Philippo dicebantur, unanimiter audientes, et videntes signa qu faciebat.
tr: προσειχον τε οι οχλοι τοις λεγομενοις υπο του φιλιππου ομοθυμαδον εν τω ακουειν αυτους και βλεπειν τα σημεια α εποιει
kjv: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.

vulg: multi enim eorum qui habebant spiritus inmundos clamantes voce magna exiebant multi autem paralytici et claudi curati sunt
clem: Multi enim eorum qui habebant spiritus immundos, clamantes voce magna exibant. Multi autem paralytici et claudi curati sunt.
tr: πολλων γαρ των εχοντων πνευματα ακαθαρτα βοωντα μεγαλη φωνη εξηρχετο πολλοι δε παραλελυμενοι και χωλοι εθεραπευθησαν
kjv: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.

vulg: factum est ergo magnum gaudium in illa civitate
clem: Factum est ergo gaudium magnum in illa civitate.
tr: και εγενετο χαρα μεγαλη εν τη πολει εκεινη
kjv: And there was great joy in that city.

vulg: vir autem quidam nomine Simon qui ante fuerat in civitate magus seducens gentem Samariae dicens esse se aliquem magnum
clem: Vir autem quidam nomine Simon, qui ante fuerat in civitate magnus, seducens gentem Samari, dicens se esse aliquem magnum:
tr: ανηρ δε τις ονοματι σιμων προυπηρχεν εν τη πολει μαγευων και εξιστων το εθνος της σαμαρειας λεγων ειναι τινα εαυτον μεγαν
kjv: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:

vulg: cui auscultabant omnes a minimo usque ad maximum dicentes hic est virtus Dei quae vocatur Magna
clem: cui auscultabant omnes a minimo usque ad maximum, dicentes: Hic est virtus Dei, qu vocatur magna.
tr: ω προσειχον παντες απο μικρου εως μεγαλου λεγοντες ουτος εστιν η δυναμις του θεου η μεγαλη
kjv: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

vulg: adtendebant autem eum propter quod multo tempore magicis suis dementasset eos
clem: Attendebant autem eum: propter quod multo tempore magiis suis dementasset eos.
tr: προσειχον δε αυτω δια το ικανω χρονω ταις μαγειαις εξεστακεναι αυτους
kjv: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.

vulg: cum vero credidissent Philippo evangelizanti de regno Dei et nomine Iesu Christi baptizabantur viri ac mulieres
clem: Cum vero credidissent Philippo evangelizanti de regno Dei, in nomine Jesu Christi baptizabantur viri ac mulieres.
tr: οτε δε επιστευσαν τω φιλιππω ευαγγελιζομενω τα περι της βασιλειας του θεου και του ονοματος του ιησου χριστου εβαπτιζοντο ανδρες τε και γυναικες
kjv: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

vulg: tunc Simon et ipse credidit et cum baptizatus esset adherebat Philippo videns etiam signa et virtutes maximas fieri stupens admirabatur
clem: Tunc Simon et ipse credidit: et cum baptizatus esset, adhrebat Philippo. Videns etiam signa et virtutes maximas fieri, stupens admirabatur.
tr: ο δε σιμων και αυτος επιστευσεν και βαπτισθεις ην προσκαρτερων τω φιλιππω θεωρων τε σημεια και δυναμεις μεγαλας γινομενας  δυναμεις και σημεια γινομενα  εξιστατο
kjv: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.

vulg: cum autem audissent apostoli qui erant Hierosolymis quia recepit Samaria verbum Dei miserunt ad illos Petrum et Iohannem
clem: Cum autem audissent Apostoli qui erant Jerosolymis, quod recepisset Samaria verbum Dei, miserunt ad eos Petrum et Joannem.
tr: ακουσαντες δε οι εν ιεροσολυμοις αποστολοι οτι δεδεκται η σαμαρεια τον λογον του θεου απεστειλαν προς αυτους τον πετρον και ιωαννην
kjv: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:

vulg: qui cum venissent oraverunt pro ipsis ut acciperent Spiritum Sanctum
clem: Qui cum venissent, oraverunt pro ipsis ut acciperent Spiritum Sanctum:
tr: οιτινες καταβαντες προσηυξαντο περι αυτων οπως λαβωσιν πνευμα αγιον
kjv: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:

vulg: nondum enim in quemquam illorum venerat sed baptizati tantum erant in nomine Domini Iesu
clem: nondum enim in quemquam illorum venerat, sed baptizati tantum erant in nomine Domini Jesu.
tr: ουπω γαρ ην επ ουδενι αυτων επιπεπτωκος μονον δε βεβαπτισμενοι υπηρχον εις το ονομα του κυριου ιησου
kjv: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)

vulg: tunc inponebant manus super illos et accipiebant Spiritum Sanctum
clem: Tunc imponebant manus super illos, et accipiebant Spiritum Sanctum.
tr: τοτε επετιθουν τας χειρας επ αυτους και ελαμβανον πνευμα αγιον
kjv: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.

vulg: cum vidisset autem Simon quia per inpositionem manus apostolorum daretur Spiritus Sanctus obtulit eis pecuniam
clem: Cum vidisset autem Simon quia per impositionem manus Apostolorum daretur Spiritus Sanctus, obtulit eis pecuniam,
tr: θεασαμενος δε ο σιμων οτι δια της επιθεσεως των χειρων των αποστολων διδοται το πνευμα το αγιον προσηνεγκεν αυτοις χρηματα
kjv: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,

vulg: dicens date et mihi hanc potestatem ut cuicumque inposuero manus accipiat Spiritum Sanctum Petrus autem dixit ad eum
clem: dicens: Date et mihi hanc potestatem, ut cuicumque imposuero manus, accipiat Spiritum Sanctum. Petrus autem dixit ad eum:
tr: λεγων δοτε καμοι την εξουσιαν ταυτην ινα ω αν  εαν  επιθω τας χειρας λαμβανη πνευμα αγιον
kjv: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

vulg: pecunia tua tecum sit in perditionem quoniam donum Dei existimasti pecunia possideri
clem: Pecunia tua tecum sit in perditionem: quoniam donum Dei existimasti pecunia possideri.
tr: πετρος δε ειπεν προς αυτον το αργυριον σου συν σοι ειη εις απωλειαν οτι την δωρεαν του θεου ενομισας δια χρηματων κτασθαι
kjv: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.

vulg: non est tibi pars neque sors in sermone isto cor enim tuum non est rectum coram Deo
clem: Non est tibi pars neque sors in sermone isto: cor enim tuum non est rectum coram Deo.
tr: ουκ εστιν σοι μερις ουδε κληρος εν τω λογω τουτω η γαρ καρδια σου ουκ εστιν ευθεια ενωπιον του θεου
kjv: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.

vulg: paenitentiam itaque age ab hac nequitia tua et roga Deum si forte remittatur tibi haec cogitatio cordis tui
clem: Pnitentiam itaque age ab hac nequitia tua: et roga Deum, si forte remittatur tibi hc cogitatio cordis tui.
tr: μετανοησον ουν απο της κακιας σου ταυτης και δεηθητι του θεου ει αρα αφεθησεται σοι η επινοια της καρδιας σου
kjv: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.

vulg: in felle enim amaritudinis et obligatione iniquitatis video te esse
clem: In felle enim amaritudinis, et obligatione iniquitatis, video te esse.
tr: εις γαρ χολην πικριας και συνδεσμον αδικιας ορω σε οντα
kjv: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.

vulg: respondens autem Simon dixit precamini vos pro me ad Dominum ut nihil veniat super me horum quae dixistis
clem: Respondens autem Simon, dixit: Precamini vos pro me ad Dominum, ut nihil veniat super me horum qu dixistis.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο σιμων ειπεν δεηθητε υμεις υπερ εμου προς τον κυριον οπως μηδεν επελθη επ εμε ων ειρηκατε
kjv: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.

vulg: et illi quidem testificati et locuti verbum Domini rediebant Hierosolymam et multis regionibus Samaritanorum evangelizabant
clem: Et illi quidem testificati, et locuti verbum Domini, redibant Jerosolymam, et multis regionibus Samaritanorum evangelizabant.
tr: οι μεν ουν διαμαρτυραμενοι και λαλησαντες τον λογον του κυριου υπεστρεψαν εις ιερουσαλημ πολλας τε κωμας των σαμαρειτων ευηγγελισαντο
kjv: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.

vulg: angelus autem Domini locutus est ad Philippum dicens surge et vade contra meridianum ad viam quae descendit ab Hierusalem in Gazam haec est deserta
clem: Angelus autem Domini locutus est ad Philippum, dicens: Surge, et vade contra meridianum, ad viam qu descendit ab Jerusalem in Gazam: hc est deserta.
tr: αγγελος δε κυριου ελαλησεν προς φιλιππον λεγων αναστηθι και πορευου κατα μεσημβριαν επι την οδον την καταβαινουσαν απο ιερουσαλημ εις γαζαν αυτη εστιν ερημος
kjv: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.

vulg: et surgens abiit et ecce vir aethiops eunuchus potens Candacis reginae Aethiopum qui erat super omnes gazas eius venerat adorare in Hierusalem
clem: Et surgens abiit. Et ecce vir thiops, eunuchus, potens Candacis regin thiopum, qui erat super omnes gazas ejus, venerat adorare in Jerusalem:
tr: και αναστας επορευθη και ιδου ανηρ αιθιοψ ευνουχος δυναστης κανδακης της βασιλισσης αιθιοπων ος ην επι πασης της γαζης αυτης ος εληλυθει προσκυνησων εις ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,

vulg: et revertebatur sedens super currum suum legensque prophetam Esaiam
clem: et revertebatur sedens super currum suum, legensque Isaiam prophetam.
tr: ην τε υποστρεφων και καθημενος επι του αρματος αυτου και   ανεγινωσκεν τον προφητην ησαιαν
kjv: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.

vulg: dixit autem Spiritus Philippo accede et adiunge te ad currum istum
clem: Dixit autem Spiritus Philippo: Accede, et adjunge te ad currum istum.
tr: ειπεν δε το πνευμα τω φιλιππω προσελθε και κολληθητι τω αρματι τουτω
kjv: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.

vulg: adcurrens autem Philippus audivit illum legentem Esaiam prophetam et dixit putasne intellegis quae legis
clem: Accurrens autem Philippus, audivit eum legentem Isaiam prophetam, et dixit: Putasne intelligis qu legis?
tr: προσδραμων δε ο φιλιππος ηκουσεν αυτου αναγινωσκοντος τον προφητην ησαιαν και ειπεν αρα γε γινωσκεις α αναγινωσκεις
kjv: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?

vulg: qui ait et quomodo possum si non aliquis ostenderit mihi rogavitque Philippum ut ascenderet et sederet secum
clem: Qui ait: Et quomodo possum, si non aliquis ostenderit mihi? Rogavitque Philippum ut ascenderet, et sederet secum.
tr: ο δε ειπεν πως γαρ αν δυναιμην εαν μη τις οδηγηση με παρεκαλεσεν τε τον φιλιππον αναβαντα καθισαι συν αυτω
kjv: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.

vulg: locus autem scripturae quam legebat erat hic tamquam ovis ad occisionem ductus est et sicut agnus coram tondente se sine voce sic non aperuit os suum
clem: Locus autem Scriptur quem legebat, erat hic: [Tamquam ovis ad occisionem ductus est: et sicus agnus coram tondente se, sine voce, sic non aperuit os suum.
tr: η δε περιοχη της γραφης ην ανεγινωσκεν ην αυτη ως προβατον επι σφαγην ηχθη και ως αμνος εναντιον του κειροντος αυτον αφωνος ουτως ουκ ανοιγει το στομα αυτου
kjv: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:

vulg: in humilitate iudicium eius sublatum est generationem illius quis enarrabit quoniam tollitur de terra vita eius
clem: In humilitate judicium ejus sublatum est. Generationem ejus quis enarrabit? quoniam tolletur de terra vita ejus.]
tr: εν τη ταπεινωσει αυτου η κρισις αυτου ηρθη την δε γενεαν αυτου τις διηγησεται οτι αιρεται απο της γης η ζωη αυτου
kjv: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.

vulg: respondens autem eunuchus Philippo dixit obsecro te de quo propheta dicit hoc de se an de alio aliquo
clem: Respondens autem eunuchus Philippo, dixit: Obsecro te, de quo propheta dicit hoc? de se, an de alio aliquo?
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ευνουχος τω φιλιππω ειπεν δεομαι σου περι τινος ο προφητης λεγει τουτο περι εαυτου η περι ετερου τινος
kjv: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?

vulg: aperiens autem Philippus os suum et incipiens ab scriptura ista evangelizavit illi Iesum
clem: Aperiens autem Philippus os suum, et incipiens a Scriptura ista, evangelizavit illi Jesum.
tr: ανοιξας δε ο φιλιππος το στομα αυτου και αρξαμενος απο της γραφης ταυτης ευηγγελισατο αυτω τον ιησουν
kjv: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.

vulg: et dum irent per viam venerunt ad quandam aquam et ait eunuchus ecce aqua quid prohibet me baptizari
clem: Et dum irent per viam, venerunt ad quamdam aquam: et ait eunuchus: Ecce aqua: quid prohibet me baptizari?
tr: ως δε επορευοντο κατα την οδον ηλθον επι τι υδωρ και φησιν ο ευνουχος ιδου υδωρ τι κωλυει με βαπτισθηναι
kjv: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?

clem: Dixit autem Philippus: Si credis ex toto corde, licet. Et respondens ait: Credo Filium Dei esse Jesum Christum.
tr: ειπεν δε ο φιλιππος ει πιστευεις εξ ολης της καρδιας εξεστιν αποκριθεις δε ειπεν πιστευω τον υιον του θεου ειναι τον ιησουν χριστον
kjv: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.

vulg: et iussit stare currum et descenderunt uterque in aquam Philippus et eunuchus et baptizavit eum
clem: Et jussit stare currum: et descenderunt uterque in aquam, Philippus et eunuchus, et baptizavit eum.
tr: και εκελευσεν στηναι το αρμα και κατεβησαν αμφοτεροι εις το υδωρ ο τε φιλιππος και ο ευνουχος και εβαπτισεν αυτον
kjv: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.

vulg: cum autem ascendissent de aqua Spiritus Domini rapuit Philippum et amplius non vidit eum eunuchus ibat enim per viam suam gaudens
clem: Cum autem ascendissent de aqua, Spiritus Domini rapuit Philippum, et amplius non vidit eum eunuchus. Ibat autem per viam suam gaudens.
tr: οτε δε ανεβησαν εκ του υδατος πνευμα κυριου ηρπασεν τον φιλιππον και ουκ ειδεν αυτον ουκετι ο ευνουχος επορευετο γαρ την οδον αυτου χαιρων
kjv: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.

vulg: Philippus autem inventus est in Azoto et pertransiens evangelizabat civitatibus cunctis donec veniret Caesaream
clem: Philippus autem inventus est in Azoto, et pertransiens evangelizabat civitatibus cunctis, donec veniret Csaream.
tr: φιλιππος δε ευρεθη εις αζωτον και διερχομενος ευηγγελιζετο τας πολεις πασας εως του ελθειν αυτον εις καισαρειαν
kjv: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.

vulg: Saulus autem adhuc inspirans minarum et caedis in discipulos Domini accessit ad principem sacerdotum
clem: Saulus autem adhuc spirans minarum et cdis in discipulos Domini, accessit ad principem sacerdotum,
tr: ο δε σαυλος ετι εμπνεων απειλης και φονου εις τους μαθητας του κυριου προσελθων τω αρχιερει
kjv: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,

vulg: et petiit ab eo epistulas in Damascum ad synagogas ut si quos invenisset huius viae viros ac mulieres vinctos perduceret in Hierusalem
clem: et petiit ab eo epistolas in Damascum ad synagogas: ut si quos invenisset hujus vi viros ac mulieres, vinctos perduceret in Jerusalem.
tr: ητησατο παρ αυτου επιστολας εις δαμασκον προς τας συναγωγας οπως εαν τινας ευρη της οδου οντας ανδρας τε και γυναικας δεδεμενους αγαγη εις ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.

vulg: et cum iter faceret contigit ut adpropinquaret Damasco et subito circumfulsit eum lux de caelo
clem: Et cum iter faceret, contigit ut appropinquaret Damasco: et subito circumfulsit eum lux de clo.
tr: εν δε τω πορευεσθαι εγενετο αυτον εγγιζειν τη δαμασκω και εξαιφνης περιηστραψεν αυτον φως απο του ουρανου
kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:

vulg: et cadens in terram audivit vocem dicentem sibi Saule Saule quid me persequeris
clem: Et cadens in terram audivit vocem dicentem sibi: Saule, Saule, quid me persequeris?
tr: και πεσων επι την γην ηκουσεν φωνην λεγουσαν αυτω σαουλ σαουλ τι με διωκεις
kjv: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

vulg: qui dixit quis es Domine et ille ego sum Iesus quem tu persequeris
clem: Qui dixit: Quis es, domine? Et ille: Ego sum Jesus, quem tu persequeris: durum est tibi contra stimulum calcitrare.
tr: ειπεν δε τις ει κυριε ο δε κυριος ειπεν εγω ειμι ιησους ον συ διωκεις σκληρον σοι προς κεντρα λακτιζειν
kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

clem: Et tremens ac stupens dixit: Domine, quid me vis facere?
tr: τρεμων τε και θαμβων ειπεν κυριε τι με θελεις ποιησαι και ο κυριος προς αυτον αναστηθι και εισελθε εις την πολιν και λαληθησεται σοι τι σε δει ποιειν
kjv: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

vulg: sed surge et ingredere civitatem et dicetur tibi quid te oporteat facere viri autem illi qui comitabantur cum eo stabant stupefacti audientes quidem vocem neminem autem videntes
clem: Et Dominus ad eum: Surge, et ingredere civitatem, et ibi dicetur tibi quid te oporteat facere. Viri autem illi qui comitabantur cum eo, stabant stupefacti, audientes quidem vocem, neminem autem videntes.
tr: οι δε ανδρες οι συνοδευοντες αυτω ειστηκεισαν εννεοι ακουοντες μεν της φωνης μηδενα δε θεωρουντες
kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.

vulg: surrexit autem Saulus de terra apertisque oculis nihil videbat ad manus autem illum trahentes introduxerunt Damascum
clem: Surrexit autem Saulus de terra, apertisque oculis nihil videbat. Ad manus autem illum trahentes, introduxerunt Damascum.
tr: ηγερθη δε ο σαυλος απο της γης ανεωγμενων δε των οφθαλμων αυτου ουδενα εβλεπεν χειραγωγουντες δε αυτον εισηγαγον εις δαμασκον
kjv: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

vulg: et erat tribus diebus non videns et non manducavit neque bibit
clem: Et erat ibi tribus diebus non videns, et non manducavit, neque bibit.
tr: και ην ημερας τρεις μη βλεπων και ουκ εφαγεν ουδε επιεν
kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

vulg: erat autem quidam discipulus Damasci nomine Ananias et dixit ad illum in visu Dominus Anania at ille ait ecce ego Domine
clem: Erat autem quidam discipulus Damasci, nomine Ananias: et dixit ad illum in visu Dominus: Anania. At ille ait: Ecce ego, Domine.
tr: ην δε τις μαθητης εν δαμασκω ονοματι ανανιας και ειπεν προς αυτον ο κυριος εν οραματι ανανια ο δε ειπεν ιδου εγω κυριε
kjv: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.

vulg: et Dominus ad illum surgens vade in vicum qui vocatur Rectus et quaere in domo Iudae Saulum nomine Tarsensem ecce enim orat
clem: Et Dominus ad eum: Surge, et vade in vicum qui vocatur Rectus: et qure in domo Jud Saulum nomine Tarsensem: ecce enim orat.
tr: ο δε κυριος προς αυτον αναστας πορευθητι επι την ρυμην την καλουμενην ευθειαν και ζητησον εν οικια ιουδα σαυλον ονοματι ταρσεα ιδου γαρ προσευχεται
kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

vulg: et vidit virum Ananiam nomine introeuntem et inponentem sibi manus ut visum recipiat
clem: (Et vidit virum Ananiam nomine, intrountem, et imponentem sibi manus ut visum recipiat.)
tr: και ειδεν εν οραματι ανδρα ονοματι ανανιαν εισελθοντα και επιθεντα αυτω χειρα οπως αναβλεψη
kjv: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

vulg: respondit autem Ananias Domine audivi a multis de viro hoc quanta mala sanctis tuis fecerit in Hierusalem
clem: Respondit autem Ananias: Domine, audivi a multis de viro hoc, quanta mala fecerit sanctis tuis in Jerusalem:
tr: απεκριθη δε ο ανανιας κυριε ακηκοα απο πολλων περι του ανδρος τουτου οσα κακα εποιησεν τοις αγιοις σου εν ιερουσαλημ
kjv: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:

vulg: et hic habet potestatem a principibus sacerdotum alligandi omnes qui invocant nomen tuum
clem: et hic habet potestatem a principibus sacerdotum alligandi omnes qui invocant nomen tuum.
tr: και ωδε εχει εξουσιαν παρα των αρχιερεων δησαι παντας τους επικαλουμενους το ονομα σου
kjv: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.

vulg: dixit autem ad eum Dominus vade quoniam vas electionis est mihi iste ut portet nomen meum coram gentibus et regibus et filiis Israhel
clem: Dixit autem ad eum Dominus: Vade, quoniam vas electionis est mihi iste, ut portet nomen meum coram gentibus, et regibus, et filiis Isral.
tr: ειπεν δε προς αυτον ο κυριος πορευου οτι σκευος εκλογης μοι εστιν ουτος του βαστασαι το ονομα μου ενωπιον εθνων και βασιλεων υιων τε ισραηλ
kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

vulg: ego enim ostendam illi quanta oporteat eum pro nomine meo pati
clem: Ego enim ostendam illi quanta oporteat eum pro nomine meo pati.
tr: εγω γαρ υποδειξω αυτω οσα δει αυτον υπερ του ονοματος μου παθειν
kjv: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.

vulg: et abiit Ananias et introivit in domum et inponens ei manus dixit Saule frater Dominus misit me Iesus qui apparuit tibi in via qua veniebas ut videas et implearis Spiritu Sancto
clem: Et abiit Ananias, et introivit in domum: et imponens ei manus, dixit: Saule frater, Dominus misit me Jesus, qui apparuit tibi in via qua veniebas, ut videas, et implearis Spiritu Sancto.
tr: απηλθεν δε ανανιας και εισηλθεν εις την οικιαν και επιθεις επ αυτον τας χειρας ειπεν σαουλ αδελφε ο κυριος απεσταλκεν με ιησους ο οφθεις σοι εν τη οδω η ηρχου οπως αναβλεψης και πλησθης πνευματος αγιου
kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

vulg: et confestim ceciderunt ab oculis eius tamquam squamae et visum recepit et surgens baptizatus est
clem: Et confestim ceciderunt ab oculis ejus tamquam squam, et visum recepit: et surgens baptizatus est.
tr: και ευθεως απεπεσον απο των οφθαλμων αυτου ωσει λεπιδες ανεβλεψεν τε παραχρημα και αναστας εβαπτισθη
kjv: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.

vulg: et cum accepisset cibum confortatus est fuit autem cum discipulis qui erant Damasci per dies aliquot
clem: Et cum accepisset cibum, confortatus est. Fuit autem cum discipulis qui erant Damasci per dies aliquot.
tr: και λαβων τροφην ενισχυσεν εγενετο δε ο σαυλος μετα των εν δαμασκω μαθητων ημερας τινας
kjv: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.

vulg: et continuo in synagogis praedicabat Iesum quoniam hic est Filius Dei
clem: Et continuo in synagogis prdicabat Jesum, quoniam hic est Filius Dei.
tr: και ευθεως εν ταις συναγωγαις εκηρυσσεν τον χριστον οτι ουτος εστιν ο υιος του θεου
kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

vulg: stupebant autem omnes qui audiebant et dicebant nonne hic est qui expugnabat in Hierusalem eos qui invocabant nomen istud et huc ad hoc venit ut vinctos illos duceret ad principes sacerdotum
clem: Stupebant autem omnes qui audiebant, et dicebant: Nonne hic est qui expugnabat in Jerusalem eos qui invocabant nomen istud: et huc ad hoc venit, ut vinctos illos duceret ad principes sacerdotum?
tr: εξισταντο δε παντες οι ακουοντες και ελεγον ουχ ουτος εστιν ο πορθησας εν ιερουσαλημ τους επικαλουμενους το ονομα τουτο και ωδε εις τουτο εληλυθει ινα δεδεμενους αυτους αγαγη επι τους αρχιερεις
kjv: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?

vulg: Saulus autem magis convalescebat et confundebat Iudaeos qui habitabant Damasci adfirmans quoniam hic est Christus
clem: Saulus autem multo magis convalescebat, et confundebat Judos qui habitabant Damasci, affirmans quoniam hic est Christus.
tr: σαυλος δε μαλλον ενεδυναμουτο και συνεχυνεν τους ιουδαιους τους κατοικουντας εν δαμασκω συμβιβαζων οτι ουτος εστιν ο χριστος
kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.

vulg: cum implerentur autem dies multi consilium fecerunt Iudaei ut eum interficerent
clem: Cum autem implerentur dies multi, consilium fecerunt in unum Judi ut eum interficerent.
tr: ως δε επληρουντο ημεραι ικαναι συνεβουλευσαντο οι ιουδαιοι ανελειν αυτον
kjv: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:

vulg: notae autem factae sunt Saulo insidiae eorum custodiebant autem et portas die ac nocte ut eum interficerent
clem: Not autem fact sunt Saulo insidi eorum. Custodiebant autem et portas die ac nocte, ut eum interficerent.
tr: εγνωσθη δε τω σαυλω η επιβουλη αυτων παρετηρουν τε τας πυλας ημερας τε και νυκτος οπως αυτον ανελωσιν
kjv: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.

vulg: accipientes autem discipuli eius nocte per murum dimiserunt eum submittentes in sporta
clem: Accipientes autem eum discipuli nocte, per murum dimiserunt eum, submittentes in sporta.
tr: λαβοντες δε αυτον οι μαθηται νυκτος καθηκαν δια του τειχους χαλασαντες εν σπυριδι
kjv: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.

vulg: cum autem venisset in Hierusalem temptabat iungere se discipulis et omnes timebant eum non credentes quia esset discipulus
clem: Cum autem venisset in Jerusalem, tentabat se jungere discipulis, et omnes timebant eum, non credentes quod esset discipulus.
tr: παραγενομενος δε ο σαυλος εις ιερουσαλημ επειρατο κολλασθαι τοις μαθηταις και παντες εφοβουντο αυτον μη πιστευοντες οτι εστιν μαθητης
kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

vulg: Barnabas autem adprehensum illum duxit ad apostolos et narravit illis quomodo in via vidisset Dominum et quia locutus est ei et quomodo in Damasco fiducialiter egerit in nomine Iesu
clem: Barnabas autem apprehensum illum duxit ad Apostolos: et narravit illis quomodo in via vidisset Dominum, et quia locutus est ei, et quomodo in Damasco fiducialiter egerit in nomine Jesu.
tr: βαρναβας δε επιλαβομενος αυτον ηγαγεν προς τους αποστολους και διηγησατο αυτοις πως εν τη οδω ειδεν τον κυριον και οτι ελαλησεν αυτω και πως εν δαμασκω επαρρησιασατο εν τω ονοματι του ιησου
kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

vulg: et erat cum illis intrans et exiens in Hierusalem et fiducialiter agens in nomine Domini
clem: Et erat cum illis intrans et exiens in Jerusalem, et fiducialiter agens in nomine Domini.
tr: και ην μετ αυτων εισπορευομενος και εκπορευομενος εν ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

vulg: loquebatur quoque et disputabat cum Graecis illi autem quaerebant occidere eum
clem: Loquebatur quoque gentibus, et disputabat cum Grcis: illi autem qurebant occidere eum.
tr: και παρρησιαζομενος εν τω ονοματι του κυριου ιησου (9:29) ελαλει τε και συνεζητει προς τους ελληνιστας οι δε επεχειρουν αυτον ανελειν
kjv: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.

vulg: quod cum cognovissent fratres deduxerunt eum Caesaream et dimiserunt Tarsum
clem: Quod cum cognovissent fratres, deduxerunt eum Csaream, et dimiserunt Tarsum.
tr: επιγνοντες δε οι αδελφοι κατηγαγον αυτον εις καισαρειαν και εξαπεστειλαν αυτον εις ταρσον
kjv: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

vulg: ecclesia quidem per totam Iudaeam et Galilaeam et Samariam habebat pacem et aedificabatur ambulans in timore Domini et consolatione Sancti Spiritus replebatur
clem: Ecclesia quidem per totam Judam, et Galilam, et Samariam habebat pacem, et dificabatur ambulans in timore Domini, et consolatione Sancti Spiritus replebatur.
tr: αι μεν ουν εκκλησιαι καθ ολης της ιουδαιας και γαλιλαιας και σαμαρειας ειχον ειρηνην οικοδομουμεναι και πορευομεναι τω φοβω του κυριου και τη παρακλησει του αγιου πνευματος επληθυνοντο
kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

vulg: factum est autem Petrum dum pertransiret universos devenire et ad sanctos qui habitabant Lyddae
clem: Factum est autem, ut Petrus dum pertransiret universos, deveniret ad sanctos qui habitabant Lydd.
tr: εγενετο δε πετρον διερχομενον δια παντων κατελθειν και προς τους αγιους τους κατοικουντας λυδδαν
kjv: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.

vulg: invenit autem ibi hominem quendam nomine Aeneam ab annis octo iacentem in grabatto qui erat paralyticus
clem: Invenit autem ibi hominem quemdam, nomine neam, ab annis octo jacentem in grabato, qui erat paralyticus.
tr: ευρεν δε εκει ανθρωπον τινα αινεαν ονοματι εξ ετων οκτω κατακειμενον επι κραββατω ος ην παραλελυμενος
kjv: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

vulg: et ait illi Petrus Aeneas sanat te Iesus Christus surge et sterne tibi et continuo surrexit
clem: Et ait illi Petrus: nea, sanat te Dominus Jesus Christus: surge, et sterne tibi. Et continuo surrexit.
tr: και ειπεν αυτω ο πετρος αινεα ιαται σε ιησους ο χριστος αναστηθι και στρωσον σεαυτω και ευθεως ανεστη
kjv: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.

vulg: et viderunt illum omnes qui habitabant Lyddae et Saronae qui conversi sunt ad Dominum
clem: Et viderunt eum omnes qui habitabant Lydd et Saron: qui conversi sunt ad Dominum.
tr: και ειδον αυτον παντες οι κατοικουντες λυδδαν και τον σαρωναν  σαρωνα  οιτινες επεστρεψαν επι τον κυριον
kjv: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.

vulg: in Ioppe autem fuit quaedam discipula nomine Tabitas quae interpretata dicitur Dorcas haec erat plena operibus bonis et elemosynis quas faciebat
clem: In Joppe autem fuit qudam discipula, nomine Tabitha, qu interpretata dicitur Dorcas. Hc erat plena operibus bonis et eleemosynis quas faciebat.
tr: εν ιοππη δε τις ην μαθητρια ονοματι ταβιθα η διερμηνευομενη λεγεται δορκας αυτη ην πληρης αγαθων εργων και ελεημοσυνων ων εποιει
kjv: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

vulg: factum est autem in diebus illis ut infirmata moreretur quam cum lavissent posuerunt eam in cenaculo
clem: Factum est autem in diebus illis ut infirmata moreretur. Quam cum lavissent, posuerunt eam in cnaculo.
tr: εγενετο δε εν ταις ημεραις εκειναις ασθενησασαν αυτην αποθανειν λουσαντες δε αυτην εθηκαν εν υπερωω
kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.

vulg: cum autem prope esset Lydda ab Ioppe discipuli audientes quia Petrus esset in ea miserunt duos viros ad eum rogantes ne pigriteris venire usque ad nos
clem: Cum autem prope esset Lydda ad Joppen, discipuli, audientes quia Petrus esset in ea, miserunt duos viros ad eum, rogantes: Ne pigriteris venire ad nos.
tr: εγγυς δε ουσης λυδδης τη ιοππη οι μαθηται ακουσαντες οτι πετρος εστιν εν αυτη απεστειλαν δυο ανδρας προς αυτον παρακαλουντες μη οκνησαι διελθειν εως αυτων
kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.

vulg: exsurgens autem Petrus venit cum illis et cum advenisset duxerunt illum in cenaculum et circumsteterunt illum omnes viduae flentes et ostendentes tunicas et vestes quas faciebat illis Dorcas
clem: Exsurgens autem Petrus, venit cum illis. Et cum advenisset, duxerunt illum in cnaculum: et circumsteterunt illum omnes vidu flentes, et ostendentes ei tunicas et vestes quas faciebat illis Dorcas.
tr: αναστας δε πετρος συνηλθεν αυτοις ον παραγενομενον ανηγαγον εις το υπερωον και παρεστησαν αυτω πασαι αι χηραι κλαιουσαι και επιδεικνυμεναι χιτωνας και ιματια οσα εποιει μετ αυτων ουσα η δορκας
kjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

vulg: eiectis autem omnibus foras Petrus ponens genua oravit et conversus ad corpus dixit Tabita surge at illa aperuit oculos suos et viso Petro resedit
clem: Ejectis autem omnibus foras, Petrus ponens genua oravit: et conversus ad corpus, dixit: Tabitha, surge. At illa aperuit oculos suos: et viso Petro, resedit.
tr: εκβαλων δε εξω παντας ο πετρος θεις τα γονατα προσηυξατο και επιστρεψας προς το σωμα ειπεν ταβιθα αναστηθι η δε ηνοιξεν τους οφθαλμους αυτης και ιδουσα τον πετρον ανεκαθισεν
kjv: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

vulg: dans autem illi manum erexit eam et cum vocasset sanctos et viduas adsignavit eam vivam
