clem: Dans autem illi manum, erexit eam. Et cum vocasset sanctos et viduas, assignavit eam vivam.
tr: δους δε αυτη χειρα ανεστησεν αυτην φωνησας δε τους αγιους και τας χηρας παρεστησεν αυτην ζωσαν
kjv: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.

vulg: notum autem factum est per universam Ioppen et crediderunt multi in Domino
clem: Notum autem factum est per universam Joppen: et crediderunt multi in Domino.
tr: γνωστον δε εγενετο καθ ολης της ιοππης και πολλοι επιστευσαν επι τον κυριον
kjv: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.

vulg: factum est autem ut dies multos moraretur in Ioppe apud quendam Simonem coriarium
clem: Factum est autem ut dies multos moraretur in Joppe, apud Simonem quemdam coriarium.
tr: εγενετο δε ημερας ικανας μειναι αυτον εν ιοππη παρα τινι σιμωνι βυρσει
kjv: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.

vulg: vir autem quidam erat in Caesarea nomine Cornelius centurio cohortis quae dicitur Italica
clem: Vir autem quidam erat in Csarea, nomine Cornelius, centurio cohortis qu dicitur Italica,
tr: ανηρ δε τις ην εν καισαρεια ονοματι κορνηλιος εκατονταρχης εκ σπειρης της καλουμενης ιταλικης
kjv: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,

vulg: religiosus et timens Deum cum omni domo sua faciens elemosynas multas plebi et deprecans Deum semper
clem: religiosus, ac timens Deum cum omni domo sua, faciens eleemosynas multas plebi, et deprecans Deum semper.
tr: ευσεβης και φοβουμενος τον θεον συν παντι τω οικω αυτου ποιων τε ελεημοσυνας πολλας τω λαω και δεομενος του θεου διαπαντος  δια παντος
kjv: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.

vulg: vidit in visu manifeste quasi hora nona diei angelum Dei introeuntem ad se et dicentem sibi Corneli
clem: Is vidit in visu manifeste, quasi hora diei nona, angelum Dei intrountem ad se, et dicentem sibi: Corneli.
tr: ειδεν εν οραματι φανερως ωσει ωραν εννατην της ημερας αγγελον του θεου εισελθοντα προς αυτον και ειποντα αυτω κορνηλιε
kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.

vulg: at ille intuens eum timore correptus dixit quid est domine dixit autem illi orationes tuae et elemosynae tuae ascenderunt in memoriam in conspectu Dei
clem: At ille intuens eum, timore correptus, dixit: Quid est, domine? Dixit autem illi: Orationes tu et eleemosyn tu ascenderunt in memoriam in conspectu Dei.
tr: ο δε ατενισας αυτω και εμφοβος γενομενος ειπεν τι εστιν κυριε ειπεν δε αυτω αι προσευχαι σου και αι ελεημοσυναι σου ανεβησαν εις μνημοσυνον ενωπιον του θεου
kjv: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.

vulg: et nunc mitte viros in Ioppen et accersi Simonem quendam qui cognominatur Petrus
clem: Et nunc mitte viros in Joppen, et accersi Simonem quemdam, qui cognominatur Petrus:
tr: και νυν πεμψον εις ιοππην ανδρας και μεταπεμψαι σιμωνα ος επικαλειται πετρος
kjv: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:

vulg: hic hospitatur apud Simonem quendam coriarium cuius est domus iuxta mare
clem: hic hospitatur apud Simonem quemdam coriarium, cujus est domus juxta mare: hic dicet tibi quid te oporteat facere.
tr: ουτος ξενιζεται παρα τινι σιμωνι βυρσει ω εστιν οικια παρα θαλασσαν ουτος λαλησει σοι τι σε δει ποιειν
kjv: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

vulg: et cum discessisset angelus qui loquebatur illi vocavit duos domesticos suos et militem metuentem Dominum ex his qui illi parebant
clem: Et cum discessisset angelus qui loquebatur illi, vocavit duos domesticos suos, et militem metuentem Dominum ex his qui illi parebant.
tr: ως δε απηλθεν ο αγγελος ο λαλων τω κορνηλιω φωνησας δυο των οικετων αυτου και στρατιωτην ευσεβη των προσκαρτερουντων αυτω
kjv: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;

vulg: quibus cum narrasset omnia misit illos in Ioppen
clem: Quibus cum narrasset omnia, misit illos in Joppen.
tr: και εξηγησαμενος αυτοις απαντα απεστειλεν αυτους εις την ιοππην
kjv: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.

vulg: postera autem die iter illis facientibus et adpropinquantibus civitati ascendit Petrus in superiora ut oraret circa horam sextam
clem: Postera autem die, iter illis facientibus, et appropinquantibus civitati, ascendit Petrus in superiora ut oraret circa horam sextam.
tr: τη δε επαυριον οδοιπορουντων εκεινων και τη πολει εγγιζοντων ανεβη πετρος επι το δωμα προσευξασθαι περι ωραν εκτην
kjv: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

vulg: et cum esuriret voluit gustare parantibus autem eis cecidit super eum mentis excessus
clem: Et cum esuriret, voluit gustare. Parantibus autem illis, cecidit super eum mentis excessus:
tr: εγενετο δε προσπεινος και ηθελεν γευσασθαι παρασκευαζοντων δε εκεινων επεπεσεν επ αυτον εκστασις
kjv: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

vulg: et videt caelum apertum et descendens vas quoddam velut linteum magnum quattuor initiis submitti de caelo in terram
clem: et vidit clum apertum, et descendens vas quoddam, velut linteum magnum, quatuor initiis submitti de clo in terram,
tr: και θεωρει τον ουρανον ανεωγμενον και καταβαινον επ αυτον σκευος τι ως οθονην μεγαλην τεσσαρσιν αρχαις δεδεμενον και καθιεμενον επι της γης
kjv: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending upon him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

vulg: in quo erant omnia quadrupedia et serpentia terrae et volatilia caeli
clem: in quo erant omnia quadrupedia, et serpentia terr, et volatilia cli.
tr: εν ω υπηρχεν παντα τα τετραποδα της γης και τα θηρια και τα ερπετα και τα πετεινα του ουρανου
kjv: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

vulg: et facta est vox ad eum surge Petre et occide et manduca
clem: Et facta est vox ad eum: Surge, Petre: occide, et manduca.
tr: και εγενετο φωνη προς αυτον αναστας πετρε θυσον και φαγε
kjv: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

vulg: ait autem Petrus absit Domine quia numquam manducavi omne commune et inmundum
clem: Ait autem Petrus: Absit Domine, quia numquam manducavi omne commune et immundum.
tr: ο δε πετρος ειπεν μηδαμως κυριε οτι ουδεποτε εφαγον παν κοινον η ακαθαρτον
kjv: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.

vulg: et vox iterum secundo ad eum quae Deus purificavit ne tu commune dixeris
clem: Et vox iterum secundo ad eum: Quod Deus purificavit, tu commune ne dixeris.
tr: και φωνη παλιν εκ δευτερου προς αυτον α ο θεος εκαθαρισεν συ μη κοινου
kjv: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

vulg: hoc autem factum est per ter et statim receptum est vas in caelum
clem: Hoc autem factum est per ter: et statim receptum est vas in clum.
tr: τουτο δε εγενετο επι τρις και παλιν ανεληφθη το σκευος εις τον ουρανον
kjv: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.

vulg: et dum intra se haesitaret Petrus quidnam esset visio quam vidisset ecce viri qui missi erant a Cornelio inquirentes domum Simonis adstiterunt ad ianuam
clem: Et dum intra se hsitaret Petrus quidnam esset visio quam vidisset, ecce viri qui missi erant a Cornelio, inquirentes domum Simonis astiterunt ad januam.
tr: ως δε εν εαυτω διηπορει ο πετρος τι αν ειη το οραμα ο ειδεν και ιδου οι ανδρες οι απεσταλμενοι απο του κορνηλιου διερωτησαντες την οικιαν σιμωνος επεστησαν επι τον πυλωνα
kjv: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,

vulg: et cum vocassent interrogabant si Simon qui cognominatur Petrus illic haberet hospitium
clem: Et cum vocassent, interrogabant, si Simon qui cognominatur Petrus illic haberet hospitium.
tr: και φωνησαντες επυνθανοντο ει σιμων ο επικαλουμενος πετρος ενθαδε ξενιζεται
kjv: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

vulg: Petro autem cogitante de visione dixit Spiritus ei ecce viri tres quaerunt te
clem: Petro autem cogitante de visione, dixit Spiritus ei: Ecce viri tres qurunt te.
tr: του δε πετρου ενθυμουμενου περι του οραματος ειπεν αυτω το πνευμα ιδου ανδρες τρεις ζητουσιν σε
kjv: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.

vulg: surge itaque et descende et vade cum eis nihil dubitans quia ego misi illos
clem: Surge itaque, descende, et vade cum eis nihil dubitans: quia ego misi illos.
tr: αλλα αναστας καταβηθι και πορευου συν αυτοις μηδεν διακρινομενος διοτι εγω απεσταλκα αυτους
kjv: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

vulg: descendens autem Petrus ad viros dixit ecce ego sum quem quaeritis quae causa est propter quam venistis
clem: Descendens autem Petrus ad viros, dixit: Ecce ego sum, quem quritis: qu causa est, propter quam venistis?
tr: καταβας δε πετρος προς τους ανδρας τους απεσταλμενους απο του κορνηλιου προς αυτον ειπεν ιδου εγω ειμι ον ζητειτε τις η αιτια δι ην παρεστε
kjv: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?

vulg: qui dixerunt Cornelius centurio vir iustus et timens Deum et testimonium habens ab universa gente Iudaeorum responsum accepit ab angelo sancto accersire te in domum suam et audire verba abs te
clem: Qui dixerunt: Cornelius centurio, vir justus et timens Deum, et testimonium habens ab universa gente Judorum, responsum accepit ab angelo sancto accersire te in domum suam, et audire verba abs te.
tr: οι δε ειπον κορνηλιος εκατονταρχης ανηρ δικαιος και φοβουμενος τον θεον μαρτυρουμενος τε υπο ολου του εθνους των ιουδαιων εχρηματισθη υπο αγγελου αγιου μεταπεμψασθαι σε εις τον οικον αυτου και ακουσαι ρηματα παρα σου
kjv: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.

vulg: introducens igitur eos recepit hospitio sequenti autem die surgens profectus est cum eis et quidam ex fratribus ab Ioppe comitati sunt eum
clem: Introducens ergo eos, recepit hospitio. Sequenti autem die, surgens profectus est cum illis, et quidam ex fratribus ab Joppe comitati sunt eum.
tr: εισκαλεσαμενος ουν αυτους εξενισεν τη δε επαυριον ο πετρος εξηλθεν συν αυτοις και τινες των αδελφων των απο της ιοππης συνηλθον αυτω
kjv: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.

vulg: altera autem die introivit Caesaream Cornelius vero expectabat illos convocatis cognatis suis et necessariis amicis
clem: Altera autem die introivit Csaream. Cornelius vero exspectabat illos, convocatis cognatis suis et necessariis amicis.
tr: και τη επαυριον εισηλθον εις την καισαρειαν ο δε κορνηλιος ην προσδοκων αυτους συγκαλεσαμενος τους συγγενεις αυτου και τους αναγκαιους φιλους
kjv: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and he had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

vulg: et factum est cum introisset Petrus obvius ei Cornelius et procidens ad pedes adoravit
clem: Et factum est cum introisset Petrus, obvius venit ei Cornelius, et procidens ad pedes ejus adoravit.
tr: ως δε εγενετο εισελθειν τον πετρον συναντησας αυτω ο κορνηλιος πεσων επι τους ποδας προσεκυνησεν
kjv: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.

vulg: Petrus vero levavit eum dicens surge et ego ipse homo sum
clem: Petrus vero elevavit eum, dicens: Surge: et ego ipse homo sum.
tr: ο δε πετρος αυτον ηγειρεν λεγων αναστηθι καγω αυτος ανθρωπος ειμι
kjv: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

vulg: et loquens cum illo intravit et invenit multos qui convenerant
clem: Et loquens cum illo intravit, et invenit multos qui convenerant:
tr: και συνομιλων αυτω εισηλθεν και ευρισκει συνεληλυθοτας πολλους
kjv: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.

vulg: dixitque ad illos vos scitis quomodo abominatum sit viro iudaeo coniungi aut accedere ad alienigenam et mihi ostendit Deus neminem communem aut inmundum dicere hominem
clem: dixitque ad illos: Vos scitis quomodo abominatum sit viro Judo conjungi aut accedere ad alienigenam: sed mihi ostendit Deus neminem communem aut immundum dicere hominem.
tr: εφη τε προς αυτους υμεις επιστασθε ως αθεμιτον εστιν ανδρι ιουδαιω κολλασθαι η προσερχεσθαι αλλοφυλω και εμοι ο θεος εδειξεν μηδενα κοινον η ακαθαρτον λεγειν ανθρωπον
kjv: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

vulg: propter quod sine dubitatione veni accersitus interrogo ergo quam ob causam accersistis me
clem: Propter quod sine dubitatione veni accersitus. Interrogo ergo, quam ob causam accersistis me?
tr: διο και αναντιρρητως ηλθον μεταπεμφθεις πυνθανομαι ουν τινι λογω μετεπεμψασθε με
kjv: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?

vulg: et Cornelius ait a nudius quartana die usque in hanc horam orans eram hora nona in domo mea et ecce vir stetit ante me in veste candida et ait
clem: Et Cornelius ait: A nudiusquarta die usque ad hanc horam, orans eram hora nona in domo mea, et ecce vir stetit ante me in veste candida, et ait:
tr: και ο κορνηλιος εφη απο τεταρτης ημερας μεχρι ταυτης της ωρας ημην νηστευων και την εννατην ωραν προσευχομενος εν τω οικω μου και ιδου ανηρ εστη ενωπιον μου εν εσθητι λαμπρα
kjv: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

vulg: Corneli exaudita est oratio tua et elemosynae tuae commemoratae sunt in conspectu Dei
clem: Corneli, exaudita est oratio tua, et eleemosyn tu commemorat sunt in conspectu Dei.
tr: και φησιν κορνηλιε εισηκουσθη σου η προσευχη και αι ελεημοσυναι σου εμνησθησαν ενωπιον του θεου
kjv: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

vulg: mitte ergo in Ioppen et accersi Simonem qui cognominatur Petrus hic hospitatur in domo Simonis coriarii iuxta mare
clem: Mitte ergo in Joppen, et accersi Simonem qui cognominatur Petrus: hic hospitatur in domo Simonis coriarii juxta mare.
tr: πεμψον ουν εις ιοππην και μετακαλεσαι σιμωνα ος επικαλειται πετρος ουτος ξενιζεται εν οικια σιμωνος βυρσεως παρα θαλασσαν ος παραγενομενος λαλησει σοι
kjv: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.

vulg: confestim igitur misi ad te et tu bene fecisti veniendo nunc ergo omnes nos in conspectu tuo adsumus audire omnia quaecumque tibi praecepta sunt a Domino
clem: Confestim ergo misi ad te: et tu benefecisti veniendo. Nunc ergo omnes nos in conspectu tuo adsumus audire omnia qucumque tibi prcepta sunt a Domino.
tr: εξαυτης ουν επεμψα προς σε συ τε καλως εποιησας παραγενομενος νυν ουν παντες ημεις ενωπιον του θεου παρεσμεν ακουσαι παντα τα προστεταγμενα σοι υπο του θεου
kjv: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.

vulg: aperiens autem Petrus os dixit in veritate conperi quoniam non est personarum acceptor Deus
clem: Aperiens autem Petrus os suum, dixit: In veritate comperi quia non est personarum acceptor Deus;
tr: ανοιξας δε πετρος το στομα ειπεν επ αληθειας καταλαμβανομαι οτι ουκ εστιν προσωποληπτης ο θεος
kjv: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

vulg: sed in omni gente qui timet eum et operatur iustitiam acceptus est illi
clem: sed in omni gente qui timet eum, et operatur justitiam, acceptus est illi.
tr: αλλ εν παντι εθνει ο φοβουμενος αυτον και εργαζομενος δικαιοσυνην δεκτος αυτω εστιν
kjv: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.

vulg: verbum misit filiis Israhel adnuntians pacem per Iesum Christum hic est omnium Dominus
clem: Verbum misit Deus filiis Isral, annuntians pacem per Jesum Christum (hic est omnium Dominus).
tr: τον λογον ον απεστειλεν τοις υιοις ισραηλ ευαγγελιζομενος ειρηνην δια ιησου χριστου ουτος εστιν παντων κυριος
kjv: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)

vulg: vos scitis quod factum est verbum per universam Iudaeam incipiens enim a Galilaea post baptismum quod praedicavit Iohannes
clem: Vos scitis quod factum est verbum per universam Judam: incipiens enim a Galila post baptismum quod prdicavit Joannes,
tr: υμεις οιδατε το γενομενον ρημα καθ ολης της ιουδαιας αρξαμενον απο της γαλιλαιας μετα το βαπτισμα ο εκηρυξεν ιωαννης
kjv: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

vulg: Iesum a Nazareth quomodo unxit eum Deus Spiritu Sancto et virtute qui pertransivit benefaciendo et sanando omnes oppressos a diabolo quoniam Deus erat cum illo
clem: Jesum a Nazareth: quomodo unxit eum Deus Spiritu Sancto, et virtute, qui pertransiit benefaciendo, et sanando omnes oppressos a diabolo, quoniam Deus erat cum illo.
tr: ιησουν τον απο ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ  ως εχρισεν αυτον ο θεος πνευματι αγιω και δυναμει ος διηλθεν ευεργετων και ιωμενος παντας τους καταδυναστευομενους υπο του διαβολου οτι ο θεος ην μετ αυτου
kjv: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

vulg: et nos testes sumus omnium quae fecit in regione Iudaeorum et Hierusalem quem et occiderunt suspendentes in ligno
clem: Et nos testes sumus omnium qu fecit in regione Judorum, et Jerusalem, quem occiderunt suspendentes in ligno.
tr: και ημεις εσμεν μαρτυρες παντων ων εποιησεν εν τε τη χωρα των ιουδαιων και εν ιερουσαλημ ον ανειλον κρεμασαντες επι ξυλου
kjv: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

vulg: hunc Deus suscitavit tertia die et dedit eum manifestum fieri
clem: Hunc Deus suscitavit tertia die, et dedit eum manifestum fieri,
tr: τουτον ο θεος ηγειρεν τη τριτη ημερα και εδωκεν αυτον εμφανη γενεσθαι
kjv: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;

vulg: non omni populo sed testibus praeordinatis a Deo nobis qui manducavimus et bibimus cum illo postquam resurrexit a mortuis
clem: non omni populo, sed testibus prordinatis a Deo: nobis, qui manducavimus et bibimus cum illo postquam resurrexit a mortuis.
tr: ου παντι τω λαω αλλα μαρτυσιν τοις προκεχειροτονημενοις υπο του θεου ημιν οιτινες συνεφαγομεν και συνεπιομεν αυτω μετα το αναστηναι αυτον εκ νεκρων
kjv: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.

vulg: et praecepit nobis praedicare populo et testificari quia ipse est qui constitutus est a Deo iudex vivorum et mortuorum
clem: Et prcepit nobis prdicare populo, et testificari, quia ipse est qui constitutus est a Deo judex vivorum et mortuorum.
tr: και παρηγγειλεν ημιν κηρυξαι τω λαω και διαμαρτυρασθαι οτι αυτος εστιν ο ωρισμενος υπο του θεου κριτης ζωντων και νεκρων
kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.

vulg: huic omnes prophetae testimonium perhibent remissionem peccatorum accipere per nomen eius omnes qui credunt in eum
clem: Huic omnes prophet testimonium perhibent remissionem peccatorum accipere per nomen ejus omnes qui credunt in eum.
tr: τουτω παντες οι προφηται μαρτυρουσιν αφεσιν αμαρτιων λαβειν δια του ονοματος αυτου παντα τον πιστευοντα εις αυτον
kjv: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.

vulg: adhuc loquente Petro verba haec cecidit Spiritus Sanctus super omnes qui audiebant verbum
clem: Adhuc loquente Petro verba hc, cecidit Spiritus Sanctus super omnes qui audiebant verbum.
tr: ετι λαλουντος του πετρου τα ρηματα ταυτα επεπεσεν το πνευμα το αγιον επι παντας τους ακουοντας τον λογον
kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

vulg: et obstipuerunt ex circumcisione fideles qui venerant cum Petro quia et in nationes gratia Spiritus Sancti effusa est
clem: Et obstupuerunt ex circumcisione fideles qui venerant cum Petro, quia et in nationes gratia Spiritus Sancti effusa est.
tr: και εξεστησαν οι εκ περιτομης πιστοι οσοι συνηλθον τω πετρω οτι και επι τα εθνη η δωρεα του αγιου πνευματος εκκεχυται
kjv: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.

vulg: audiebant enim illos loquentes linguis et magnificantes Deum
clem: Audiebant enim illos loquentes linguis, et magnificantes Deum.
tr: ηκουον γαρ αυτων λαλουντων γλωσσαις και μεγαλυνοντων τον θεον τοτε απεκριθη ο πετρος
kjv: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,

vulg: tunc respondit Petrus numquid aquam quis prohibere potest ut non baptizentur hii qui Spiritum Sanctum acceperunt sicut et nos
clem: Tunc respondit Petrus: Numquid aquam quis prohibere potest ut non baptizentur hi qui Spiritum Sanctum acceperunt sicut et nos?
tr: μητι το υδωρ κωλυσαι δυναται τις του μη βαπτισθηναι τουτους οιτινες το πνευμα το αγιον ελαβον καθως και ημεις
kjv: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?

vulg: et iussit eos in nomine Iesu Christi baptizari tunc rogaverunt eum ut maneret aliquot diebus
clem: Et jussit eos baptizari in nomine Domini Jesu Christi. Tunc rogaverunt eum ut maneret apud eos aliquot diebus.
tr: προσεταξεν τε αυτους βαπτισθηναι εν τω ονοματι του κυριου τοτε ηρωτησαν αυτον επιμειναι ημερας τινας
kjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

vulg: audierunt autem apostoli et fratres qui erant in Iudaea quoniam et gentes receperunt verbum Dei
clem: Audierunt autem Apostoli et fratres qui erant in Juda, quoniam et gentes receperunt verbum Dei.
tr: ηκουσαν δε οι αποστολοι και οι αδελφοι οι οντες κατα την ιουδαιαν οτι και τα εθνη εδεξαντο τον λογον του θεου
kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

vulg: cum ascendisset autem Petrus in Hierosolymam disceptabant adversus illum qui erant ex circumcisione
clem: Cum autem ascendisset Petrus Jerosolymam, disceptabant adversus illum qui erant ex circumcisione,
tr: και οτε ανεβη πετρος εις ιεροσολυμα διεκρινοντο προς αυτον οι εκ περιτομης
kjv: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,

vulg: dicentes quare introisti ad viros praeputium habentes et manducasti cum illis
clem: dicentes: Quare introisti ad viros prputium habentes, et manducasti cum illis?
tr: λεγοντες οτι προς ανδρας ακροβυστιαν εχοντας εισηλθες και συνεφαγες αυτοις
kjv: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

vulg: incipiens autem Petrus exponebat illis ordinem dicens
clem: Incipiens autem Petrus exponebat illis ordinem, dicens:
tr: αρξαμενος δε ο πετρος εξετιθετο αυτοις καθεξης λεγων
kjv: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

vulg: ego eram in civitate Ioppe orans et vidi in excessu mentis visionem descendens vas quoddam velut linteum magnum quattuor initiis submitti de caelo et venit usque ad me
clem: Ego eram in civitate Joppe orans, et vidi in excessu mentis visionem, descendens vas quoddam velut linteum magnum quatuor initiis summitti de clo, et venit usque ad me.
tr: εγω ημην εν πολει ιοππη προσευχομενος και ειδον εν εκστασει οραμα καταβαινον σκευος τι ως οθονην μεγαλην τεσσαρσιν αρχαις καθιεμενην εκ του ουρανου και ηλθεν αχρις εμου
kjv: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

vulg: in quod intuens considerabam et vidi quadrupedia terrae et bestias et reptilia et volatilia caeli
clem: In quod intuens considerabam, et vidi quadrupedia terr, et bestias, et reptilia, et volatilia cli.
tr: εις ην ατενισας κατενοουν και ειδον τα τετραποδα της γης και τα θηρια και τα ερπετα και τα πετεινα του ουρανου
kjv: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

vulg: audivi autem et vocem dicentem mihi surgens Petre occide et manduca
clem: Audivi autem et vocem dicentem mihi: Surge, Petre: occide, et manduca.
tr: ηκουσα δε φωνης λεγουσης μοι αναστας πετρε θυσον και φαγε
kjv: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

vulg: dixi autem nequaquam Domine quia commune aut inmundum numquam introivit in os meum
clem: Dixi autem: Nequaquam Domine: quia commune aut immundum numquam introivit in os meum.
tr: ειπον δε μηδαμως κυριε οτι παν κοινον η ακαθαρτον ουδεποτε εισηλθεν εις το στομα μου
kjv: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

vulg: respondit autem vox secundo de caelo quae Deus mundavit tu ne commune dixeris
clem: Respondit autem vox secundo de clo: Qu Deus mundavit, tu ne commune dixeris.
tr: απεκριθη δε μοι φωνη εκ δευτερου εκ του ουρανου α ο θεος εκαθαρισεν συ μη κοινου
kjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

vulg: hoc autem factum est per ter et recepta sunt rursum omnia in caelum
clem: Hoc autem factum est per ter: et recepta sunt omnia rursum in clum.
tr: τουτο δε εγενετο επι τρις και παλιν ανεσπασθη απαντα εις τον ουρανον
kjv: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.

vulg: et ecce confestim tres viri adstiterunt in domo in qua eram missi a Caesarea ad me
clem: Et ecce viri tres confestim astiterunt in domo in qua eram, missi a Csarea ad me.
tr: και ιδου εξαυτης τρεις ανδρες επεστησαν επι την οικιαν εν η ημην απεσταλμενοι απο καισαρειας προς με
kjv: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.

vulg: dixit autem Spiritus mihi ut irem cum illis nihil haesitans venerunt autem mecum et sex fratres isti et ingressi sumus in domum viri
clem: Dixit autem Spiritus mihi ut irem cum illis, nihil hsitans. Venerunt autem mecum et sex fratres isti, et ingressi sumus in domum viri.
tr: ειπεν δε μοι το πνευμα συνελθειν αυτοις μηδεν διακρινομενον ηλθον δε συν εμοι και οι εξ αδελφοι ουτοι και εισηλθομεν εις τον οικον του ανδρος
kjv: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:

vulg: narravit autem nobis quomodo vidisset angelum in domo sua stantem et dicentem sibi mitte in Ioppen et accersi Simonem qui cognominatur Petrus
clem: Narravit autem nobis quomodo vidisset angelum in domo sua, stantem et dicentem sibi: Mitte in Joppen, et accersi Simonem qui cognominatur Petrus,
tr: απηγγειλεν τε ημιν πως ειδεν τον αγγελον εν τω οικω αυτου σταθεντα και ειποντα αυτω αποστειλον εις ιοππην ανδρας και μεταπεμψαι σιμωνα τον επικαλουμενον πετρον
kjv: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

vulg: qui loquetur tibi verba in quibus salvus eris tu et universa domus tua
clem: qui loquetur tibi verba in quibus salvus eris tu, et universa domus tua.
tr: ος λαλησει ρηματα προς σε εν οις σωθηση συ και πας ο οικος σου
kjv: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.

vulg: cum autem coepissem loqui decidit Spiritus Sanctus super eos sicut et in nos in initio
clem: Cum autem cpissem loqui, cecidit Spiritus Sanctus super eos, sicut et in nos in initio.
tr: εν δε τω αρξασθαι με λαλειν επεπεσεν το πνευμα το αγιον επ αυτους ωσπερ και εφ ημας εν αρχη
kjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

vulg: recordatus sum autem verbi Domini sicut dicebat Iohannes quidem baptizavit aqua vos autem baptizabimini Spiritu Sancto
clem: Recordatus sum autem verbi Domini, sicut dicebat: Joannes quidem baptizavit aqua, vos autem baptizabimini Spiritu Sancto.
tr: εμνησθην δε του ρηματος κυριου ως ελεγεν ιωαννης μεν εβαπτισεν υδατι υμεις δε βαπτισθησεσθε εν πνευματι αγιω
kjv: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.

vulg: si ergo eandem gratiam dedit illis Deus sicut et nobis qui credidimus in Dominum Iesum Christum ego quis eram qui possem prohibere Deum
clem: Si ergo eamdem gratiam dedit illis Deus, sicut et nobis qui credidimus in Dominum Jesum Christum: ego quis eram, qui possem prohibere Deum?
tr: ει ουν την ισην δωρεαν εδωκεν αυτοις ο θεος ως και ημιν πιστευσασιν επι τον κυριον ιησουν χριστον εγω δε τις ημην δυνατος κωλυσαι τον θεον
kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

vulg: his auditis tacuerunt et glorificaverunt Deum dicentes ergo et gentibus Deus paenitentiam ad vitam dedit
clem: His auditis, tacuerunt: et glorificaverunt Deum, dicentes: Ergo et gentibus pnitentiam dedit Deus ad vitam.
tr: ακουσαντες δε ταυτα ησυχασαν και εδοξαζον τον θεον λεγοντες αραγε και τοις εθνεσιν ο θεος την μετανοιαν εδωκεν εις ζωην
kjv: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

vulg: et illi quidem qui dispersi fuerant a tribulatione quae facta fuerat sub Stephano perambulaverunt usque Foenicen et Cyprum et Antiochiam nemini loquentes verbum nisi solis Iudaeis
clem: Et illi quidem qui dispersi fuerant a tribulatione qu facta fuerat sub Stephano, perambulaverunt usque Phnicen, et Cyprum, et Antiochiam, nemini loquentes verbum, nisi solis Judis.
tr: οι μεν ουν διασπαρεντες απο της θλιψεως της γενομενης επι στεφανω διηλθον εως φοινικης και κυπρου και αντιοχειας μηδενι λαλουντες τον λογον ει μη μονον ιουδαιοις
kjv: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.

vulg: erant autem quidam ex eis viri cyprii et cyrenei qui cum introissent Antiochiam loquebantur et ad Graecos adnuntiantes Dominum Iesum
clem: Erant autem quidam ex eis viri Cyprii et Cyreni, qui cum introissent Antiochiam, loquebantur et ad Grcos, annuntiantes Dominum Jesum.
tr: ησαν δε τινες εξ αυτων ανδρες κυπριοι και κυρηναιοι οιτινες εισελθοντες εις αντιοχειαν ελαλουν προς τους ελληνιστας ευαγγελιζομενοι τον κυριον ιησουν
kjv: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.

vulg: et erat manus Domini cum eis multusque numerus credentium conversus est ad Dominum
clem: Et erat manus Domini cum eis: multusque numerus credentium conversus est ad Dominum.
tr: και ην χειρ κυριου μετ αυτων πολυς τε αριθμος πιστευσας επεστρεψεν επι τον κυριον
kjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.

vulg: pervenit autem sermo ad aures ecclesiae quae erat Hierosolymis super istis et miserunt Barnaban usque Antiochiam
clem: Pervenit autem sermo ad aures ecclesi qu erat Jerosolymis super istis: et miserunt Barnabam usque ad Antiochiam.
tr: ηκουσθη δε ο λογος εις τα ωτα της εκκλησιας της εν ιεροσολυμοις περι αυτων και εξαπεστειλαν βαρναβαν διελθειν εως αντιοχειας
kjv: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

vulg: qui cum pervenisset et vidisset gratiam Dei gavisus est et hortabatur omnes proposito cordis permanere in Domino
clem: Qui cum pervenisset, et vidisset gratiam Dei, gavisus est: et hortabatur omnes in proposito cordis permanere in Domino:
tr: ος παραγενομενος και ιδων την χαριν του θεου εχαρη και παρεκαλει παντας τη προθεσει της καρδιας προσμενειν τω κυριω
kjv: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

vulg: quia erat vir bonus et plenus Spiritu Sancto et fide et adposita est turba multa Domino
clem: quia erat vir bonus, et plenus Spiritu Sancto, et fide. Et apposita est multa turba Domino.
tr: οτι ην ανηρ αγαθος και πληρης πνευματος αγιου και πιστεως και προσετεθη οχλος ικανος τω κυριω
kjv: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

vulg: profectus est autem Tarsum ut quaereret Saulum quem cum invenisset perduxit Antiochiam
clem: Profectus est autem Barnabas Tarsum, ut qureret Saulum: quem cum invenisset, perduxit Antiochiam.
tr: εξηλθεν δε εις ταρσον ο βαρναβας αναζητησαι σαυλον
kjv: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

vulg: et annum totum conversati sunt in ecclesia et docuerunt turbam multam ita ut cognominarentur primum Antiochiae discipuli Christiani
clem: Et annum totum conversati sunt ibi in ecclesia: et docuerunt turbam multam, ita ut cognominarentur primum Antiochi discipuli, christiani.
tr: και ευρων αυτον ηγαγεν αυτον εις αντιοχειαν εγενετο δε αυτους ενιαυτον ολον συναχθηναι εν τη εκκλησια και διδαξαι οχλον ικανον χρηματισαι τε πρωτον εν αντιοχεια τους μαθητας χριστιανους
kjv: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

vulg: in his autem diebus supervenerunt ab Hierosolymis prophetae Antiochiam
clem: In his autem diebus supervenerunt ab Jerosolymis prophet Antiochiam:
tr: εν ταυταις δε ταις ημεραις κατηλθον απο ιεροσολυμων προφηται εις αντιοχειαν
kjv: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.

vulg: et surgens unus ex eis nomine Agabus significabat per Spiritum famem magnam futuram in universo orbe terrarum quae facta est sub Claudio
clem: et surgens unus ex eis nomine Agabus, significabat per spiritum famem magnam futuram in universo orbe terrarum, qu facta est sub Claudio.
tr: αναστας δε εις εξ αυτων ονοματι αγαβος εσημανεν δια του πνευματος λιμον μεγαν μελλειν εσεσθαι εφ ολην την οικουμενην οστις και εγενετο επι κλαυδιου καισαρος
kjv: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.

vulg: discipuli autem prout quis habebat proposuerunt singuli eorum in ministerium mittere habitantibus in Iudaea fratribus
clem: Discipuli autem, prout quis habebat, proposuerunt singuli in ministerium mittere habitantibus in Juda fratribus:
tr: των δε μαθητων καθως ηυπορειτο τις ωρισαν εκαστος αυτων εις διακονιαν πεμψαι τοις κατοικουσιν εν τη ιουδαια αδελφοις
kjv: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:

vulg: quod et fecerunt mittentes ad seniores per manus Barnabae et Sauli
clem: quod et fecerunt, mittentes ad seniores per manus Barnab et Sauli.
tr: ο και εποιησαν αποστειλαντες προς τους πρεσβυτερους δια χειρος βαρναβα και σαυλου
kjv: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

vulg: eodem autem tempore misit Herodes rex manus ut adfligeret quosdam de ecclesia
clem: Eodem autem tempore misit Herodes rex manus, ut affligeret quosdam de ecclesia.
tr: κατ εκεινον δε τον καιρον επεβαλεν ηρωδης ο βασιλευς τας χειρας κακωσαι τινας των απο της εκκλησιας
kjv: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.

vulg: occidit autem Iacobum fratrem Iohannis gladio
clem: Occidit autem Jacobum fratrem Joannis gladio.
tr: ανειλεν δε ιακωβον τον αδελφον ιωαννου μαχαιρα
kjv: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

vulg: videns autem quia placeret Iudaeis adposuit adprehendere et Petrum erant autem dies azymorum
clem: Videns autem quia placeret Judis, apposuit ut apprehenderet et Petrum. Erant autem dies Azymorum.
tr: και ιδων οτι αρεστον εστιν τοις ιουδαιοις προσεθετο συλλαβειν και πετρον ησαν δε ημεραι των αζυμων
kjv: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

vulg: quem cum adprehendisset misit in carcerem tradens quattuor quaternionibus militum custodire eum volens post pascha producere eum populo
clem: Quem cum apprehendisset, misit in carcerem, tradens quatuor quaternionibus militum custodiendum, volens post Pascha producere eum populo.
tr: ον και πιασας εθετο εις φυλακην παραδους τεσσαρσιν τετραδιοις στρατιωτων φυλασσειν αυτον βουλομενος μετα το πασχα αναγαγειν αυτον τω λαω
kjv: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.

vulg: et Petrus quidem servabatur in carcere oratio autem fiebat sine intermissione ab ecclesia ad Deum pro eo
clem: Et Petrus quidem servabatur in carcere. Oratio autem fiebant sine intermissione ab ecclesia ad Deum pro eo.
tr: ο μεν ουν πετρος ετηρειτο εν τη φυλακη προσευχη δε ην εκτενης γινομενη υπο της εκκλησιας προς τον θεον υπερ αυτου
kjv: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

vulg: cum autem producturus eum esset Herodes in ipsa nocte erat Petrus dormiens inter duos milites vinctus catenis duabus et custodes ante ostium custodiebant carcerem
clem: Cum autem producturus eum esset Herodes, in ipsa nocte erat Petrus dormiens inter duos milites, vinctus catenis duabus: et custodes ante ostium custodiebant carcerem.
tr: οτε δε εμελλεν αυτον προαγειν ο ηρωδης τη νυκτι εκεινη ην ο πετρος κοιμωμενος μεταξυ δυο στρατιωτων δεδεμενος αλυσεσιν δυσιν φυλακες τε προ της θυρας ετηρουν την φυλακην
kjv: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

vulg: et ecce angelus Domini adstitit et lumen refulsit in habitaculo percussoque latere Petri suscitavit eum dicens surge velociter et ceciderunt catenae de manibus eius
clem: Et ecce angelus Domini astitit, et lumen refulsit in habitaculo: percussoque latere Petri, excitavit eum, dicens: Surge velociter. Et ceciderunt caten de manibus ejus.
tr: και ιδου αγγελος κυριου επεστη και φως ελαμψεν εν τω οικηματι παταξας δε την πλευραν του πετρου ηγειρεν αυτον λεγων αναστα εν ταχει και εξεπεσον αυτου αι αλυσεις εκ των χειρων
kjv: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.

vulg: dixit autem angelus ad eum praecingere et calcia te gallicas tuas et fecit sic et dixit illi circumda tibi vestimentum tuum et sequere me
clem: Dixit autem angelus ad eum: Prcingere, et calcea te caligas tuas. Et fecit sic. Et dixit illi: Circumda tibi vestimentum tuum, et sequere me.
tr: ειπεν τε ο αγγελος προς αυτον περιζωσαι και υποδησαι τα σανδαλια σου εποιησεν δε ουτως και λεγει αυτω περιβαλου το ιματιον σου και ακολουθει μοι
kjv: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

vulg: et exiens sequebatur et nesciebat quia verum est quod fiebat per angelum aestimabat autem se visum videre
clem: Et exiens sequebatur eum, et nesciebat quia verum est, quod fiebat per angelum: existimabat autem se visum videre.
tr: και εξελθων ηκολουθει αυτω και ουκ ηδει οτι αληθες εστιν το γινομενον δια του αγγελου εδοκει δε οραμα βλεπειν
kjv: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.

vulg: transeuntes autem primam et secundam custodiam venerunt ad portam ferream quae ducit ad civitatem quae ultro aperta est eis et exeuntes processerunt vicum unum et continuo discessit angelus ab eo
clem: Transeuntes autem primam et secundam custodiam, venerunt ad portam ferream, qu ducit ad civitatem: qu ultro aperta est eis. Et exeuntes processerunt vicum unum: et continuo discessit angelus ab eo.
tr: διελθοντες δε πρωτην φυλακην και δευτεραν ηλθον επι την πυλην την σιδηραν την φερουσαν εις την πολιν ητις αυτοματη ηνοιχθη αυτοις και εξελθοντες προηλθον ρυμην μιαν και ευθεως απεστη ο αγγελος απ αυτου
kjv: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.

vulg: et Petrus ad se reversus dixit nunc scio vere quia misit Dominus angelum suum et eripuit me de manu Herodis et de omni expectatione plebis Iudaeorum
clem: Et Petrus ad se reversus, dixit: Nunc scio vere quia misit Dominus angelum suum, et eripuit me de manu Herodis, et de omni exspectatione plebis Judorum.
tr: και ο πετρος γενομενος εν εαυτω ειπεν νυν οιδα αληθως οτι εξαπεστειλεν κυριος τον αγγελον αυτου και εξειλετο με εκ χειρος ηρωδου και πασης της προσδοκιας του λαου των ιουδαιων
kjv: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

vulg: consideransque venit ad domum Mariae matris Iohannis qui cognominatus est Marcus ubi erant multi congregati et orantes
clem: Consideransque venit ad domum Mari matris Joannis, qui cognominatus est Marcus, ubi erant multi congregati, et orantes.
tr: συνιδων τε ηλθεν επι την οικιαν μαριας της μητρος ιωαννου του επικαλουμενου μαρκου ου ησαν ικανοι συνηθροισμενοι και προσευχομενοι
kjv: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

vulg: pulsante autem eo ostium ianuae processit puella ad audiendum nomine Rhode
clem: Pulsante autem eo ostium janu, processit puella ad audiendum, nomine Rhode.
tr: κρουσαντος δε του πετρου την θυραν του πυλωνος προσηλθεν παιδισκη υπακουσαι ονοματι ροδη
kjv: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.

vulg: et ut cognovit vocem Petri prae gaudio non aperuit ianuam sed intro currens nuntiavit stare Petrum ante ianuam
clem: Et ut cognovit vocem Petri, pr gaudio non aperuit januam, sed intro currens nuntiavit stare Petrum ante januam.
tr: και επιγνουσα την φωνην του πετρου απο της χαρας ουκ ηνοιξεν τον πυλωνα εισδραμουσα δε απηγγειλεν εσταναι τον πετρον προ του πυλωνος
kjv: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.

vulg: at illi dixerunt ad eam insanis illa autem adfirmabat sic se habere illi autem dicebant angelus eius est
clem: At illi dixerunt ad eam: Insanis. Illa autem affirmabat sic se habere. Illi autem dicebant: Angelus ejus est.
tr: οι δε προς αυτην ειπον μαινη η δε διισχυριζετο ουτως εχειν οι δ ελεγον ο αγγελος αυτου εστιν
kjv: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.

vulg: Petrus autem perseverabat pulsans cum autem aperuissent viderunt eum et obstipuerunt
clem: Petrus autem perseverabat pulsans. Cum autem aperuissent, viderunt eum, et obstupuerunt.
tr: ο δε πετρος επεμενεν κρουων ανοιξαντες δε ειδον αυτον και εξεστησαν
kjv: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.

vulg: annuens autem eis manu ut tacerent enarravit quomodo Dominus eduxisset eum de carcere dixitque nuntiate Iacobo et fratribus haec et egressus abiit in alium locum
clem: Annuens autem eis manu ut tacerent, narravit quomodo Dominus eduxisset eum de carcere, dixitque: Nuntiate Jacobo et fratribus hc. Et egressus abiit in alium locum.
tr: κατασεισας δε αυτοις τη χειρι σιγαν διηγησατο αυτοις πως ο κυριος αυτον εξηγαγεν εκ της φυλακης ειπεν δε απαγγειλατε ιακωβω και τοις αδελφοις ταυτα και εξελθων επορευθη εις ετερον τοπον
kjv: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.

vulg: facta autem die erat non parva turbatio inter milites quidnam de Petro factum esset
clem: Facta autem die, erat non parva turbatio inter milites, quidnam factum esset de Petro.
tr: γενομενης δε ημερας ην ταραχος ουκ ολιγος εν τοις στρατιωταις τι αρα ο πετρος εγενετο
kjv: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.

vulg: Herodes autem cum requisisset eum et non invenisset inquisitione facta de custodibus iussit eos duci descendensque a Iudaea in Caesaream ibi commoratus est
clem: Herodes autem cum requisisset eum et non invenisset, inquisitione facta de custodibus, jussit eos duci: descendensque a Juda in Csaream, ibi commoratus est.
tr: ηρωδης δε επιζητησας αυτον και μη ευρων ανακρινας τους φυλακας εκελευσεν απαχθηναι και κατελθων απο της ιουδαιας εις την καισαρειαν διετριβεν
kjv: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.

vulg: erat autem iratus Tyriis et Sidoniis at illi unianimes venerunt ad eum et persuaso Blasto qui erat super cubiculum regis postulabant pacem eo quod alerentur regiones eorum ab illo
clem: Erat autem iratus Tyriis et Sidonis. At illi unanimes venerunt ad eum, et persuaso Blasto, qui erat super cubiculum regis, postulabant pacem, eo quod alerentur regiones eorum ab illo.
tr: ην δε ο ηρωδης θυμομαχων τυριοις και σιδωνιοις ομοθυμαδον δε παρησαν προς αυτον και πεισαντες βλαστον τον επι του κοιτωνος του βασιλεως ητουντο ειρηνην δια το τρεφεσθαι αυτων την χωραν απο της βασιλικης
kjv: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.

vulg: statuto autem die Herodes vestitus veste regia sedit pro tribunali et contionabatur ad eos
clem: Statuto autem die Herodes vestitus veste regia sedit pro tribunali, et concionabatur ad eos.
tr: τακτη δε ημερα ο ηρωδης ενδυσαμενος εσθητα βασιλικην και καθισας επι του βηματος εδημηγορει προς αυτους
kjv: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.

vulg: populus autem adclamabat dei voces et non hominis
clem: Populus autem acclamabat: Dei voces, et non hominis.
tr: ο δε δημος επεφωνει θεου φωνη και ουκ ανθρωπου
kjv: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.

vulg: confestim autem percussit eum angelus Domini eo quod non dedisset honorem Deo et consumptus a vermibus exspiravit
clem: Confestim autem percussit eum angelus Domini, eo quod non dedisset honorem Deo: et consumptus a vermibus, expiravit.
tr: παραχρημα δε επαταξεν αυτον αγγελος κυριου ανθ ων ουκ εδωκεν την δοξαν τω θεω και γενομενος σκωληκοβρωτος εξεψυξεν
kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

vulg: verbum autem Domini crescebat et multiplicabatur
clem: Verbum autem Domini crescebat, et multiplicabatur.
tr: ο δε λογος του θεου ηυξανεν και επληθυνετο
kjv: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

vulg: Barnabas autem et Saulus reversi sunt ab Hierosolymis expleto ministerio adsumpto Iohanne qui cognominatus est Marcus
clem: Barnabas autem et Saulus reversi sunt ab Jerosolymis expleto ministerio assumpto Joanne, qui cognominatus est Marcus.
tr: βαρναβας δε και σαυλος υπεστρεψαν εξ ιερουσαλημ πληρωσαντες την διακονιαν συμπαραλαβοντες και ιωαννην τον επικληθεντα μαρκον
kjv: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.

vulg: erant autem in ecclesia quae erat Antiochiae prophetae et doctores in quibus Barnabas et Symeon qui vocabatur Niger et Lucius Cyrenensis et Manaen qui erat Herodis tetrarchae conlactaneus et Saulus
clem: Erant autem in ecclesia qu erat Antiochi, prophet et doctores, in quibus Barnabas, et Simon qui vocabatur Niger, et Lucius Cyrenensis, et Manahen, qui erat Herodis Tetrarch collactaneus, et Saulus.
tr: ησαν δε τινες εν αντιοχεια κατα την ουσαν εκκλησιαν προφηται και διδασκαλοι ο τε βαρναβας και συμεων ο καλουμενος νιγερ και λουκιος ο κυρηναιος μαναην τε ηρωδου του τετραρχου συντροφος και σαυλος
kjv: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

vulg: ministrantibus autem illis Domino et ieiunantibus dixit Spiritus Sanctus separate mihi Barnaban et Saulum in opus quod adsumpsi eos
clem: Ministrantibus autem illis Domino, et jejunantibus, dixit illis Spiritus Sanctus: Segregate mihi Saulum et Barnabam in opus ad quod assumpsi eos.
tr: λειτουργουντων δε αυτων τω κυριω και νηστευοντων ειπεν το πνευμα το αγιον αφορισατε δη μοι τον τε βαρναβαν και τον σαυλον εις το εργον ο προσκεκλημαι αυτους
kjv: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

vulg: tunc ieiunantes et orantes inponentesque eis manus dimiserunt illos
clem: Tunc jejunantes et orantes, imponentesque eis manus, dimiserunt illos.
tr: τοτε νηστευσαντες και προσευξαμενοι και επιθεντες τας χειρας αυτοις απελυσαν
kjv: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

vulg: et ipsi quidem missi ab Spiritu Sancto abierunt Seleuciam et inde navigaverunt Cyprum
clem: Et ipsi quidem missi a Spiritu Sancto abierunt Seleuciam: et inde navigaverunt Cyprum.
tr: ουτοι μεν ουν εκπεμφθεντες υπο του πνευματος του αγιου κατηλθον εις την σελευκειαν εκειθεν τε απεπλευσαν εις την κυπρον
kjv: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

vulg: et cum venissent Salamina praedicabant verbum Dei in synagogis Iudaeorum habebant autem et Iohannem in ministerio
clem: Et cum venissent Salaminam, prdicabant verbum Dei in synagogis Judorum. Habebant autem et Joannem in ministerio.
tr: και γενομενοι εν σαλαμινι κατηγγελλον τον λογον του θεου εν ταις συναγωγαις των ιουδαιων ειχον δε και ιωαννην υπηρετην
kjv: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

vulg: et cum perambulassent universam insulam usque Paphum invenerunt quendam virum magum pseudoprophetam Iudaeum cui nomen erat Bariesu
clem: Et cum perambulassent universam insulam usque Paphum, invenerunt quemdam virum magum pseudoprophetam, Judum, cui nomen erat Barjesu,
tr: διελθοντες δε την νησον αχρι παφου ευρον τινα μαγον ψευδοπροφητην ιουδαιον ω ονομα βαριησους
kjv: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:

vulg: qui erat cum proconsule Sergio Paulo viro prudente hic accitis Barnaba et Saulo desiderabat audire verbum Dei
clem: qui erat cum proconsule Sergio Paulo viro prudente. Hic, accersitis Barnaba et Saulo, desiderabat audire verbum Dei.
tr: ος ην συν τω ανθυπατω σεργιω παυλω ανδρι συνετω ουτος προσκαλεσαμενος βαρναβαν και σαυλον επεζητησεν ακουσαι τον λογον του θεου
kjv: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.

vulg: resistebat autem illis Elymas magus sic enim interpretatur nomen eius quaerens avertere proconsulem a fide
clem: Resistebat autem illis Elymas magus (sic enim interpretatur nomen ejus), qurens avertere proconsulem a fide.
tr: ανθιστατο δε αυτοις ελυμας ο μαγος ουτως γαρ μεθερμηνευεται το ονομα αυτου ζητων διαστρεψαι τον ανθυπατον απο της πιστεως
kjv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

vulg: Saulus autem qui et Paulus repletus Spiritu Sancto intuens in eum
clem: Saulus autem, qui et Paulus, repletus Spiritu Sancto, intuens in eum,
tr: σαυλος δε ο και παυλος πλησθεις πνευματος αγιου και ατενισας εις αυτον
kjv: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him.

vulg: dixit o plene omni dolo et omni fallacia fili diaboli inimice omnis iustitiae non desinis subvertere vias Domini rectas
clem: dixit: O plene omni dolo et omni fallacia, fili diaboli, inimice omnis justiti, non desinis subvertere vias Domini rectas.
tr: ειπεν ω πληρης παντος δολου και πασης ραδιουργιας υιε διαβολου εχθρε πασης δικαιοσυνης ου παυση διαστρεφων τας οδους κυριου τας ευθειας
kjv: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

vulg: et nunc ecce manus Domini super te et eris caecus non videns solem usque ad tempus et confestim cecidit in eum caligo et tenebrae et circumiens quaerebat qui ei manum daret
clem: Et nunc ecce manus Domini super te, et eris ccus, non videns solem usque ad tempus. Et confestim cecidit in eum caligo et tenebr: et circuiens qurebat qui ei manum daret.
tr: και νυν ιδου χειρ του κυριου επι σε και εση τυφλος μη βλεπων τον ηλιον αχρι καιρου παραχρημα δε επεπεσεν επ αυτον αχλυς και σκοτος και περιαγων εζητει χειραγωγους
kjv: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.

vulg: tunc proconsul cum vidisset factum credidit admirans super doctrinam Domini
clem: Tunc proconsul cum vidisset factum, credidit admirans super doctrina Domini.
tr: τοτε ιδων ο ανθυπατος το γεγονος επιστευσεν εκπλησσομενος επι τη διδαχη του κυριου
kjv: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

vulg: et cum a Papho navigassent Paulus et qui cum eo venerunt Pergen Pamphiliae Iohannes autem discedens ab eis reversus est Hierosolymam
clem: Et cum a Papho navigassent Paulus et qui cum eo erant, venerunt Pergen Pamphyli. Joannes autem discedens ab eis, reversus est Jerosolymam.
tr: αναχθεντες δε απο της παφου οι περι τον παυλον ηλθον εις περγην της παμφυλιας ιωαννης δε αποχωρησας απ αυτων υπεστρεψεν εις ιεροσολυμα
kjv: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

vulg: illi vero pertranseuntes Pergen venerunt Antiochiam Pisidiae et ingressi synagogam die sabbatorum sederunt
clem: Illi vero pertranseuntes Pergen, venerunt Antiochiam Pisidi: et ingressi synagogam die sabbatorum, sederunt.
tr: αυτοι δε διελθοντες απο της περγης παρεγενοντο εις αντιοχειαν της πισιδιας και εισελθοντες εις την συναγωγην τη ημερα των σαββατων εκαθισαν
kjv: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

vulg: post lectionem autem legis et prophetarum miserunt principes synagogae ad eos dicentes viri fratres si quis est in vobis sermo exhortationis ad plebem dicite
clem: Post lectionem autem legis et prophetarum, miserunt principes synagog ad eos, dicentes: Viri fratres, si quis est in vobis sermo exhortationis ad plebem, dicite.
tr: μετα δε την αναγνωσιν του νομου και των προφητων απεστειλαν οι αρχισυναγωγοι προς αυτους λεγοντες ανδρες αδελφοι ει εστιν λογος εν υμιν παρακλησεως προς τον λαον λεγετε
kjv: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

vulg: surgens autem Paulus et manu silentium indicens ait viri israhelitae et qui timetis Deum audite
clem: Surgens autem Paulus, et manu silentium indicens, ait: Viri Isralit, et qui timetis Deum, audite:
tr: αναστας δε παυλος και κατασεισας τη χειρι ειπεν ανδρες ισραηλιται και οι φοβουμενοι τον θεον ακουσατε
kjv: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.

vulg: Deus plebis Israhel elegit patres nostros et plebem exaltavit cum essent incolae in terra Aegypti et in brachio excelso eduxit eos ex ea
clem: Deus plebis Isral elegit patres nostros, et plebem exaltavit cum essent incol in terra gypti, et in brachio excelso eduxit eos ex ea,
tr: ο θεος του λαου τουτου ισραηλ εξελεξατο τους πατερας ημων και τον λαον υψωσεν εν τη παροικια εν γη αιγυπτω και μετα βραχιονος υψηλου εξηγαγεν αυτους εξ αυτης
kjv: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.

vulg: et per quadraginta annorum tempus mores eorum sustinuit in deserto
clem: et per quadraginta annorum tempus mores eorum sustinuit in deserto.
tr: και ως τεσσαρακονταετη χρονον ετροποφορησεν αυτους εν τη ερημω
kjv: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.

vulg: et destruens gentes septem in terra Chanaan sorte distribuit eis terram eorum
clem: Et destruens gentes septem in terra Chanaan, sorte distribuit eis terram eorum,
tr: και καθελων εθνη επτα εν γη χανααν κατεκληροδοτησεν αυτοις την γην αυτων
kjv: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

vulg: quasi post quadringentos et quinquaginta annos et post haec dedit iudices usque ad Samuhel prophetam
clem: quasi post quadringentos et quinquaginta annos: et post hc dedit judices, usque ad Samuel prophetam.
tr: και μετα ταυτα ως ετεσιν τετρακοσιοις και πεντηκοντα εδωκεν κριτας εως σαμουηλ του προφητου
kjv: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

vulg: et exinde postulaverunt regem et dedit illis Deus Saul filium Cis virum de tribu Beniamin annis quadraginta
clem: Et exinde postulaverunt regem: et dedit illis Deus Saul filium Cis, virum de tribu Benjamin, annis quadraginta:
tr: κακειθεν ητησαντο βασιλεα και εδωκεν αυτοις ο θεος τον σαουλ υιον κις ανδρα εκ φυλης βενιαμιν ετη τεσσαρακοντα
kjv: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

vulg: et amoto illo suscitavit illis David regem cui et testimonium perhibens dixit inveni David filium Iesse virum secundum cor meum qui faciet omnes voluntates meas
clem: et amoto illo, suscitavit illis David regem: cui testimonium perhibens, dixit: Inveni David filium Jesse, virum secundum cor meum, qui faciet omnes voluntates meas.
tr: και μεταστησας αυτον ηγειρεν αυτοις τον δαβιδ εις βασιλεα ω και ειπεν μαρτυρησας ευρον δαβιδ τον του ιεσσαι ανδρα κατα την καρδιαν μου ος ποιησει παντα τα θεληματα μου
kjv: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave their testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

vulg: huius Deus ex semine secundum promissionem eduxit Israhel salvatorem Iesum
clem: Hujus Deus ex semine secundum promissionem eduxit Isral salvatorem Jesum,
tr: τουτου ο θεος απο του σπερματος κατ επαγγελιαν ηγειρεν τω ισραηλ σωτηρα ιησουν
kjv: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

vulg: praedicante Iohanne ante faciem adventus eius baptismum paenitentiae omni populo Israhel
clem: prdicante Joanne ante faciem adventus ejus baptismum pnitenti omni populo Isral.
tr: προκηρυξαντος ιωαννου προ προσωπου της εισοδου αυτου βαπτισμα μετανοιας παντι τω λαω ισραηλ
kjv: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

vulg: cum impleret autem Iohannes cursum suum dicebat quem me arbitramini esse non sum ego sed ecce venit post me cuius non sum dignus calciamenta pedum solvere
clem: Cum impleret autem Joannes cursum suum, dicebat: Quem me arbitramini esse, non sum ego: sed ecce venit post me, cujus non sum dignus calceamenta pedum solvere.
tr: ως δε επληρου ο ιωαννης τον δρομον ελεγεν τινα με υπονοειτε ειναι ουκ ειμι εγω αλλ ιδου ερχεται μετ εμε ου ουκ ειμι αξιος το υποδημα των ποδων λυσαι
kjv: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.

vulg: viri fratres filii generis Abraham et qui in vobis timent Deum vobis verbum salutis huius missum est
clem: Viri fratres, filii generis Abraham, et qui in vobis timent Deum, vobis verbum salutis hujus missum est.
tr: ανδρες αδελφοι υιοι γενους αβρααμ και οι εν υμιν φοβουμενοι τον θεον υμιν ο λογος της σωτηριας ταυτης απεσταλη
kjv: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.

vulg: qui enim habitabant Hierusalem et principes eius hunc ignorantes et voces prophetarum quae per omne sabbatum leguntur iudicantes impleverunt
clem: Qui enim habitabant Jerusalem, et principes ejus hunc ignorantes, et voces prophetarum qu per omne sabbatum leguntur, judicantes impleverunt,
tr: οι γαρ κατοικουντες εν ιερουσαλημ και οι αρχοντες αυτων τουτον αγνοησαντες και τας φωνας των προφητων τας κατα παν σαββατον αναγινωσκομενας κριναντες επληρωσαν
kjv: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.

vulg: et nullam causam mortis invenientes in eum petierunt a Pilato ut interficerent eum
clem: et nullam causam mortis invenientes in eo, petierunt a Pilato ut interficerent eum.
tr: και μηδεμιαν αιτιαν θανατου ευροντες ητησαντο πιλατον αναιρεθηναι αυτον
kjv: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.

vulg: cumque consummassent omnia quae de eo scripta erant deponentes eum de ligno posuerunt in monumento
clem: Cumque consummassent omnia qu de eo scripta erant, deponentes eum de ligno, posuerunt eum in monumento.
tr: ως δε ετελεσαν απαντα τα περι αυτου γεγραμμενα καθελοντες απο του ξυλου εθηκαν εις μνημειον
kjv: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.

vulg: Deus vero suscitavit eum a mortuis qui visus est per dies multos his
clem: Deus vero suscitavit eum a mortuis tertia die: qui visus est per dies multos his
tr: ο δε θεος ηγειρεν αυτον εκ νεκρων
kjv: But God raised him from the dead:

vulg: qui simul ascenderant cum eo de Galilaea in Hierusalem qui usque nunc sunt testes eius ad plebem
clem: qui simul ascenderant cum eo de Galila in Jerusalem: qui usque nunc sunt testes ejus ad plebem.
tr: ος ωφθη επι ημερας πλειους τοις συναναβασιν αυτω απο της γαλιλαιας εις ιερουσαλημ οιτινες εισιν μαρτυρες αυτου προς τον λαον
kjv: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.

vulg: et nos vobis adnuntiamus ea quae ad patres nostros repromissio facta est
clem: Et nos vobis annuntiamus eam, qu ad patres nostros repromissio facta est:
tr: και ημεις υμας ευαγγελιζομεθα την προς τους πατερας επαγγελιαν γενομενην
kjv: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,

vulg: quoniam hanc Deus adimplevit filiis nostris resuscitans Iesum sicut et in psalmo secundo scriptum est Filius meus es tu ego hodie genui te
clem: quoniam hanc Deus adimplevit filiis nostris resuscitans Jesum, sicut et in psalmo secundo scriptum est: Filius meus es tu, ego hodie genui te.
tr: οτι ταυτην ο θεος εκπεπληρωκεν τοις τεκνοις αυτων ημιν αναστησας ιησουν (13:33) ως και εν τω ψαλμω τω δευτερω γεγραπται υιος μου ει συ εγω σημερον γεγεννηκα σε
kjv: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

vulg: quod autem suscitaverit eum a mortuis amplius iam non reversurum in corruptionem ita dixit quia dabo vobis sancta David fidelia
clem: Quod autem suscitavit eum a mortuis, amplius jam non reversurum in corruptionem, ita dixit: Quia dabo vobis sancta David fidelia.
tr: οτι δε ανεστησεν αυτον εκ νεκρων μηκετι μελλοντα υποστρεφειν εις διαφθοραν ουτως ειρηκεν οτι δωσω υμιν τα οσια δαβιδ τα πιστα
kjv: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

vulg: ideoque et alias dicit non dabis Sanctum tuum videre corruptionem
clem: Ideoque et alias dicit: Non dabis sanctum tuum videre corruptionem.
tr: διο και εν ετερω λεγει ου δωσεις τον οσιον σου ιδειν διαφθοραν
kjv: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

vulg: David enim sua generatione cum administrasset voluntati Dei dormivit et adpositus est ad patres suos et vidit corruptionem
clem: David enim in sua generatione cum administrasset, voluntati Dei dormivit: et appositus est ad patres suos, et vidit corruptionem.
tr: δαβιδ μεν γαρ ιδια γενεα υπηρετησας τη του θεου βουλη εκοιμηθη και προσετεθη προς τους πατερας αυτου και ειδεν διαφθοραν
kjv: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:

vulg: quem vero Deus suscitavit non vidit corruptionem
clem: Quem vero Deus suscitavit a mortuis, non vidit corruptionem.
tr: ον δε ο θεος ηγειρεν ουκ ειδεν διαφθοραν
kjv: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

vulg: notum igitur sit vobis viri fratres quia per hunc vobis remissio peccatorum adnuntiatur ab omnibus quibus non potuistis in lege Mosi iustificari
clem: Notum igitur sit vobis, viri fratres, quia per hunc vobis remissio peccatorum annuntiatur, et ab omnibus quibus non potuistis in lege Moysi justificari,
tr: γνωστον ουν εστω υμιν ανδρες αδελφοι οτι δια τουτου υμιν αφεσις αμαρτιων καταγγελλεται
kjv: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:

vulg: in hoc omnis qui credit iustificatur
clem: in hoc omnis qui credit, justificatur.
tr: και απο παντων ων ουκ ηδυνηθητε εν τω νομω μωσεως δικαιωθηναι εν τουτω πας ο πιστευων δικαιουται
kjv: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.

vulg: videte ergo ne superveniat quod dictum est in prophetis
clem: Videte ergo ne superveniat vobis quod dictum est in prophetis:
tr: βλεπετε ουν μη επελθη εφ υμας το ειρημενον εν τοις προφηταις
kjv: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;

vulg: videte contemptores et admiramini et disperdimini quia opus operor ego in diebus vestris opus quod non credetis si quis enarraverit vobis
clem: [Videte contemptores, et admiramini, et disperdimini: quia opus operor ego in diebus vestris, opus quod non credetis, si quis enarraverit vobis.]
tr: ιδετε οι καταφρονηται και θαυμασατε και αφανισθητε οτι εργον εγω εργαζομαι εν ταις ημεραις υμων εργον ω ου μη πιστευσητε εαν τις εκδιηγηται υμιν
kjv: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

vulg: exeuntibus autem illis rogabant ut sequenti sabbato loquerentur sibi verba haec
clem: Exeuntibus autem illis rogabant ut sequenti sabbato loquerentur sibi verba hc.
tr: εξιοντων δε εκ της συναγωγης των ιουδαιων παρεκαλουν τα εθνη εις το μεταξυ σαββατον λαληθηναι αυτοις τα ρηματα ταυτα
kjv: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

vulg: cumque dimissa esset synagoga secuti sunt multi Iudaeorum et colentium advenarum Paulum et Barnaban qui loquentes suadebant eis ut permanerent in gratia Dei
clem: Cumque dimissa esset synagoga, secuti sunt multi Judorum, et colentium advenarum, Paulum et Barnabam: qui loquentes suadebant eis ut permanerent in gratia Dei.
tr: λυθεισης δε της συναγωγης ηκολουθησαν πολλοι των ιουδαιων και των σεβομενων προσηλυτων τω παυλω και τω βαρναβα οιτινες προσλαλουντες αυτοις επειθον αυτους επιμενειν τη χαριτι του θεου
kjv: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

vulg: sequenti vero sabbato paene universa civitas convenit audire verbum Domini
clem: Sequenti vero sabbato pene universa civitas convenit audire verbum Dei.
tr: τω δε ερχομενω σαββατω σχεδον πασα η πολις συνηχθη ακουσαι τον λογον του θεου
kjv: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.

vulg: videntes autem turbas Iudaei repleti sunt zelo et contradicebant his quae a Paulo dicebantur blasphemantes
clem: Videntes autem turbas Judi, repleti sunt zelo, et contradicebant his qu a Paulo dicebantur, blasphemantes.
tr: ιδοντες δε οι ιουδαιοι τους οχλους επλησθησαν ζηλου και αντελεγον τοις υπο του παυλου λεγομενοις αντιλεγοντες και βλασφημουντες
kjv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.

vulg: tunc constanter Paulus et Barnabas dixerunt vobis oportebat primum loqui verbum Dei sed quoniam repellitis illud et indignos vos iudicastis aeternae vitae ecce convertimur ad gentes
clem: Tunc constanter Paulus et Barnabas dixerunt: Vobis oportebat primum loqui verbum Dei: sed quoniam repellitis illud, et indignos vos judicatis tern vit, ecce convertimur ad gentes.
tr: παρρησιασαμενοι δε ο παυλος και ο βαρναβας ειπον υμιν ην αναγκαιον πρωτον λαληθηναι τον λογον του θεου επειδη δε απωθεισθε αυτον και ουκ αξιους κρινετε εαυτους της αιωνιου ζωης ιδου στρεφομεθα εις τα εθνη
kjv: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

vulg: sic enim praecepit nobis Dominus posui te in lumen gentibus ut sis in salutem usque ad extremum terrae
clem: Sic enim prcepit nobis Dominus: Posui te in lucem gentium, ut sis in salutem usque ad extremum terr.
tr: ουτως γαρ εντεταλται ημιν ο κυριος τεθεικα σε εις φως εθνων του ειναι σε εις σωτηριαν εως εσχατου της γης
kjv: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

vulg: audientes autem gentes gavisae sunt et glorificabant verbum Domini et crediderunt quotquot erant praeordinati ad vitam aeternam
clem: Audientes autem gentes, gavis sunt, et glorificabant verbum Domini: et crediderunt quotquot erant prordinati ad vitam ternam.
tr: ακουοντα δε τα εθνη εχαιρον και εδοξαζον τον λογον του κυριου και επιστευσαν οσοι ησαν τεταγμενοι εις ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.

vulg: disseminabatur autem verbum Domini per universam regionem
clem: Disseminabatur autem verbum Domini per universam regionem.
tr: διεφερετο δε ο λογος του κυριου δι ολης της χωρας
kjv: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

vulg: Iudaei autem concitaverunt religiosas mulieres et honestas et primos civitatis et excitaverunt persecutionem in Paulum et Barnaban et eiecerunt eos de finibus suis
clem: Judi autem concitaverunt mulieres religiosas et honestas, et primos civitatis, et excitaverunt persecutionem in Paulum et Barnabam: et ejecerunt eos de finibus suis.
tr: οι δε ιουδαιοι παρωτρυναν τας σεβομενας γυναικας και τας ευσχημονας και τους πρωτους της πολεως και επηγειραν διωγμον επι τον παυλον και τον βαρναβαν και εξεβαλον αυτους απο των οριων αυτων
kjv: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

vulg: at illi excusso pulvere pedum in eos venerunt Iconium
clem: At illi excusso pulvere pedum in eos, venerunt Iconium.
tr: οι δε εκτιναξαμενοι τον κονιορτον των ποδων αυτων επ αυτους ηλθον εις ικονιον
kjv: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

vulg: discipuli quoque replebantur gaudio et Spiritu Sancto
clem: Discipuli quoque replebantur gaudio, et Spiritu Sancto.
tr: οι δε μαθηται επληρουντο χαρας και πνευματος αγιου
kjv: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.

vulg: factum est autem Iconii ut simul introirent synagogam Iudaeorum et loquerentur ita ut crederet Iudaeorum et Graecorum copiosa multitudo
clem: Factum est autem Iconii, ut simul introirent in synagogam Judorum, et loquerentur, ita ut crederet Judorum et Grcorum copiosa multitudo.
tr: εγενετο δε εν ικονιω κατα το αυτο εισελθειν αυτους εις την συναγωγην των ιουδαιων και λαλησαι ουτως ωστε πιστευσαι ιουδαιων τε και ελληνων πολυ πληθος
kjv: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

vulg: qui vero increduli fuerunt Iudaei suscitaverunt et ad iracundiam concitaverunt animas gentium adversus fratres
clem: Qui vero increduli fuerunt Judi, suscitaverunt et ad iracundiam concitaverunt animas gentium adversus fratres.
tr: οι δε απειθουντες ιουδαιοι επηγειραν και εκακωσαν τας ψυχας των εθνων κατα των αδελφων
kjv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.

vulg: multo igitur tempore demorati sunt fiducialiter agentes in Domino testimonium perhibente verbo gratiae suae dante signa et prodigia fieri per manus eorum
clem: Multo igitur tempore demorati sunt, fiducialiter agentes in Domino, testimonium perhibente verbo grati su, dante signa et prodigia fieri per manus eorum.
tr: ικανον μεν ουν χρονον διετριψαν παρρησιαζομενοι επι τω κυριω τω μαρτυρουντι τω λογω της χαριτος αυτου και διδοντι σημεια και τερατα γινεσθαι δια των χειρων αυτων
kjv: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

vulg: divisa est autem multitudo civitatis et quidam quidem erant cum Iudaeis quidam vero cum apostolis
clem: Divisa est autem multitudo civitatis: et quidam quidem erant cum Judis, quidam vero cum Apostolis.
tr: εσχισθη δε το πληθος της πολεως και οι μεν ησαν συν τοις ιουδαιοις οι δε συν τοις αποστολοις
kjv: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

vulg: cum autem factus esset impetus gentilium et Iudaeorum cum principibus suis ut contumeliis adficerent et lapidarent eos
clem: Cum autem factus esset impetus gentilium et Judorum cum principibus suis, ut contumeliis afficerent, et lapidarent eos,
tr: ως δε εγενετο ορμη των εθνων τε και ιουδαιων συν τοις αρχουσιν αυτων υβρισαι και λιθοβολησαι αυτους
kjv: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,

vulg: intellegentes confugerunt ad civitates Lycaoniae Lystram et Derben et universam in circuitu regionem et ibi evangelizantes erant
clem: intelligentes confugerunt ad civitates Lycaoni Lystram et Derben, et universam in circuitu regionem, et ibi evangelizantes erant.
tr: συνιδοντες κατεφυγον εις τας πολεις της λυκαονιας λυστραν και δερβην και την περιχωρον
kjv: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:

vulg: et quidam vir in Lystris infirmus pedibus sedebat claudus ex utero matris suae qui numquam ambulaverat
clem: Et quidam vir Lystris infirmus pedibus sedebat, claudus ex utero matris su, qui numquam ambulaverat.
tr: κακει ησαν ευαγγελιζομενοι
kjv: And there they preached the gospel.

vulg: hic audivit Paulum loquentem qui intuitus eum et videns quia haberet fidem ut salvus fieret
clem: Hic audivit Paulum loquentem. Qui intuitus eum, et videns quia fidem haberet ut salvus fieret,
tr: και τις ανηρ εν λυστροις αδυνατος τοις ποσιν εκαθητο χωλος εκ κοιλιας μητρος αυτου υπαρχων ος ουδεποτε περιπεπατηκει  περιεπεπατηκει
kjv: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:

vulg: dixit magna voce surge super pedes tuos rectus et exilivit et ambulabat
clem: dixit magna voce: Surge super pedes tuos rectus. Et exilivit, et ambulabat.
tr: ουτος ηκουεν του παυλου λαλουντος ος ατενισας αυτω και ιδων οτι πιστιν εχει του σωθηναι
kjv: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

vulg: turbae autem cum vidissent quod fecerat Paulus levaverunt vocem suam lycaonice dicentes dii similes facti hominibus descenderunt ad nos
clem: Turb autem cum vidissent quod fecerat Paulus, levaverunt vocem suam lycaonice, dicentes: Dii similes facti hominibus descenderunt ad nos.
tr: ειπεν μεγαλη τη φωνη αναστηθι επι τους ποδας σου ορθος και ηλλετο και περιεπατει
kjv: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.

vulg: et vocabant Barnaban Iovem Paulum vero Mercurium quoniam ipse erat dux verbi
clem: Et vocabant Barnabam Jovem, Paulum vero Mercurium: quoniam ipse erat dux verbi.
tr: οι δε οχλοι ιδοντες ο εποιησεν ο παυλος επηραν την φωνην αυτων λυκαονιστι λεγοντες οι θεοι ομοιωθεντες ανθρωποις κατεβησαν προς ημας
kjv: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
