vulg: sacerdos quoque Iovis qui erat ante civitatem tauros et coronas ante ianuas adferens cum populis volebat sacrificare
clem: Sacerdos quoque Jovis, qui erat ante civitatem, tauros et coronas ante januas afferens, cum populis volebat sacrificare.
tr: εκαλουν τε τον μεν βαρναβαν δια τον δε παυλον ερμην επειδη αυτος ην ο ηγουμενος του λογου
kjv: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.

vulg: quod ubi audierunt apostoli Barnabas et Paulus conscissis tunicis suis exilierunt in turbas clamantes
clem: Quod ubi audierunt Apostoli, Barnabas et Paulus, conscissis tunicis suis exilierunt in turbas, clamantes
tr: ο δε ιερευς του διος του οντος προ της πολεως αυτων ταυρους και στεμματα επι τους πυλωνας ενεγκας συν τοις οχλοις ηθελεν θυειν
kjv: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

vulg: et dicentes viri quid haec facitis et nos mortales sumus similes vobis homines adnuntiantes vobis ab his vanis converti ad Deum vivum qui fecit caelum et terram et mare et omnia quae in eis sunt
clem: et dicentes: Viri, quid hc facitis? et nos mortales sumus, similes vobis homines, annuntiantes vobis ab his vanis converti ad Deum vivum, qui fecit clum, et terram, et mare, et omnia qu in eis sunt:
tr: ακουσαντες δε οι αποστολοι βαρναβας και παυλος διαρρηξαντες τα ιματια αυτων εισεπηδησαν εις τον οχλον κραζοντες
kjv: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

vulg: qui in praeteritis generationibus dimisit omnes gentes ingredi in vias suas
clem: qui in prteritis generationibus dimisit omnes gentes ingredi vias suas.
tr: και λεγοντες ανδρες τι ταυτα ποιειτε και ημεις ομοιοπαθεις εσμεν υμιν ανθρωποι ευαγγελιζομενοι υμας απο τουτων των ματαιων επιστρεφειν επι τον θεον τον ζωντα ος εποιησεν τον ουρανον και την γην και την θαλασσαν και παντα τα εν αυτοις
kjv: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

vulg: et quidem non sine testimonio semet ipsum reliquit benefaciens de caelo dans pluvias et tempora fructifera implens cibo et laetitia corda vestra
clem: Et quidem non sine testimonio semetipsum reliquit benefaciens de clo, dans pluvias et tempora fructifera, implens cibo et ltitia corda nostra.
tr: ος εν ταις παρωχημεναις γενεαις ειασεν παντα τα εθνη πορευεσθαι ταις οδοις αυτων
kjv: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

vulg: et haec dicentes vix sedaverunt turbas ne sibi immolarent
clem: Et hc dicentes, vix sedaverunt turbas ne sibi immolarent.
tr: και τοι γε  καιτοιγε  ουκ αμαρτυρον εαυτον αφηκεν αγαθοποιων ουρανοθεν ημιν υετους διδους και καιρους καρποφορους εμπιπλων τροφης και ευφροσυνης τας καρδιας ημων
kjv: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

vulg: supervenerunt autem quidam ab Antiochia et Iconio Iudaei et persuasis turbis lapidantesque Paulum traxerunt extra civitatem aestimantes eum mortuum esse
clem: Supervenerunt autem quidam ab Antiochia et Iconio Judi: et persuasis turbis, lapidantesque Paulum, traxerunt extra civitatem, existimantes eum mortuum esse.
tr: και ταυτα λεγοντες μολις κατεπαυσαν τους οχλους του μη θυειν αυτοις
kjv: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.

vulg: circumdantibus autem eum discipulis surgens intravit civitatem et postera die profectus est cum Barnaba in Derben
clem: Circumdantibus autem eum discipulis, surgens intravit civitatem, et postera die profectus est cum Barnaba in Derben.
tr: επηλθον δε απο αντιοχειας και ικονιου ιουδαιοι και πεισαντες τους οχλους και λιθασαντες τον παυλον εσυρον εξω της πολεως νομισαντες αυτον τεθναναι
kjv: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

vulg: cumque evangelizassent civitati illi et docuissent multos reversi sunt Lystram et Iconium et Antiochiam
clem: Cumque evangelizassent civitati illi, et docuissent multos, reversi sunt Lystram, et Iconium, et Antiochiam,
tr: κυκλωσαντων δε αυτον των μαθητων αναστας εισηλθεν εις την πολιν και τη επαυριον εξηλθεν συν τω βαρναβα εις δερβην
kjv: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

vulg: confirmantes animas discipulorum exhortantes ut permanerent in fide et quoniam per multas tribulationes oportet nos intrare in regnum Dei
clem: confirmantes animas discipulorum, exhortantesque ut permanerent in fide: et quoniam per multas tribulationes oportet nos intrare in regnum Dei.
tr: ευαγγελισαμενοι τε την πολιν εκεινην και μαθητευσαντες ικανους υπεστρεψαν εις την λυστραν και ικονιον και αντιοχειαν
kjv: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

vulg: et cum constituissent illis per singulas ecclesias presbyteros et orassent cum ieiunationibus commendaverunt eos Domino in quem crediderunt
clem: Et cum constituissent illis per singulas ecclesias presbyteros, et orassent cum jejunationibus, commendaverunt eos Domino, in quem crediderunt.
tr: επιστηριζοντες τας ψυχας των μαθητων παρακαλουντες εμμενειν τη πιστει και οτι δια πολλων θλιψεων δει ημας εισελθειν εις την βασιλειαν του θεου
kjv: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

vulg: transeuntesque Pisidiam venerunt Pamphiliam
clem: Transeuntesque Pisidiam, venerunt in Pamphyliam,
tr: χειροτονησαντες δε αυτοις πρεσβυτερους κατ εκκλησιαν προσευξαμενοι μετα νηστειων παρεθεντο αυτους τω κυριω εις ον πεπιστευκεισαν
kjv: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.

vulg: et loquentes in Pergen verbum Domini descenderunt in Attaliam
clem: et loquentes verbum Domini in Perge, descenderunt in Attaliam:
tr: και διελθοντες την πισιδιαν ηλθον εις παμφυλιαν
kjv: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

vulg: et inde navigaverunt Antiochiam unde erant traditi gratiae Dei in opus quod conpleverunt
clem: et inde navigaverunt Antiochiam, unde erant traditi grati Dei in opus quod compleverunt.
tr: και λαλησαντες εν περγη τον λογον κατεβησαν εις ατταλειαν
kjv: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

vulg: cum autem venissent et congregassent ecclesiam rettulerunt quanta fecisset Deus cum illis quia aperuisset gentibus ostium fidei
clem: Cum autem venissent, et congregassent ecclesiam, retulerunt quanta fecisset Deus cum illis, et quia aperuisset gentibus ostium fidei.
tr: κακειθεν απεπλευσαν εις αντιοχειαν οθεν ησαν παραδεδομενοι τη χαριτι του θεου εις το εργον ο επληρωσαν
kjv: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.

vulg: morati sunt autem tempus non modicum cum discipulis
clem: Morati sunt autem tempus non modicum cum discipulis.
tr: παραγενομενοι δε και συναγαγοντες την εκκλησιαν ανηγγειλαν οσα εποιησεν ο θεος μετ αυτων και οτι ηνοιξεν τοις εθνεσιν θυραν πιστεως
kjv: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.

tr: διετριβον δε εκει χρονον ουκ ολιγον συν τοις μαθηταις
kjv: And there they abode long time with the disciples.

vulg: et quidam descendentes de Iudaea docebant fratres quia nisi circumcidamini secundum morem Mosi non potestis salvi fieri
clem: Et quidam descendentes de Juda docebant fratres: Quia nisi circumcidamini secundum morem Moysi, non potestis salvari.
tr: και τινες κατελθοντες απο της ιουδαιας εδιδασκον τους αδελφους οτι εαν μη περιτεμνησθε τω εθει μωυσεως ου δυνασθε σωθηναι
kjv: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

vulg: facta ergo seditione non minima Paulo et Barnabae adversum illos statuerunt ut ascenderent Paulus et Barnabas et quidam alii ex illis ad apostolos et presbyteros in Hierusalem super hac quaestione
clem: Facta ergo seditione non minima Paulo et Barnab adversus illos, statuerunt ut ascenderent Paulus et Barnabas, et quidam alii ex aliis ad Apostolos et presbyteros in Jerusalem super hac qustione.
tr: γενομενης ουν στασεως και συζητησεως ουκ ολιγης τω παυλω και τω βαρναβα προς αυτους εταξαν αναβαινειν παυλον και βαρναβαν και τινας αλλους εξ αυτων προς τους αποστολους και πρεσβυτερους εις ιερουσαλημ περι του ζητηματος τουτου
kjv: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

vulg: illi igitur deducti ab ecclesia pertransiebant Foenicen et Samariam narrantes conversionem gentium et faciebant gaudium magnum omnibus fratribus
clem: Illi ergo deducti ab ecclesia pertransibant Phnicen et Samariam, narrantes conversionem gentium: et faciebant gaudium magnum omnibus fratribus.
tr: οι μεν ουν προπεμφθεντες υπο της εκκλησιας διηρχοντο την φοινικην και σαμαρειαν εκδιηγουμενοι την επιστροφην των εθνων και εποιουν χαραν μεγαλην πασιν τοις αδελφοις
kjv: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.

vulg: cum autem venissent Hierosolymam suscepti sunt ab ecclesia et ab apostolis et senioribus adnuntiantes quanta Deus fecisset cum illis
clem: Cum autem venissent Jerosolymam, suscepti sunt ab ecclesia, et ab Apostolis et senioribus, annuntiantes quanta Deus fecisset cum illis.
tr: παραγενομενοι δε εις ιερουσαλημ απεδεχθησαν υπο της εκκλησιας και των αποστολων και των πρεσβυτερων ανηγγειλαν τε οσα ο θεος εποιησεν μετ αυτων
kjv: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.

vulg: surrexerunt autem quidam de heresi Pharisaeorum qui crediderant dicentes quia oportet circumcidi eos praecipere quoque servare legem Mosi
clem: Surrexerunt autem quidam de hresi pharisorum, qui crediderunt, dicentes quia oportet circumcidi eos, prcipere quoque servare legem Moysi.
tr: εξανεστησαν δε τινες των απο της αιρεσεως των φαρισαιων πεπιστευκοτες λεγοντες οτι δει περιτεμνειν αυτους παραγγελλειν τε τηρειν τον νομον μωυσεως
kjv: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

vulg: conveneruntque apostoli et seniores videre de verbo hoc
clem: Conveneruntque Apostoli et seniores videre de verbo hoc.
tr: συνηχθησαν δε οι αποστολοι και οι πρεσβυτεροι ιδειν περι του λογου τουτου
kjv: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.

vulg: cum autem magna conquisitio fieret surgens Petrus dixit ad eos viri fratres vos scitis quoniam ab antiquis diebus in nobis elegit Deus per os meum audire gentes verbum evangelii et credere
clem: Cum autem magna conquisitio fieret, surgens Petrus dixit ad eos: Viri fratres, vos scitis quoniam ab antiquis diebus Deus in nobis elegit, per os meum audire gentes verbum Evangelii et credere.
tr: πολλης δε συζητησεως γενομενης αναστας πετρος ειπεν προς αυτους ανδρες αδελφοι υμεις επιστασθε οτι αφ ημερων αρχαιων ο θεος εν ημιν εξελεξατο δια του στοματος μου ακουσαι τα εθνη τον λογον του ευαγγελιου και πιστευσαι
kjv: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

vulg: et qui novit corda Deus testimonium perhibuit dans illis Spiritum Sanctum sicut et nobis
clem: Et qui novit corda Deus, testimonium perhibuit, dans illis Spiritum Sanctum, sicut et nobis,
tr: και ο καρδιογνωστης θεος εμαρτυρησεν αυτοις δους αυτοις το πνευμα το αγιον καθως και ημιν
kjv: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;

vulg: et nihil discrevit inter nos et illos fide purificans corda eorum
clem: et nihil discrevit inter nos et illos, fide purificans corda eorum.
tr: και ουδεν διεκρινεν μεταξυ ημων τε και αυτων τη πιστει καθαρισας τας καρδιας αυτων
kjv: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

vulg: nunc ergo quid temptatis Deum inponere iugum super cervicem discipulorum quod neque patres nostri neque nos portare potuimus
clem: Nunc ergo quid tentatis Deum, imponere jugum super cervices discipulorum quod neque patres nostri, neque nos portare potuimus?
tr: νυν ουν τι πειραζετε τον θεον επιθειναι ζυγον επι τον τραχηλον των μαθητων ον ουτε οι πατερες ημων ουτε ημεις ισχυσαμεν βαστασαι
kjv: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

vulg: sed per gratiam Domini Iesu credimus salvari quemadmodum et illi
clem: sed per gratiam Domini Jesu Christi credimus salvari, quemadmodum et illi.
tr: αλλα δια της χαριτος κυριου ιησου χριστου πιστευομεν σωθηναι καθ ον τροπον κακεινοι
kjv: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.

vulg: tacuit autem omnis multitudo et audiebant Barnaban et Paulum narrantes quanta fecisset Deus signa et prodigia in gentibus per eos
clem: Tacuit autem omnis multitudo: et audiebant Barnabam et Paulum narrantes quanta Deus fecisset signa et prodigia per eos.
tr: εσιγησεν δε παν το πληθος και ηκουον βαρναβα και παυλου εξηγουμενων οσα εποιησεν ο θεος σημεια και τερατα εν τοις εθνεσιν δι αυτων
kjv: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.

vulg: et postquam tacuerunt respondit Iacobus dicens viri fratres audite me
clem: Et postquam tacuerunt, respondit Jacobus, dicens: Viri fratres, audite me.
tr: μετα δε το σιγησαι αυτους απεκριθη ιακωβος λεγων ανδρες αδελφοι ακουσατε μου
kjv: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:

vulg: Simeon narravit quemadmodum primum Deus visitavit sumere ex gentibus populum nomini suo
clem: Simon narravit quemadmodum primum Deus visitavit sumere ex gentibus populum nomini suo.
tr: συμεων εξηγησατο καθως πρωτον ο θεος επεσκεψατο λαβειν εξ εθνων λαον επι τω ονοματι αυτου
kjv: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

vulg: et huic concordant verba prophetarum sicut scriptum est
clem: Et huic concordant verba prophetarum: sicut scriptum est:
tr: και τουτω συμφωνουσιν οι λογοι των προφητων καθως γεγραπται
kjv: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

vulg: post haec revertar et aedificabo tabernaculum David quod decidit et diruta eius reaedificabo et erigam illud
clem: [Post hc revertar, et redificabo tabernaculum David quod decidit: et diruta ejus redificabo, et erigam illud:
tr: μετα ταυτα αναστρεψω και ανοικοδομησω την σκηνην δαβιδ την πεπτωκυιαν και τα κατεσκαμμενα αυτης ανοικοδομησω και ανορθωσω αυτην
kjv: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:

vulg: ut requirant ceteri hominum Dominum et omnes gentes super quas invocatum est nomen meum dicit Dominus faciens haec
clem: ut requirant ceteri hominum Dominum, et omnes gentes super quas invocatum est nomen meum, dicit Dominus faciens hc.
tr: οπως αν εκζητησωσιν οι καταλοιποι των ανθρωπων τον κυριον και παντα τα εθνη εφ ους επικεκληται το ονομα μου επ αυτους λεγει κυριος ο ποιων ταυτα παντα
kjv: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.

vulg: notum a saeculo est Domino opus suum
clem: Notum a sculo est Domino opus suum.]
tr: γνωστα απ αιωνος εστιν τω θεω παντα τα εργα αυτου
kjv: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

vulg: propter quod ego iudico non inquietari eos qui ex gentibus convertuntur ad Deum
clem: Propter quod ego judico non inquietari eos qui ex gentibus convertuntur ad Deum,
tr: διο εγω κρινω μη παρενοχλειν τοις απο των εθνων επιστρεφουσιν επι τον θεον
kjv: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:

vulg: sed scribere ad eos ut abstineant se a contaminationibus simulacrorum et fornicatione et suffocatis et sanguine
clem: sed scribere ad eos ut abstineant se a contaminationibus simulacrorum, et fornicatione, et suffocatis, et sanguine.
tr: αλλα επιστειλαι αυτοις του απεχεσθαι απο των αλισγηματων των ειδωλων και της πορνειας και του πνικτου και του αιματος
kjv: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

vulg: Moses enim a temporibus antiquis habet in singulis civitatibus qui eum praedicent in synagogis ubi per omne sabbatum legitur
clem: Moyses enim a temporibus antiquis habet in singulis civitatibus qui eum prdicent in synagogis, ubi per omne sabbatum legitur.
tr: μωσης γαρ εκ γενεων αρχαιων κατα πολιν τους κηρυσσοντας αυτον εχει εν ταις συναγωγαις κατα παν σαββατον αναγινωσκομενος
kjv: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

vulg: tunc placuit apostolis et senioribus cum omni ecclesia eligere viros ex eis et mittere Antiochiam cum Paulo et Barnaba Iudam qui cognominatur Barsabban et Silam viros primos in fratribus
clem: Tunc placuit Apostolis et senioribus cum omni ecclesia eligere viros ex eis, et mittere Antiochiam cum Paulo et Barnaba: Judam, qui cognominabatur Barsabas, et Silam, viros primos in fratribus:
tr: τοτε εδοξεν τοις αποστολοις και τοις πρεσβυτεροις συν ολη τη εκκλησια εκλεξαμενους ανδρας εξ αυτων πεμψαι εις αντιοχειαν συν τω παυλω και βαρναβα ιουδαν τον επικαλουμενον βαρσαβαν και σιλαν ανδρας ηγουμενους εν τοις αδελφοις
kjv: Then pleased it the apostles and elders with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

vulg: scribentes per manus eorum apostoli et seniores fratres his qui sunt Antiochiae et Syriae et Ciliciae fratribus ex gentibus salutem
clem: scribentes per manus eorum: Apostoli et seniores fratres, his qui sunt Antiochi, et Syri, et Cilici, fratribus ex gentibus, salutem.
tr: γραψαντες δια χειρος αυτων ταδε οι αποστολοι και οι πρεσβυτεροι και οι αδελφοι τοις κατα την αντιοχειαν και συριαν και κιλικιαν αδελφοις τοις εξ εθνων χαιρειν
kjv: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia.

vulg: quoniam audivimus quia quidam ex nobis exeuntes turbaverunt vos verbis evertentes animas vestras quibus non mandavimus
clem: Quoniam audivimus quia quidam ex nobis exeuntes, turbaverunt vos verbis, evertentes animas vestras, quibus non mandavimus,
tr: επειδη ηκουσαμεν οτι τινες εξ ημων εξελθοντες εταραξαν υμας λογοις ανασκευαζοντες τας ψυχας υμων λεγοντες περιτεμνεσθαι και τηρειν τον νομον οις ου διεστειλαμεθα
kjv: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

vulg: placuit nobis collectis in unum eligere viros et mittere ad vos cum carissimis nostris Barnaba et Paulo
clem: placuit nobis collectis in unum eligere viros, et mittere ad vos cum carissimis nostris Barnaba et Paulo,
tr: εδοξεν ημιν γενομενοις ομοθυμαδον εκλεξαμενους ανδρας πεμψαι προς υμας συν τοις αγαπητοις ημων βαρναβα και παυλω
kjv: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

vulg: hominibus qui tradiderunt animas suas pro nomine Domini nostri Iesu Christi
clem: hominibus qui tradiderunt animas suas pro nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi.
tr: ανθρωποις παραδεδωκοσιν τας ψυχας αυτων υπερ του ονοματος του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
kjv: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: misimus ergo Iudam et Silam qui et ipsi vobis verbis referent eadem
clem: Misimus ergo Judam et Silam, qui et ipsi vobis verbis referent eadem.
tr: απεσταλκαμεν ουν ιουδαν και σιλαν και αυτους δια λογου απαγγελλοντας τα αυτα
kjv: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.

vulg: visum est enim Spiritui Sancto et nobis nihil ultra inponere vobis oneris quam haec necessario
clem: Visum est enim Spiritui Sancto et nobis nihil ultra imponere vobis oneris quam hc necessaria:
tr: εδοξεν γαρ τω αγιω πνευματι και ημιν μηδεν πλεον επιτιθεσθαι υμιν βαρος πλην των επαναγκες τουτων
kjv: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

vulg: ut abstineatis vos ab immolatis simulacrorum et sanguine suffocato et fornicatione a quibus custodientes vos bene agetis valete
clem: ut abstineatis vos ab immolatis simulacrorum, et sanguine, et suffocato, et fornicatione: a quibus custodientes vos, bene agetis. Valete.
tr: απεχεσθαι ειδωλοθυτων και αιματος και πνικτου και πορνειας εξ ων διατηρουντες εαυτους ευ πραξετε ερρωσθε
kjv: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.

vulg: illi igitur dimissi descenderunt Antiochiam et congregata multitudine tradiderunt epistulam
clem: Illi ergo dimissi, descenderunt Antiochiam: et congregata multitudine tradiderunt epistolam.
tr: οι μεν ουν απολυθεντες ηλθον εις αντιοχειαν και συναγαγοντες το πληθος επεδωκαν την επιστολην
kjv: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

vulg: quam cum legissent gavisi sunt super consolatione
clem: Quam cum legissent, gavisi sunt super consolatione.
tr: αναγνοντες δε εχαρησαν επι τη παρακλησει
kjv: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

vulg: Iudas autem et Silas et ipsi cum essent prophetae verbo plurimo consolati sunt fratres et confirmaverunt
clem: Judas autem et Silas, et ipsi cum essent prophet, verbo plurimo consolati sunt fratres, et confirmaverunt.
tr: ιουδας τε  δε  και σιλας και αυτοι προφηται οντες δια λογου πολλου παρεκαλεσαν τους αδελφους και επεστηριξαν
kjv: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.

vulg: facto autem ibi tempore dimissi sunt cum pace a fratribus ad eos qui miserant illos
clem: Facto autem ibi aliquanto tempore, dimissi sunt cum pace a fratribus ad eos qui miserant illos.
tr: ποιησαντες δε χρονον απελυθησαν μετ ειρηνης απο των αδελφων προς τους αποστολους
kjv: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

clem: Visum est autem Sil ibi remanere: Judas autem solus abiit Jerusalem.
tr: εδοξεν δε τω σιλα επιμειναι αυτου
kjv: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.

vulg: Paulus autem et Barnabas demorabantur Antiochiae docentes et evangelizantes cum aliis pluribus verbum Domini
clem: Paulus autem et Barnabas demorabantur Antiochi, docentes et evangelizantes cum aliis pluribus verbum Domini.
tr: παυλος δε και βαρναβας διετριβον εν αντιοχεια διδασκοντες και ευαγγελιζομενοι μετα και ετερων πολλων τον λογον του κυριου
kjv: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

vulg: post aliquot autem dies dixit ad Barnaban Paulus revertentes visitemus fratres per universas civitates in quibus praedicavimus verbum Domini quomodo se habeant
clem: Post aliquot autem dies, dixit ad Barnabam Paulus: Revertentes visitemus fratres per universas civitates in quibus prdicavimus verbum Domini, quomodo se habeant.
tr: μετα δε τινας ημερας ειπεν παυλος προς βαρναβαν επιστρεψαντες δη επισκεψωμεθα τους αδελφους ημων κατα πασαν πολιν εν αις κατηγγειλαμεν τον λογον του κυριου πως εχουσιν
kjv: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

vulg: Barnabas autem volebat secum adsumere et Iohannem qui cognominatur Marcus
clem: Barnabas autem volebat secum assumere et Joannem, qui cognominabatur Marcus.
tr: βαρναβας δε εβουλευσατο συμπαραλαβειν τον ιωαννην τον καλουμενον μαρκον
kjv: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

vulg: Paulus autem rogabat eum qui discessisset ab eis a Pamphilia et non isset cum eis in opus non debere recipi eum
clem: Paulus autem rogabat eum (ut qui discessisset ab eis de Pamphylia, et non isset cum eis in opus) non debere recipi.
tr: παυλος δε ηξιου τον αποσταντα απ αυτων απο παμφυλιας και μη συνελθοντα αυτοις εις το εργον μη συμπαραλαβειν τουτον
kjv: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

vulg: facta est autem dissensio ita ut discederent ab invicem et Barnabas adsumpto Marco navigaret Cyprum
clem: Facta est autem dissensio, ita ut discederent ab invicem, et Barnabas quidem, assumpto Marco, navigaret Cyprum.
tr: εγενετο ουν παροξυσμος ωστε αποχωρισθηναι αυτους απ αλληλων τον τε βαρναβαν παραλαβοντα τον μαρκον εκπλευσαι εις κυπρον
kjv: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;

vulg: Paulus vero electo Sila profectus est traditus gratiae Domini a fratribus
clem: Paulus vero, electo Sila, profectus est, traditus grati Dei a fratribus.
tr: παυλος δε επιλεξαμενος σιλαν εξηλθεν παραδοθεις τη χαριτι του θεου υπο των αδελφων
kjv: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.

vulg: perambulabat autem Syriam et Ciliciam confirmans ecclesias
clem: Perambulabat autem Syriam et Ciliciam, confirmans ecclesias: prcipiens custodire prcepta Apostolorum et seniorum.
tr: διηρχετο δε την συριαν και κιλικιαν επιστηριζων τας εκκλησιας
kjv: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.

vulg: pervenit autem in Derben et Lystram et ecce discipulus quidam erat ibi nomine Timotheus filius mulieris iudaeae fidelis patre gentili
clem: Pervenit autem Derben et Lystram. Et ecce discipulus quidam erat ibi nomine Timotheus, filius mulieris Jud fidelis, patre gentili.
tr: κατηντησεν δε εις δερβην και λυστραν και ιδου μαθητης τις ην εκει ονοματι τιμοθεος υιος γυναικος τινος ιουδαιας πιστης πατρος δε ελληνος
kjv: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

vulg: huic testimonium reddebant qui in Lystris erant et Iconii fratres
clem: Huic testimonium bonum reddebant qui in Lystris erant et Iconio fratres.
tr: ος εμαρτυρειτο υπο των εν λυστροις και ικονιω αδελφων
kjv: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

vulg: hunc voluit Paulus secum proficisci et adsumens circumcidit eum propter Iudaeos qui erant in illis locis sciebant enim omnes quod pater eius gentilis esset
clem: Hunc voluit Paulus secum proficisci: et assumens circumcidit eum propter Judos qui erant in illis locis. Sciebant enim omnes quod pater ejus erat gentilis.
tr: τουτον ηθελησεν ο παυλος συν αυτω εξελθειν και λαβων περιετεμεν αυτον δια τους ιουδαιους τους οντας εν τοις τοποις εκεινοις ηδεισαν γαρ απαντες τον πατερα αυτου οτι ελλην υπηρχεν
kjv: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

vulg: cum autem pertransirent civitates tradebant eis custodire dogmata quae erant decreta ab apostolis et senioribus qui essent Hierosolymis
clem: Cum autem pertransirent civitates, tradebant eis custodiri dogmata qu erant decreta ab Apostolis et senioribus qui erant Jerosolymis.
tr: ως δε διεπορευοντο τας πολεις παρεδιδουν αυτοις φυλασσειν τα δογματα τα κεκριμενα υπο των αποστολων και των πρεσβυτερων των εν ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

vulg: et ecclesiae quidem confirmabantur fide et abundabant numero cotidie
clem: Et ecclesi quidem confirmabantur fide, et abundabunt numero quotidie.
tr: αι μεν ουν εκκλησιαι εστερεουντο τη πιστει και επερισσευον τω αριθμω καθ ημεραν
kjv: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

vulg: transeuntes autem Frygiam et Galatiae regionem vetati sunt a Sancto Spiritu loqui verbum in Asia
clem: Transeuntes autem Phrygiam et Galati regionem, vetati sunt a Spiritu Sancto loqui verbum Dei in Asia.
tr: διελθοντες δε την φρυγιαν και την γαλατικην χωραν κωλυθεντες υπο του αγιου πνευματος λαλησαι τον λογον εν τη ασια
kjv: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,

vulg: cum venissent autem in Mysiam temptabant ire Bithyniam et non permisit eos Spiritus Iesu
clem: Cum venissent autem in Mysiam, tentabant ire in Bithyniam: et non permisit eos Spiritus Jesu.
tr: ελθοντες κατα την μυσιαν επειραζον κατα την βιθυνιαν πορευεσθαι και ουκ ειασεν αυτους το πνευμα
kjv: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.

vulg: cum autem pertransissent Mysiam descenderunt Troadem
clem: Cum autem pertransissent Mysiam, descenderunt Troadem:
tr: παρελθοντες δε την μυσιαν κατεβησαν εις τρωαδα
kjv: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

vulg: et visio per noctem Paulo ostensa est vir macedo quidam erat stans et deprecans eum et dicens transiens in Macedoniam adiuva nos
clem: et visio per noctem Paulo ostensa est: vir Macedo quidam erat stans et deprecans eum, et dicens: Transiens in Macedoniam, adjuva nos.
tr: και οραμα δια της νυκτος ωφθη τω παυλω ανηρ τις ην μακεδων εστως παρακαλων αυτον και λεγων διαβας εις μακεδονιαν βοηθησον ημιν
kjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

vulg: ut autem visum vidit statim quaesivimus proficisci in Macedoniam certi facti quia vocasset nos Deus evangelizare eis
clem: Ut autem visum vidit, statim qusivimus proficisci in Macedoniam, certi facti quod vocasset nos Deus evangelizare eis.
tr: ως δε το οραμα ειδεν ευθεως εζητησαμεν εξελθειν εις την μακεδονιαν συμβιβαζοντες οτι προσκεκληται ημας ο κυριος ευαγγελισασθαι αυτους
kjv: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.

vulg: navigantes autem a Troade recto cursu venimus Samothraciam et sequenti die Neapolim
clem: Navigantes autem a Troade, recto cursu venimus Samothraciam, et sequenti die Neapolim:
tr: αναχθεντες ουν απο της τρωαδος ευθυδρομησαμεν εις σαμοθρακην τη τε επιουση εις νεαπολιν
kjv: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

vulg: et inde Philippis quae est prima partis Macedoniae civitas colonia eramus autem in hac urbe diebus aliquot conferentes
clem: et inde Philippos, qu est prima partis Macedoni civitas, colonia. Eramus autem in hac urbe diebus aliquot, conferentes.
tr: εκειθεν τε εις φιλιππους ητις εστιν πρωτη της μεριδος της μακεδονιας πολις κολωνια ημεν δε εν ταυτη τη πολει διατριβοντες ημερας τινας
kjv: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

vulg: die autem sabbatorum egressi sumus foras portam iuxta flumen ubi videbatur oratio esse et sedentes loquebamur mulieribus quae convenerant
clem: Die autem sabbatorum egressi sumus foras portam juxta flumen, ubi videbatur oratio esse: et sedentes loquebamur mulieribus qu convenerant.
tr: τη τε ημερα των σαββατων εξηλθομεν εξω της πολεως παρα ποταμον ου ενομιζετο προσευχη ειναι και καθισαντες ελαλουμεν ταις συνελθουσαις γυναιξιν
kjv: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.

vulg: et quaedam mulier nomine Lydia purpuraria civitatis Thyatirenorum colens Deum audivit cuius Dominus aperuit cor intendere his quae dicebantur a Paulo
clem: Et qudam mulier nomine Lydia, purpuraria civitatis Thyatirenorum, colens Deum, audivit: cujus Dominus aperuit cor intendere his qu dicebantur a Paulo.
tr: και τις γυνη ονοματι λυδια πορφυροπωλις πολεως θυατειρων σεβομενη τον θεον ηκουεν ης ο κυριος διηνοιξεν την καρδιαν προσεχειν τοις λαλουμενοις υπο του παυλου
kjv: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

vulg: cum autem baptizata esset et domus eius deprecata est dicens si iudicastis me fidelem Domino esse introite in domum meam et manete et coegit nos
clem: Cum autem baptizata esset, et domus ejus, deprecata est, dicens: Si judicastis me fidelem Domino esse, introite in domum meam, et manete. Et cogit nos.
tr: ως δε εβαπτισθη και ο οικος αυτης παρεκαλεσεν λεγουσα ει κεκρικατε με πιστην τω κυριω ειναι εισελθοντες εις τον οικον μου μεινατε και παρεβιασατο ημας
kjv: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

vulg: factum est autem euntibus nobis ad orationem puellam quandam habentem spiritum pythonem obviare nobis quae quaestum magnum praestabat dominis suis divinando
clem: Factum est autem euntibus nobis ad orationem, puellam quamdam habentem spiritum pythonem obviare nobis, qu qustum magnum prstabat dominis suis divinando.
tr: εγενετο δε πορευομενων ημων εις προσευχην παιδισκην τινα εχουσαν πνευμα πυθωνος απαντησαι ημιν ητις εργασιαν πολλην παρειχεν τοις κυριοις αυτης μαντευομενη
kjv: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

vulg: haec subsecuta Paulum et nos clamabat dicens isti homines servi Dei excelsi sunt qui adnuntiant vobis viam salutis
clem: Hc subsecuta Paulum et nos, clamabat dicens: Isti homines servi Dei excelsi sunt, qui annuntiant vobis viam salutis.
tr: αυτη κατακολουθησασα τω παυλω και ημιν εκραζεν λεγουσα ουτοι οι ανθρωποι δουλοι του θεου του υψιστου εισιν οιτινες καταγγελλουσιν ημιν οδον σωτηριας
kjv: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.

vulg: hoc autem faciebat multis diebus dolens autem Paulus et conversus spiritui dixit praecipio tibi in nomine Iesu Christi exire ab ea et exiit eadem hora
clem: Hoc autem faciebat multis diebus. Dolens autem Paulus, et conversus, spiritui dixit: Prcipio tibi in nomine Jesu Christi exire ab ea. Et exiit eadem hora.
tr: τουτο δε εποιει επι πολλας ημερας διαπονηθεις δε ο παυλος και επιστρεψας τω πνευματι ειπεν παραγγελλω σοι εν τω ονοματι ιησου χριστου εξελθειν απ αυτης και εξηλθεν αυτη τη ωρα
kjv: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

vulg: videntes autem domini eius quia exivit spes quaestus eorum adprehendentes Paulum et Silam perduxerunt in forum ad principes
clem: Videntes autem domini ejus quia exivit spes qustus eorum, apprehendentes Paulum et Silam, perduxerunt in forum ad principes:
tr: ιδοντες δε οι κυριοι αυτης οτι εξηλθεν η ελπις της εργασιας αυτων επιλαβομενοι τον παυλον και τον σιλαν ειλκυσαν εις την αγοραν επι τους αρχοντας
kjv: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,

vulg: et offerentes eos magistratibus dixerunt hii homines conturbant civitatem nostram cum sint Iudaei
clem: et offerentes eos magistratibus, dixerunt: Hi homines conturbant civitatem nostram, cum sint Judi:
tr: και προσαγαγοντες αυτους τοις στρατηγοις ειπον ουτοι οι ανθρωποι εκταρασσουσιν ημων την πολιν ιουδαιοι υπαρχοντες
kjv: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

vulg: et adnuntiant morem quem non licet nobis suscipere neque facere cum simus Romani
clem: et annuntiant morem quem non licet nobis suscipere neque facere, cum simus Romani.
tr: και καταγγελλουσιν εθη α ουκ εξεστιν ημιν παραδεχεσθαι ουδε ποιειν ρωμαιοις ουσιν
kjv: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.

vulg: et concurrit plebs adversus eos et magistratus scissis tunicis eorum iusserunt virgis caedi
clem: Et cucurrit plebs adversus eos: et magistratus, scissis tunicis eorum, jusserunt eos virgis cdi.
tr: και συνεπεστη ο οχλος κατ αυτων και οι στρατηγοι περιρρηξαντες αυτων τα ιματια εκελευον ραβδιζειν
kjv: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.

vulg: et cum multas plagas eis inposuissent miserunt eos in carcerem praecipientes custodi ut diligenter custodiret eos
clem: Et cum multas plagas eis imposuissent, miserunt eos in carcerem, prcipientes custodi ut diligenter custodiret eos.
tr: πολλας τε επιθεντες αυτοις πληγας εβαλον εις φυλακην παραγγειλαντες τω δεσμοφυλακι ασφαλως τηρειν αυτους
kjv: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

vulg: qui cum tale praeceptum accepisset misit eos in interiorem carcerem et pedes eorum strinxit in ligno
clem: Qui cum tale prceptum accepisset, misit eos in interiorem carcerem, et pedes eorum strinxit ligno.
tr: ος παραγγελιαν τοιαυτην ειληφως εβαλεν αυτους εις την εσωτεραν φυλακην και τους ποδας αυτων ησφαλισατο εις το ξυλον
kjv: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

vulg: media autem nocte Paulus et Silas adorantes laudabant Deum et audiebant eos qui in custodia erant
clem: Media autem nocte Paulus et Silas orantes, laudabant Deum: et audiebant eos qui in custodia erant.
tr: κατα δε το μεσονυκτιον παυλος και σιλας προσευχομενοι υμνουν τον θεον επηκροωντο δε αυτων οι δεσμιοι
kjv: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

vulg: subito vero terraemotus factus est magnus ita ut moverentur fundamenta carceris et aperta sunt statim ostia omnia et universorum vincula soluta sunt
clem: Subito vero terrmotus factus est magnus, ita ut moverentur fundamenta carceris. Et statim aperta sunt omnia ostia: et universorum vincula soluta sunt.
tr: αφνω δε σεισμος εγενετο μεγας ωστε σαλευθηναι τα θεμελια του δεσμωτηριου ανεωχθησαν τε παραχρημα αι θυραι πασαι και παντων τα δεσμα ανεθη
kjv: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.

vulg: expergefactus autem custos carceris et videns apertas ianuas carceris evaginato gladio volebat se interficere aestimans fugisse vinctos
clem: Expergefactus autem custos carceris, et videns januas apertas carceris, evaginato gladio volebat se interficere, stimans fugisse vinctos.
tr: εξυπνος δε γενομενος ο δεσμοφυλαξ και ιδων ανεωγμενας τας θυρας της φυλακης σπασαμενος μαχαιραν εμελλεν εαυτον αναιρειν νομιζων εκπεφευγεναι τους δεσμιους
kjv: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.

vulg: clamavit autem Paulus magna voce dicens nihil feceris tibi mali universi enim hic sumus
clem: Clamavit autem Paulus voce magna, dicens: Nihil tibi mali feceris: universi enim hic sumus.
tr: εφωνησεν δε φωνη μεγαλη ο παυλος λεγων μηδεν πραξης σεαυτω κακον απαντες γαρ εσμεν ενθαδε
kjv: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.

vulg: petitoque lumine introgressus est et tremefactus procidit Paulo et Silae
clem: Petitoque lumine, introgressus est: et tremefactus procidit Paulo et Sil ad pedes:
tr: αιτησας δε φωτα εισεπηδησεν και εντρομος γενομενος προσεπεσεν τω παυλω και τω σιλα
kjv: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,

vulg: et producens eos foras ait domini quid me oportet facere ut salvus fiam
clem: et producens eos foras, ait: Domini, quid me oportet facere, ut salvus fiam?
tr: και προαγαγων αυτους εξω εφη κυριοι τι με δει ποιειν ινα σωθω
kjv: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

vulg: at illi dixerunt crede in Domino Iesu et salvus eris tu et domus tua
clem: At illi dixerunt: Crede in Dominum Jesum, et salvus eris tu, et domus tua.
tr: οι δε ειπον πιστευσον επι τον κυριον ιησουν χριστον και σωθηση συ και ο οικος σου
kjv: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

vulg: et locuti sunt ei verbum Domini cum omnibus qui erant in domo eius
clem: Et locuti sunt ei verbum Domini cum omnibus qui erant in domo ejus.
tr: και ελαλησαν αυτω τον λογον του κυριου και πασιν τοις εν τη οικια αυτου
kjv: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

vulg: et tollens eos in illa hora noctis lavit plagas eorum et baptizatus est ipse et omnes eius continuo
clem: Et tollens eos in illa hora noctis, lavit plagas eorum: et baptizatus est ipse, et omnis domus ejus continuo.
tr: και παραλαβων αυτους εν εκεινη τη ωρα της νυκτος ελουσεν απο των πληγων και εβαπτισθη αυτος και οι αυτου παντες παραχρημα
kjv: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.

vulg: cumque perduxisset eos in domum suam adposuit eis mensam et laetatus est cum omni domo sua credens Deo
clem: Cumque perduxisset eos in domum suam, apposuit eis mensam, et ltatus est cum omni domo sua credens Deo.
tr: αναγαγων τε αυτους εις τον οικον αυτου παρεθηκεν τραπεζαν και ηγαλλιασατο πανοικι πεπιστευκως τω θεω
kjv: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.

vulg: et cum dies factus esset miserunt magistratus lictores dicentes dimitte homines illos
clem: Et cum dies factus esset, miserunt magistratus lictores, dicentes: Dimitte homines illos.
tr: ημερας δε γενομενης απεστειλαν οι στρατηγοι τους ραβδουχους λεγοντες απολυσον τους ανθρωπους εκεινους
kjv: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.

vulg: nuntiavit autem custos carceris verba haec Paulo quia miserunt magistratus ut dimittamini nunc igitur exeuntes ite in pace
clem: Nuntiavit autem custos carceris verba hc Paulo: Quia miserunt magistratus ut dimittamini: nunc igitur exeuntes, ite in pace.
tr: απηγγειλεν δε ο δεσμοφυλαξ τους λογους τουτους προς τον παυλον οτι απεσταλκασιν οι στρατηγοι ινα απολυθητε νυν ουν εξελθοντες πορευεσθε εν ειρηνη
kjv: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.

vulg: Paulus autem dixit eis caesos nos publice indemnatos homines romanos miserunt in carcerem et nunc occulte nos eiciunt non ita sed veniant
clem: Paulus autem dixit eis: Csos nos publice, indemnatos homines Romanos, miserunt in carcerem: et nunc occulte nos ejiciunt? Non ita: sed veniant,
tr: ο δε παυλος εφη προς αυτους δειραντες ημας δημοσια ακατακριτους ανθρωπους ρωμαιους υπαρχοντας εβαλον εις φυλακην και νυν λαθρα ημας εκβαλλουσιν ου γαρ αλλα ελθοντες αυτοι ημας εξαγαγετωσαν
kjv: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.

vulg: et ipsi nos eiciant nuntiaverunt autem magistratibus lictores verba haec timueruntque audito quod Romani essent
clem: et ipsi nos ejiciant. Nuntiaverunt autem magistratibus lictores verba hc. Timueruntque audito quod Romani essent:
tr: ανηγγειλαν δε τοις στρατηγοις οι ραβδουχοι τα ρηματα ταυτα και εφοβηθησαν ακουσαντες οτι ρωμαιοι εισιν
kjv: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.

vulg: et venientes deprecati sunt eos et educentes rogabant ut egrederentur urbem
clem: et venientes deprecati sunt eos, et educentes rogabant ut egrederentur de urbe.
tr: και ελθοντες παρεκαλεσαν αυτους και εξαγαγοντες ηρωτων εξελθειν της πολεως
kjv: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.

vulg: exeuntes autem de carcere introierunt ad Lydiam et visis fratribus consolati sunt eos et profecti sunt
clem: Exeuntes autem de carcere, introierunt ad Lydiam: et visis fratribus consolati sunt eos, et profecti sunt.
tr: εξελθοντες δε εκ της φυλακης εισηλθον εις την λυδιαν και ιδοντες τους αδελφους παρεκαλεσαν αυτους και εξηλθον
kjv: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.

vulg: cum autem perambulassent Amphipolim et Apolloniam venerunt Thessalonicam ubi erat synagoga Iudaeorum
clem: Cum autem perambulassent Amphipolim et Apolloniam, venerunt Thessalonicam, ubi erat synagoga Judorum.
tr: διοδευσαντες δε την αμφιπολιν και απολλωνιαν ηλθον εις θεσσαλονικην οπου ην η συναγωγη των ιουδαιων
kjv: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

vulg: secundum consuetudinem autem Paulus introivit ad eos et per sabbata tria disserebat eis de scripturis
clem: Secundum consuetudinem autem Paulus introivit ad eos, et per sabbata tria disserebat eis de Scripturis,
tr: κατα δε το ειωθος τω παυλω εισηλθεν προς αυτους και επι σαββατα τρια διελεγετο αυτοις απο των γραφων
kjv: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,

vulg: adaperiens et insinuans quia Christum oportuit pati et resurgere a mortuis et quia hic est Christus Iesus quem ego adnuntio vobis
clem: adaperiens et insinuans quia Christum oportuit pati, et resurgere a mortuis: et quia hic est Jesus Christus, quem ego annuntio vobis.
tr: διανοιγων και παρατιθεμενος οτι τον χριστον εδει παθειν και αναστηναι εκ νεκρων και οτι ουτος εστιν ο χριστος ιησους ον εγω καταγγελλω υμιν
kjv: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.

vulg: et quidam ex eis crediderunt et adiuncti sunt Paulo et Silae et de colentibus gentilibusque multitudo magna et mulieres nobiles non paucae
clem: Et quidam ex eis crediderunt et adjuncti sunt Paulo et Sil: et de colentibus gentilibusque multitudo magna, et mulieres nobiles non pauc.
tr: και τινες εξ αυτων επεισθησαν και προσεκληρωθησαν τω παυλω και τω σιλα των τε σεβομενων ελληνων πολυ πληθος γυναικων τε των πρωτων ουκ ολιγαι
kjv: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

vulg: zelantes autem Iudaei adsumentesque de vulgo viros quosdam malos et turba facta concitaverunt civitatem et adsistentes domui Iasonis quaerebant eos producere in populum
clem: Zelantes autem Judi, assumentesque de vulgo viros quosdam malos, et turba facta, concitaverunt civitatem: et assistentes domui Jasonis qurebant eos producere in populum.
tr: ζηλωσαντες δε οι απειθουντες ιουδαιοι και προσλαβομενοι των αγοραιων τινας ανδρας πονηρους και οχλοποιησαντες εθορυβουν την πολιν επισταντες τε τη οικια ιασονος εζητουν αυτους αγαγειν εις τον δημον
kjv: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.

vulg: et cum non invenissent eos trahebant Iasonem et quosdam fratres ad principes civitatis clamantes quoniam hii qui orbem concitant et huc venerunt
clem: Et cum non invenissent eos, trahebant Jasonem et quosdam fratres ad principes civitatis, clamantes: Quoniam hi qui urbem concitant, et huc venerunt,
tr: μη ευροντες δε αυτους εσυρον τον ιασονα και τινας αδελφους επι τους πολιταρχας βοωντες οτι οι την οικουμενην αναστατωσαντες ουτοι και ενθαδε παρεισιν
kjv: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;

vulg: quos suscepit Iason et hii omnes contra decreta Caesaris faciunt regem alium dicentes esse Iesum
clem: quos suscepit Jason, et hi omnes contra decreta Csaris faciunt, regem alium dicentes esse, Jesum.
tr: ους υποδεδεκται ιασων και ουτοι παντες απεναντι των δογματων καισαρος πραττουσιν βασιλεα λεγοντες ετερον ειναι ιησουν
kjv: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.

vulg: concitaverunt autem plebem et principes civitatis audientes haec
clem: Concitaverunt autem plebem et principes civitatis audientes hc.
tr: εταραξαν δε τον οχλον και τους πολιταρχας ακουοντας ταυτα
kjv: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.

vulg: et accepto satis ab Iasone et a ceteris dimiserunt eos
clem: Et accepta satisfactione a Jasone et a ceteris, dimiserunt eos.
tr: και λαβοντες το ικανον παρα του ιασονος και των λοιπων απελυσαν αυτους
kjv: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.

vulg: fratres vero confestim per noctem dimiserunt Paulum et Silam in Beroeam qui cum advenissent in synagogam Iudaeorum introierunt
clem: Fratres vero confestim per noctem dimiserunt Paulum et Silam in Beram. Qui cum venissent, in synagogam Judorum introierunt.
tr: οι δε αδελφοι ευθεως δια της νυκτος εξεπεμψαν τον τε παυλον και τον σιλαν εις βεροιαν οιτινες παραγενομενοι εις την συναγωγην των ιουδαιων απηεσαν
kjv: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.

vulg: hii autem erant nobiliores eorum qui sunt Thessalonicae qui susceperunt verbum cum omni aviditate cotidie scrutantes scripturas si haec ita se haberent
clem: Hi autem erant nobiliores eorum qui sunt Thessalonic, qui susceperunt verbum cum omni aviditate, quotidie scrutantes Scripturas, si hc ita se haberent.
tr: ουτοι δε ησαν ευγενεστεροι των εν θεσσαλονικη οιτινες εδεξαντο τον λογον μετα πασης προθυμιας το καθ ημεραν ανακρινοντες τας γραφας ει εχοι ταυτα ουτως
kjv: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

vulg: et multi quidem crediderunt ex eis et gentilium mulierum honestarum et viri non pauci
clem: Et multi quidem crediderunt ex eis, et mulierum gentilium honestarum, et viri non pauci.
tr: πολλοι μεν ουν εξ αυτων επιστευσαν και των ελληνιδων γυναικων των ευσχημονων και ανδρων ουκ ολιγοι
kjv: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

vulg: cum autem cognovissent in Thessalonica Iudaei quia et Beroeae praedicatum est a Paulo verbum Dei venerunt et illuc commoventes et turbantes multitudinem
clem: Cum autem cognovissent in Thessalonica Judi quia et Ber prdicatum est a Paulo verbum Dei, venerunt et illuc commoventes, et turbantes multitudinem.
tr: ως δε εγνωσαν οι απο της θεσσαλονικης ιουδαιοι οτι και εν τη βεροια κατηγγελη υπο του παυλου ο λογος του θεου ηλθον κακει σαλευοντες τους οχλους
kjv: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.

vulg: statimque tunc Paulum dimiserunt fratres ut iret usque ad mare Silas autem et Timotheus remanserunt ibi
clem: Statimque tunc Paulum dimiserunt fratres, ut iret usque ad mare: Silas autem et Timotheus remanserunt ibi.
tr: ευθεως δε τοτε τον παυλον εξαπεστειλαν οι αδελφοι πορευεσθαι ως επι την θαλασσαν υπεμενον δε ο τε σιλας και ο τιμοθεος εκει
kjv: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.

vulg: qui autem deducebant Paulum perduxerunt usque Athenas et accepto mandato ab eo ad Silam et Timotheum ut quam celeriter venirent ad illum profecti sunt
clem: Qui autem deducebant Paulum, perduxerunt eum usque Athenas, et accepto mandato ab eo ad Silam et Timotheum ut quam celeriter venirent ad illum, profecti sunt.
tr: οι δε καθιστωντες τον παυλον ηγαγον αυτον εως αθηνων και λαβοντες εντολην προς τον σιλαν και τιμοθεον ινα ως ταχιστα ελθωσιν προς αυτον εξηεσαν
kjv: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.

vulg: Paulus autem cum Athenis eos expectaret incitabatur spiritus eius in ipso videns idolatriae deditam civitatem
clem: Paulus autem cum Athenis eos exspectaret, incitabatur spiritus ejus in ipso, videns idololatri deditam civitatem.
tr: εν δε ταις αθηναις εκδεχομενου αυτους του παυλου παρωξυνετο το πνευμα αυτου εν αυτω θεωρουντι κατειδωλον ουσαν την πολιν
kjv: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

vulg: disputabat igitur in synagoga cum Iudaeis et colentibus et in foro per omnes dies ad eos qui aderant
clem: Disputabat igitur in synagoga cum Judis et colentibus, et in foro, per omnes dies ad eos qui aderant.
tr: διελεγετο μεν ουν εν τη συναγωγη τοις ιουδαιοις και τοις σεβομενοις και εν τη αγορα κατα πασαν ημεραν προς τους παρατυγχανοντας
kjv: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.

vulg: quidam autem epicurei et stoici philosophi disserebant cum eo et quidam dicebant quid vult seminiverbius hic dicere alii vero novorum daemoniorum videtur adnuntiator esse quia Iesum et resurrectionem adnuntiabat eis
clem: Quidam autem epicurei et stoici philosophi disserebant cum eo, et quidam dicebant: Quid vult seminiverbius hic dicere? Alii vero: Novorum dmoniorum videtur annuntiator esse: quia Jesum et resurrectionem annuntiabat eis.
tr: τινες δε των επικουρειων και των στωικων φιλοσοφων συνεβαλλον αυτω και τινες ελεγον τι αν θελοι ο σπερμολογος ουτος λεγειν οι δε ξενων δαιμονιων δοκει καταγγελευς ειναι οτι τον ιησουν και την αναστασιν αυτοις ευηγγελιζετο
kjv: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.

vulg: et adprehensum eum ad Ariopagum duxerunt dicentes possumus scire quae est haec nova quae a te dicitur doctrina
clem: Et apprehensum eum ad Areopagum duxerunt, dicentes: Possumus scire qu est hc nova, qu a te dicitur, doctrina?
tr: επιλαβομενοι τε αυτου επι τον αρειον παγον ηγαγον λεγοντες δυναμεθα γνωναι τις η καινη αυτη η υπο σου λαλουμενη διδαχη
kjv: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?

vulg: nova enim quaedam infers auribus nostris volumus ergo scire quidnam velint haec esse
clem: nova enim qudam infers auribus nostris: volumus ergo scire quidnam velint hc esse.
tr: ξενιζοντα γαρ τινα εισφερεις εις τας ακοας ημων βουλομεθα ουν γνωναι τι αν θελοι ταυτα ειναι
kjv: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

vulg: Athenienses autem omnes et advenae hospites ad nihil aliud vacabant nisi aut dicere aut audire aliquid novi
clem: (Athenienses autem omnes, et adven hospites, ad nihil aliud vacabant nisi aut dicere aut audire aliquid novi.)
tr: αθηναιοι δε παντες και οι επιδημουντες ξενοι εις ουδεν ετερον ευκαιρουν η λεγειν τι και ακουειν καινοτερον
kjv: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)

vulg: stans autem Paulus in medio Ariopagi ait viri athenienses per omnia quasi superstitiosiores vos video
clem: Stans autem Paulus in medio Areopagi, ait: Viri Athenienses, per omnia quasi superstitiosiores vos video.
tr: σταθεις δε ο παυλος εν μεσω του αρειου παγου εφη ανδρες αθηναιοι κατα παντα ως δεισιδαιμονεστερους υμας θεωρω
kjv: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

vulg: praeteriens enim et videns simulacra vestra inveni et aram in qua scriptum erat ignoto deo quod ergo ignorantes colitis hoc ego adnuntio vobis
clem: Prteriens enim, et videns simulacra vestra, inveni et aram in qua scriptum erat: Ignoto Deo. Quod ergo ignorantes colitis, hoc ego annuntio vobis.
tr: διερχομενος γαρ και αναθεωρων τα σεβασματα υμων ευρον και βωμον εν ω επεγεγραπτο αγνωστω θεω ον ουν αγνοουντες ευσεβειτε τουτον εγω καταγγελλω υμιν
kjv: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, To The Unknown God. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.

vulg: Deus qui fecit mundum et omnia quae in eo sunt hic caeli et terrae cum sit Dominus non in manufactis templis inhabitat
clem: Deus, qui fecit mundum, et omnia qu in eo sunt, hic cli et terr cum sit Dominus, non in manufactis templis habitat,
tr: ο θεος ο ποιησας τον κοσμον και παντα τα εν αυτω ουτος ουρανου και γης κυριος υπαρχων ουκ εν χειροποιητοις ναοις κατοικει
kjv: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;

vulg: nec manibus humanis colitur indigens aliquo cum ipse det omnibus vitam et inspirationem et omnia
clem: nec manibus humanis colitur indigens aliquo, cum ipse det omnibus vitam, et inspirationem, et omnia:
tr: ουδε υπο χειρων ανθρωπων θεραπευεται προσδεομενος τινος αυτος διδους πασιν ζωην και πνοην κατα  και τα  παντα
kjv: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

vulg: fecitque ex uno omne genus hominum inhabitare super universam faciem terrae definiens statuta tempora et terminos habitationis eorum
clem: fecitque ex uno omne genus hominum inhabitare super universam faciem terr, definiens statuta tempora, et terminos habitationis eorum,
tr: εποιησεν τε εξ ενος αιματος παν εθνος ανθρωπων κατοικειν επι παν το προσωπον της γης ορισας προτεταγμενους καιρους και τας οροθεσιας της κατοικιας αυτων
kjv: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;

vulg: quaerere Deum si forte adtractent eum aut inveniant quamvis non longe sit ab unoquoque nostrum
clem: qurere Deum si forte attrectent eum, aut inveniant, quamvis non longe sit ab unoquoque nostrum.
tr: ζητειν τον κυριον ει αρα γε  αραγε  ψηλαφησειαν αυτον και ευροιεν καιτοιγε ου μακραν απο ενος εκαστου ημων υπαρχοντα
kjv: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:

vulg: in ipso enim vivimus et movemur et sumus sicut et quidam vestrum poetarum dixerunt ipsius enim et genus sumus
clem: In ipso enim vivimus, et movemur, et sumus: sicut et quidam vestrorum potarum dixerunt: Ipsius enim et genus sumus.
tr: εν αυτω γαρ ζωμεν και κινουμεθα και εσμεν ως και τινες των καθ υμας ποιητων ειρηκασιν του γαρ και γενος εσμεν
kjv: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

vulg: genus ergo cum simus Dei non debemus aestimare auro aut argento aut lapidi sculpturae artis et cogitationis hominis divinum esse simile
clem: Genus ergo cum simus Dei, non debemus stimare auro, aut argento, aut lapidi, sculptur artis, et cogitationis hominis, divinum esse simile.
tr: γενος ουν υπαρχοντες του θεου ουκ οφειλομεν νομιζειν χρυσω η αργυρω η λιθω χαραγματι τεχνης και ενθυμησεως ανθρωπου το θειον ειναι ομοιον
kjv: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.

vulg: et tempora quidem huius ignorantiae despiciens Deus nunc adnuntiat hominibus ut omnes ubique paenitentiam agant
clem: Et tempora quidem hujus ignoranti despiciens Deus, nunc annuntiat hominibus ut omnes ubique pnitentiam agant,
tr: τους μεν ουν χρονους της αγνοιας υπεριδων ο θεος τα νυν παραγγελλει τοις ανθρωποις πασιν πανταχου μετανοειν
kjv: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:

vulg: eo quod statuit diem in qua iudicaturus est orbem in aequitate in viro in quo statuit fidem praebens omnibus suscitans eum a mortuis
clem: eo quod statuit diem in quo judicaturus est orbem in quitate, in viro in quo statuit, fidem prbens omnibus, suscitans eum a mortuis.
tr: διοτι εστησεν ημεραν εν η μελλει κρινειν την οικουμενην εν δικαιοσυνη εν ανδρι ω ωρισεν πιστιν παρασχων πασιν αναστησας αυτον εκ νεκρων
kjv: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.

vulg: cum audissent autem resurrectionem mortuorum quidam quidem inridebant quidam vero dixerunt audiemus te de hoc iterum
clem: Cum audissent autem resurrectionem mortuorum, quidam quidem irridebant, quidam vero dixerunt: Audiemus te de hoc iterum.
tr: ακουσαντες δε αναστασιν νεκρων οι μεν εχλευαζον οι δε ειπον ακουσομεθα σου παλιν περι τουτου
kjv: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.

vulg: sic Paulus exivit de medio eorum
clem: Sic Paulus exivit de medio eorum.
tr: και ουτως ο παυλος εξηλθεν εκ μεσου αυτων
kjv: So Paul departed from among them.

vulg: quidam vero viri adherentes ei crediderunt in quibus et Dionisius Ariopagita et mulier nomine Damaris et alii cum eis
clem: Quidam vero viri adhrentes ei, crediderunt: in quibus et Dionysius Areopagita, et mulier nomine Damaris, et alii cum eis.
tr: τινες δε ανδρες κολληθεντες αυτω επιστευσαν εν οις και διονυσιος ο αρεοπαγιτης και γυνη ονοματι δαμαρις και ετεροι συν αυτοις
kjv: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

vulg: post haec egressus ab Athenis venit Corinthum
clem: Post hc egressus ab Athenis, venit Corinthum:
tr: μετα δε ταυτα χωρισθεις ο παυλος εκ των αθηνων ηλθεν εις κορινθον
kjv: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;

vulg: et inveniens quendam Iudaeum nomine Aquilam Ponticum genere qui nuper venerat ab Italia et Priscillam uxorem eius eo quod praecepisset Claudius discedere omnes Iudaeos a Roma accessit ad eos
clem: et inveniens quemdam Judum nomine Aquilam, Ponticum genere, qui nuper venerat ab Italia, et Priscillam uxorem ejus (eo quod prcepisset Claudius discedere omnes Judos a Roma), accessit ad eos.
tr: και ευρων τινα ιουδαιον ονοματι ακυλαν ποντικον τω γενει προσφατως εληλυθοτα απο της ιταλιας και πρισκιλλαν γυναικα αυτου δια το διατεταχεναι κλαυδιον χωριζεσθαι παντας τους ιουδαιους εκ της ρωμης προσηλθεν αυτοις
kjv: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

vulg: et quia eiusdem erat artis manebat apud eos et operabatur erat autem scenofactoriae artis
clem: Et quia ejusdem erat artis, manebat apud eos, et operabatur. (Erant autem scenofactori artis.)
tr: και δια το ομοτεχνον ειναι εμενεν παρ αυτοις και ειργαζετο ησαν γαρ σκηνοποιοι την τεχνην
kjv: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

clem: Et disputabat in synagoga per omne sabbatum, interponens nomen Domini Jesu: suadebatque Judis et Grcis.
tr: διελεγετο δε εν τη συναγωγη κατα παν σαββατον επειθεν τε ιουδαιους και ελληνας
kjv: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.

vulg: cum venissent autem de Macedonia Silas et Timotheus instabat verbo Paulus testificans Iudaeis esse Christum Iesum
clem: Cum venissent autem de Macedonia Silas et Timotheus, instabat verbo Paulus, testificans Judis esse Christum Jesum.
tr: ως δε κατηλθον απο της μακεδονιας ο τε σιλας και ο τιμοθεος συνειχετο τω πνευματι ο παυλος διαμαρτυρομενος τοις ιουδαιοις τον χριστον ιησουν
kjv: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

vulg: contradicentibus autem eis et blasphemantibus excutiens vestimenta dixit ad eos sanguis vester super caput vestrum mundus ego ex hoc ad gentes vadam
clem: Contradicentibus autem eis, et blasphemantibus, excutiens vestimenta sua, dixit ad eos: Sanguis vester super caput vestrum: mundus ego: ex hoc ad gentes vadam.
tr: αντιτασσομενων δε αυτων και βλασφημουντων εκτιναξαμενος τα ιματια ειπεν προς αυτους το αιμα υμων επι την κεφαλην υμων καθαρος εγω απο του νυν εις τα εθνη πορευσομαι
kjv: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean; from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.

vulg: et migrans inde intravit in domum cuiusdam nomine Titi Iusti colentis Deum cuius domus erat coniuncta synagogae
clem: Et migrans inde, intravit in domum cujusdam, nomine Titi Justi, colentis Deum, cujus domus erat conjuncta synagog.
tr: και μεταβας εκειθεν ηλθεν εις οικιαν τινος ονοματι ιουστου σεβομενου τον θεον ου η οικια ην συνομορουσα τη συναγωγη
kjv: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.

vulg: Crispus autem archisynagogus credidit Domino cum omni domo sua et multi Corinthiorum audientes credebant et baptizabantur
clem: Crispus autem archisynagogus credidit Domino cum omni domo sua: et multi Corinthiorum audientes credebant, et baptizabantur.
tr: κρισπος δε ο αρχισυναγωγος επιστευσεν τω κυριω συν ολω τω οικω αυτου και πολλοι των κορινθιων ακουοντες επιστευον και εβαπτιζοντο
kjv: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.

vulg: dixit autem Dominus nocte per visionem Paulo noli timere sed loquere et ne taceas
clem: Dixit autem Dominus nocte per visionem Paulo: Noli timere, sed loquere, et ne taceas:
tr: ειπεν δε ο κυριος δι οραματος εν νυκτι τω παυλω μη φοβου αλλα λαλει και μη σιωπησης
kjv: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:

vulg: propter quod ego sum tecum et nemo adponetur tibi ut noceat te quoniam populus est mihi multus in hac civitate
clem: propter quod ego sum tecum, et nemo apponetur tibi ut noceat te: quoniam populus est mihi multus in hac civitate.
tr: διοτι εγω ειμι μετα σου και ουδεις επιθησεται σοι του κακωσαι σε διοτι λαος εστιν μοι πολυς εν τη πολει ταυτη
kjv: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.

vulg: sedit autem annum et sex menses docens apud eos verbum Dei
clem: Sedit autem ibi annum et sex menses, docens apud eos verbum Dei.
tr: εκαθισεν τε ενιαυτον και μηνας εξ διδασκων εν αυτοις τον λογον του θεου
kjv: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

vulg: Gallione autem proconsule Achaiae insurrexerunt uno animo Iudaei in Paulum et adduxerunt eum ad tribunal
clem: Gallione autem proconsule Achai, insurrexerunt uno animo Judi in Paulum, et adduxerunt eum ad tribunal,
tr: γαλλιωνος δε ανθυπατευοντος της αχαιας κατεπεστησαν ομοθυμαδον οι ιουδαιοι τω παυλω και ηγαγον αυτον επι το βημα
kjv: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,

vulg: dicentes quia contra legem hic persuadet hominibus colere Deum
clem: dicentes: Quia contra legem hic persuadet hominibus colere Deum.
tr: λεγοντες οτι παρα τον νομον ουτος αναπειθει τους ανθρωπους σεβεσθαι τον θεον
kjv: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.

vulg: incipiente autem Paulo aperire os dixit Gallio ad Iudaeos si quidem esset iniquum aliquid aut facinus pessimum o viri iudaei recte vos sustinerem
clem: Incipiente autem Paulo aperire os, dixit Gallio ad Judos: Si quidem esset iniquum aliquid aut facinus pessimum, o viri Judi, recte vos sustinerem.
tr: μελλοντος δε του παυλου ανοιγειν το στομα ειπεν ο γαλλιων προς τους ιουδαιους ει μεν ουν ην αδικημα τι η ραδιουργημα πονηρον ω ιουδαιοι κατα λογον αν ηνεσχομην υμων
kjv: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:

vulg: si vero quaestiones sunt de verbo et nominibus et legis vestrae vos ipsi videritis iudex ego horum nolo esse
clem: Si vero qustiones sunt de verbo, et nominibus, et lege vestra, vos ipsi videritis: judex ego horum nolo esse.
tr: ει δε ζητημα εστιν περι λογου και ονοματων και νομου του καθ υμας οψεσθε αυτοι κριτης γαρ εγω τουτων ου βουλομαι ειναι
kjv: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.

vulg: et minavit eos a tribunali
clem: Et minavit eos a tribunali.
tr: και απηλασεν αυτους απο του βηματος
kjv: And he drave them from the judgment seat.

vulg: adprehendentes autem omnes Sosthenen principem synagogae percutiebant ante tribunal et nihil eorum Gallioni curae erat
clem: Apprehendentes autem omnes Sosthenem principem synagog, percutiebant eum ante tribunal: et nihil eorum Gallioni cur erat.
tr: επιλαβομενοι δε παντες οι ελληνες σωσθενην τον αρχισυναγωγον ετυπτον εμπροσθεν του βηματος και ουδεν τουτων τω γαλλιωνι εμελεν
kjv: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.

vulg: Paulus vero cum adhuc sustinuisset dies multos fratribus valefaciens navigavit Syriam et cum eo Priscilla et Aquila qui sibi totonderat in Cencris caput habebat enim votum
clem: Paulus vero cum adhuc sustinuisset dies multos fratribus valefaciens, navigavit in Syriam (et cum eo Priscilla et Aquila), qui sibi totonderat in Cenchris caput: habebat enim votum.
tr: ο δε παυλος ετι προσμεινας ημερας ικανας τοις αδελφοις αποταξαμενος εξεπλει εις την συριαν και συν αυτω πρισκιλλα και ακυλας κειραμενος την κεφαλην εν κεγχρεαις ειχεν γαρ ευχην
kjv: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.

vulg: devenitque Ephesum et illos ibi reliquit ipse vero ingressus synagogam disputavit cum Iudaeis
clem: Devenitque Ephesum, et illos ibi reliquit. Ipse vero ingressus synagogam, disputabat cum Judis.
tr: κατηντησεν δε εις εφεσον κακεινους κατελιπεν αυτου αυτος δε εισελθων εις την συναγωγην διελεχθη τοις ιουδαιοις
kjv: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

vulg: rogantibus autem eis ut ampliori tempore maneret non consensit
clem: Rogantibus autem eis ut ampliori tempore maneret, non consensit,
tr: ερωτωντων δε αυτων επι πλειονα χρονον μειναι παρ αυτοις ουκ επενευσεν
kjv: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;

vulg: sed valefaciens et dicens iterum revertar ad vos Deo volente profectus est ab Epheso
clem: sed valefaciens, et dicens: Iterum revertar ad vos, Deo volente: profectus est ab Epheso.
tr: αλλ απεταξατο αυτοις ειπων δει με παντως την εορτην την ερχομενην ποιησαι εις ιεροσολυμα παλιν δε ανακαμψω προς υμας του θεου θελοντος και ανηχθη απο της εφεσου
kjv: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

vulg: et descendens Caesaream ascendit et salutavit ecclesiam et descendit Antiochiam
clem: Et descendens Csaream, ascendit, et salutavit ecclesiam, et descendit Antiochiam.
tr: και κατελθων εις καισαρειαν αναβας και ασπασαμενος την εκκλησιαν κατεβη εις αντιοχειαν
kjv: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.

vulg: et facto ibi aliquanto tempore profectus est perambulans ex ordine galaticam regionem et Frygiam confirmans omnes discipulos
clem: Et facto ibi aliquanto tempore profectus est, perambulans ex ordine Galaticam regionem, et Phrygiam, confirmans omnes discipulos.
tr: και ποιησας χρονον τινα εξηλθεν διερχομενος καθεξης την γαλατικην χωραν και φρυγιαν επιστηριζων παντας τους μαθητας
kjv: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.

vulg: Iudaeus autem quidam Apollo nomine Alexandrinus natione vir eloquens devenit Ephesum potens in scripturis
clem: Judus autem quidam, Apollo nomine, Alexandrinus genere, vir eloquens, devenit Ephesum, potens in scripturis.
tr: ιουδαιος δε τις απολλως ονοματι αλεξανδρευς τω γενει ανηρ λογιος κατηντησεν εις εφεσον δυνατος ων εν ταις γραφαις
kjv: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

vulg: hic erat edoctus viam Domini et fervens spiritu loquebatur et docebat diligenter ea quae sunt Iesu sciens tantum baptisma Iohannis
clem: Hic erat edoctus viam Domini: et fervens spiritu loquebatur, et docebat diligenter ea qu sunt Jesu, sciens tantum baptisma Joannis.
tr: ουτος ην κατηχημενος την οδον του κυριου και ζεων τω πνευματι ελαλει και εδιδασκεν ακριβως τα περι του κυριου επισταμενος μονον το βαπτισμα ιωαννου
kjv: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.

vulg: hic ergo coepit fiducialiter agere in synagoga quem cum audissent Priscilla et Aquila adsumpserunt eum et diligentius exposuerunt ei viam Dei
clem: Hic ergo cpit fiducialiter agere in synagoga. Quem cum audissent Priscilla et Aquila, assumpserunt eum, et diligentius exposuerunt ei viam Domini.
tr: ουτος τε ηρξατο παρρησιαζεσθαι εν τη συναγωγη ακουσαντες δε αυτου ακυλας και πρισκιλλα προσελαβοντο αυτον και ακριβεστερον αυτω εξεθεντο την του θεου οδον
kjv: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

vulg: cum autem vellet ire Achaiam exhortati fratres scripserunt discipulis ut susciperent eum qui cum venisset contulit multum his qui crediderant
clem: Cum autem vellet ire Achaiam, exhortati fratres, scripserunt discipulis ut susciperent eum. Qui cum venisset, contulit multum his qui crediderant.
tr: βουλομενου δε αυτου διελθειν εις την αχαιαν προτρεψαμενοι οι αδελφοι εγραψαν τοις μαθηταις αποδεξασθαι αυτον ος παραγενομενος συνεβαλετο πολυ τοις πεπιστευκοσιν δια της χαριτος
kjv: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:

vulg: vehementer enim Iudaeos revincebat publice ostendens per scripturas esse Christum Iesum
clem: Vehementer enim Judos revincebat publice, ostendens per Scripturas esse Christum Jesum.
tr: ευτονως γαρ τοις ιουδαιοις διακατηλεγχετο δημοσια επιδεικνυς δια των γραφων ειναι τον χριστον ιησουν
kjv: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publicly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.

vulg: factum est autem cum Apollo esset Corinthi ut Paulus peragratis superioribus partibus veniret Ephesum et inveniret quosdam discipulos
clem: Factum est autem cum Apollo esset Corinthi, ut Paulus peragratis superioribus partibus veniret Ephesum, et inveniret quosdam discipulos:
tr: εγενετο δε εν τω τον απολλω ειναι εν κορινθω παυλον διελθοντα τα ανωτερικα μερη ελθειν εις εφεσον και ευρων τινας μαθητας
kjv: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

vulg: dixitque ad eos si Spiritum Sanctum accepistis credentes at illi ad eum sed neque si Spiritus Sanctus est audivimus
clem: dixitque ad eos: Si Spiritum Sanctum accepistis credentes? At illi dixerunt ad eum: Sed neque si Spiritus Sanctus est, audivimus.
tr: ειπεν προς αυτους ει πνευμα αγιον ελαβετε πιστευσαντες οι δε ειπον προς αυτον αλλ ουδε ει πνευμα αγιον εστιν ηκουσαμεν
kjv: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.

vulg: ille vero ait in quo ergo baptizati estis qui dixerunt in Iohannis baptismate
clem: Ille vero ait: In quo ergo baptizati estis? Qui dixerunt: In Joannis baptismate.
tr: ειπεν τε προς αυτους εις τι ουν εβαπτισθητε οι δε ειπον εις το ιωαννου βαπτισμα
kjv: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.

vulg: dixit autem Paulus Iohannes baptizavit baptisma paenitentiae populum dicens in eum qui venturus esset post ipsum ut crederent hoc est in Iesum
clem: Dixit autem Paulus: Joannes baptizavit baptismo pnitenti populum, dicens in eum qui venturus esset post ipsum ut crederent, hoc est, in Jesum.
tr: ειπεν δε παυλος ιωαννης μεν εβαπτισεν βαπτισμα μετανοιας τω λαω λεγων εις τον ερχομενον μετ αυτον ινα πιστευσωσιν τουτ εστιν εις τον χριστον ιησουν
kjv: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.

vulg: his auditis baptizati sunt in nomine Domini Iesu
clem: His auditis, baptizati sunt in nomine Domini Jesu.
tr: ακουσαντες δε εβαπτισθησαν εις το ονομα του κυριου ιησου
kjv: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

vulg: et cum inposuisset illis manum Paulus venit Spiritus Sanctus super eos et loquebantur linguis et prophetabant
