clem: Et cum imposuisset illis manus Paulus, venit Spiritus Sanctus super eos, et loquebantur linguis, et prophetabant.
tr: και επιθεντος αυτοις του παυλου τας χειρας ηλθεν το πνευμα το αγιον επ αυτους ελαλουν τε γλωσσαις και προεφητευον
kjv: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.

vulg: erant autem omnes viri fere duodecim
clem: Erant autem omnes viri fere duodecim.
tr: ησαν δε οι παντες ανδρες ωσει δεκαδυο
kjv: And all the men were about twelve.

vulg: introgressus autem synagogam cum fiducia loquebatur per tres menses disputans et suadens de regno Dei
clem: Introgressus autem synagogam, cum fiducia loquebatur per tres menses, disputans et suadens de regno Dei.
tr: εισελθων δε εις την συναγωγην επαρρησιαζετο επι μηνας τρεις διαλεγομενος και πειθων τα περι της βασιλειας του θεου
kjv: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.

vulg: cum autem quidam indurarentur et non crederent maledicentes viam coram multitudine discedens ab eis segregavit discipulos cotidie disputans in scola Tyranni
clem: Cum autem quidam indurarentur, et non crederent, maledicentes viam Domini coram multitudine, discedens ab eis, segregavit discipulos, quotidie disputans in schola tyranni cujusdam.
tr: ως δε τινες εσκληρυνοντο και ηπειθουν κακολογουντες την οδον ενωπιον του πληθους αποστας απ αυτων αφωρισεν τους μαθητας καθ ημεραν διαλεγομενος εν τη σχολη τυραννου τινος
kjv: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.

vulg: hoc autem factum est per biennium ita ut omnes qui habitabant in Asia audirent verbum Domini Iudaei atque gentiles
clem: Hoc autem factum est per biennium, ita ut omnes qui habitabant in Asia audirent verbum Domini, Judi atque gentiles.
tr: τουτο δε εγενετο επι ετη δυο ωστε παντας τους κατοικουντας την ασιαν ακουσαι τον λογον του κυριου ιησου ιουδαιους τε και ελληνας
kjv: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

vulg: virtutesque non quaslibet Deus faciebat per manus Pauli
clem: Virtutesque non quaslibet faciebat Deus per manum Pauli,
tr: δυναμεις τε ου τας τυχουσας εποιει ο θεος δια των χειρων παυλου
kjv: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:

vulg: ita ut etiam super languidos deferrentur a corpore eius sudaria vel semicintia et recedebant ab eis languores et spiritus nequam egrediebantur
clem: ita ut etiam super languidos deferrentur a corpore ejus sudaria et semicinctia, et recedebant ab eis languores, et spiritus nequam egrediebantur.
tr: ωστε και επι τους ασθενουντας επιφερεσθαι απο του χρωτος αυτου σουδαρια η σιμικινθια και απαλλασσεσθαι απ αυτων τας νοσους τα τε πνευματα τα πονηρα εξερχεσθαι απ αυτων
kjv: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.

vulg: temptaverunt autem quidam et de circumeuntibus iudaeis exorcistis invocare super eos qui habebant spiritus malos nomen Domini Iesu dicentes adiuro vos per Iesum quem Paulus praedicat
clem: Tentaverunt autem quidam et de circumeuntibus Judis exorcistis invocare super eos qui habebant spiritus malos nomen Domini Jesu, dicentes: Adjuro vos per Jesum, quem Paulus prdicat.
tr: επεχειρησαν δε τινες απο των περιερχομενων ιουδαιων εξορκιστων ονομαζειν επι τους εχοντας τα πνευματα τα πονηρα το ονομα του κυριου ιησου λεγοντες ορκιζομεν υμας τον ιησουν ον ο παυλος κηρυσσει
kjv: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.

vulg: erant autem quidam Scevae Iudaei principis sacerdotum septem filii qui hoc faciebant
clem: Erant autem quidam Judi, Scev principis sacerdotum septem filii, qui hoc faciebant.
tr: ησαν δε τινες υιοι σκευα ιουδαιου αρχιερεως επτα οι τουτο ποιουντες
kjv: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.

vulg: respondens autem spiritus nequam dixit eis Iesum novi et Paulum scio vos autem qui estis
clem: Respondens autem spiritus nequam dixit eis: Jesum novi, et Paulum scio: vos autem qui estis?
tr: αποκριθεν δε το πνευμα το πονηρον ειπεν τον ιησουν γινωσκω και τον παυλον επισταμαι υμεις δε τινες εστε
kjv: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?

vulg: et insiliens homo in eos in quo erat daemonium pessimum et dominatus amborum invaluit contra eos ita ut nudi et vulnerati effugerent de domo illa
clem: Et insiliens in eos homo, in quo erat dmonium pessimum, et dominatus amborum, invaluit contra eos, ita ut nudi et vulnerati effugerent de domo illa.
tr: και εφαλλομενος επ αυτους ο ανθρωπος εν ω ην το πνευμα το πονηρον και κατακυριευσας αυτων ισχυσεν κατ αυτων ωστε γυμνους και τετραυματισμενους εκφυγειν εκ του οικου εκεινου
kjv: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

vulg: hoc autem notum factum est omnibus Iudaeis atque gentilibus qui habitabant Ephesi et cecidit timor super omnes illos et magnificabatur nomen Domini Iesu
clem: Hoc autem notum factum est omnibus Judis, atque gentilibus qui habitabant Ephesi: et cecidit timor super omnes illos, et magnificabatur nomen Domini Jesu.
tr: τουτο δε εγενετο γνωστον πασιν ιουδαιοις τε και ελλησιν τοις κατοικουσιν την εφεσον και επεπεσεν φοβος επι παντας αυτους και εμεγαλυνετο το ονομα του κυριου ιησου
kjv: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

vulg: multique credentium veniebant confitentes et adnuntiantes actus suos
clem: Multique credentium veniebant, confitentes et annuntiantes actus suos.
tr: πολλοι τε των πεπιστευκοτων ηρχοντο εξομολογουμενοι και αναγγελλοντες τας πραξεις αυτων
kjv: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.

vulg: multi autem ex his qui fuerant curiosa sectati contulerunt libros et conbuserunt coram omnibus et conputatis pretiis illorum invenerunt pecuniam denariorum quinquaginta milium
clem: Multi autem ex eis, qui fuerant curiosa sectati, contulerunt libros, et combusserunt coram omnibus: et computatis pretiis illorum, invenerunt pecuniam denariorum quinquaginta millium.
tr: ικανοι δε των τα περιεργα πραξαντων συνενεγκαντες τας βιβλους κατεκαιον ενωπιον παντων και συνεψηφισαν τας τιμας αυτων και ευρον αργυριου μυριαδας πεντε
kjv: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.

vulg: ita fortiter verbum Dei crescebat et confirmabatur
clem: Ita fortiter crescebat verbum Dei, et confirmabatur.
tr: ουτως κατα κρατος ο λογος του κυριου ηυξανεν και ισχυεν
kjv: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.

vulg: his autem expletis posuit Paulus in Spiritu transita Macedonia et Achaia ire Hierosolymam dicens quoniam postquam fuero ibi oportet me et Romam videre
clem: His autem expletis, proposuit Paulus in Spiritu, transita Macedonia et Achaia, ire Jerosolymam, dicens: Quoniam postquam fuero ibi, oportet me et Romam videre.
tr: ως δε επληρωθη ταυτα εθετο ο παυλος εν τω πνευματι διελθων την μακεδονιαν και αχαιαν πορευεσθαι εις ιερουσαλημ ειπων οτι μετα το γενεσθαι με εκει δει με και ρωμην ιδειν
kjv: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.

vulg: mittens autem in Macedoniam duos ex ministrantibus sibi Timotheum et Erastum ipse remansit ad tempus in Asia
clem: Mittens autem in Macedoniam duos ex ministrantibus sibi, Timotheum et Erastum, ipse remansit ad tempus in Asia.
tr: αποστειλας δε εις την μακεδονιαν δυο των διακονουντων αυτω τιμοθεον και εραστον αυτος επεσχεν χρονον εις την ασιαν
kjv: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.

vulg: facta est autem in illo tempore turbatio non minima de via
clem: Facta est autem illo tempore turbatio non minima de via Domini.
tr: εγενετο δε κατα τον καιρον εκεινον ταραχος ουκ ολιγος περι της οδου
kjv: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.

vulg: Demetrius enim quidam nomine argentarius faciens aedes argenteas Dianae praestabat artificibus non modicum quaestum
clem: Demetrius enim quidam nomine, argentarius, faciens des argenteas Dian, prstabat artificibus non modicum qustum:
tr: δημητριος γαρ τις ονοματι αργυροκοπος ποιων ναους αργυρους αρτεμιδος παρειχετο τοις τεχνιταις εργασιαν ουκ ολιγην
kjv: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;

vulg: quos convocans et eos qui eiusmodi erant opifices dixit viri scitis quia de hoc artificio adquisitio est nobis
clem: quos convocans, et eos qui hujusmodi erant opifices, dixit: Viri, scitis quia de hoc artificio est nobis acquisitio:
tr: ους συναθροισας και τους περι τα τοιαυτα εργατας ειπεν ανδρες επιστασθε οτι εκ ταυτης της εργασιας η ευπορια ημων εστιν
kjv: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.

vulg: et videtis et auditis quia non solum Ephesi sed paene totius Asiae Paulus hic suadens avertit multam turbam dicens quoniam non sunt dii qui manibus fiunt
clem: et videtis et auditis quia non solum Ephesi, sed pene totius Asi, Paulus hic suadens avertit multam turbam, dicens: Quoniam non sunt dii, qui manibus fiunt.
tr: και θεωρειτε και ακουετε οτι ου μονον εφεσου αλλα σχεδον πασης της ασιας ο παυλος ουτος πεισας μετεστησεν ικανον οχλον λεγων οτι ουκ εισιν θεοι οι δια χειρων γινομενοι
kjv: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:

vulg: non solum autem haec periclitabitur nobis pars in redargutionem venire sed et magnae deae Dianae templum in nihilum reputabitur sed et destrui incipiet maiestas eius quam tota Asia et orbis colit
clem: Non solum autem hc periclitabitur nobis pars in redargutionem venire, sed et magn Dian templum in nihilum reputabitur, sed et destrui incipiet majestas ejus, quam tota Asia et orbis colit.
tr: ου μονον δε τουτο κινδυνευει ημιν το μερος εις απελεγμον ελθειν αλλα και το της μεγαλης θεας αρτεμιδος ιερον εις ουδεν λογισθηναι μελλειν δε  τε  και καθαιρεισθαι την μεγαλειοτητα αυτης ην ολη η ασια και η οικουμενη σεβεται
kjv: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.

vulg: his auditis repleti sunt ira et exclamaverunt dicentes magna Diana Ephesiorum
clem: His auditis, repleti sunt ira, et exclamaverunt dicentes: Magna Diana Ephesiorum.
tr: ακουσαντες δε και γενομενοι πληρεις θυμου εκραζον λεγοντες μεγαλη η αρτεμις εφεσιων
kjv: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

vulg: et impleta est civitas confusione et impetum fecerunt uno animo in theatrum rapto Gaio et Aristarcho Macedonibus comitibus Pauli
clem: Et impleta est civitas confusione, et impetum fecerunt uno animo in theatrum, rapto Gajo et Aristarcho Macedonibus, comitibus Pauli.
tr: και επλησθη η πολις ολη συγχυσεως ωρμησαν τε ομοθυμαδον εις το θεατρον συναρπασαντες γαιον και αρισταρχον μακεδονας συνεκδημους του παυλου
kjv: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

vulg: Paulo autem volente intrare in populum non permiserunt discipuli
clem: Paulo autem volente intrare in populum, non permiserunt discipuli.
tr: του δε παυλου βουλομενου εισελθειν εις τον δημον ουκ ειων αυτον οι μαθηται
kjv: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.

vulg: quidam autem et de Asiae principibus qui erant amici eius miserunt ad eum rogantes ne se daret in theatrum
clem: Quidam autem et de Asi principibus, qui erant amici ejus, miserunt ad eum rogantes ne se daret in theatrum:
tr: τινες δε και των ασιαρχων οντες αυτω φιλοι πεμψαντες προς αυτον παρεκαλουν μη δουναι εαυτον εις το θεατρον
kjv: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.

vulg: alii autem aliud clamabant erat enim ecclesia confusa et plures nesciebant qua ex causa convenissent
clem: alii autem aliud clamabant. Erat enim ecclesia confusa: et plures nesciebant qua ex causa convenissent.
tr: αλλοι μεν ουν αλλο τι εκραζον ην γαρ η εκκλησια συγκεχυμενη και οι πλειους ουκ ηδεισαν τινος ενεκεν συνεληλυθεισαν
kjv: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused: and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.

vulg: de turba autem detraxerunt Alexandrum propellentibus eum Iudaeis Alexander ergo manu silentio postulato volebat rationem reddere populo
clem: De turba autem detraxerunt Alexandrum, propellentibus eum Judis. Alexander autem manu silentio postulato, volebat reddere rationem populo.
tr: εκ δε του οχλου προεβιβασαν αλεξανδρον προβαλοντων  προβαλλοντων  αυτον των ιουδαιων ο δε αλεξανδρος κατασεισας την χειρα ηθελεν απολογεισθαι τω δημω
kjv: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.

vulg: quem ut cognoverunt Iudaeum esse vox facta est una omnium quasi per horas duas clamantium magna Diana Ephesiorum
clem: Quem ut cognoverunt Judum esse, vox facta una est omnium, quasi per horas duas clamantium: Magna Diana Ephesiorum.
tr: επιγνοντων δε οτι ιουδαιος εστιν φωνη εγενετο μια εκ παντων ως επι ωρας δυο κραζοντων μεγαλη η αρτεμις εφεσιων
kjv: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

vulg: et cum sedasset scriba turbas dixit viri ephesii quis enim est hominum qui nesciat Ephesiorum civitatem cultricem esse magnae Dianae Iovisque prolis
clem: Et cum sedasset scriba turbas, dixit: Viri Ephesii, quis enim est hominum, qui nesciat Ephesiorum civitatem cultricem esse magn Dian, Jovisque prolis?
tr: καταστειλας δε ο γραμματευς τον οχλον φησιν ανδρες εφεσιοι τις γαρ εστιν ανθρωπος ος ου γινωσκει την εφεσιων πολιν νεωκορον ουσαν της μεγαλης θεας αρτεμιδος και του διοπετους
kjv: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?

vulg: cum ergo his contradici non possit oportet vos sedatos esse et nihil temere agere
clem: Cum ergo his contradici non possit, oportet vos sedatos esse, et nihil temere agere.
tr: αναντιρρητων ουν οντων τουτων δεον εστιν υμας κατεσταλμενους υπαρχειν και μηδεν προπετες πραττειν
kjv: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.

vulg: adduxistis enim homines istos neque sacrilegos neque blasphemantes deam vestram
clem: Adduxistis enim homines istos, neque sacrilegos, neque blasphemantes deam vestram.
tr: ηγαγετε γαρ τους ανδρας τουτους ουτε ιεροσυλους ουτε βλασφημουντας την θεαν υμων
kjv: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.

vulg: quod si Demetrius et qui cum eo sunt artifices habent adversus aliquem causam conventus forenses aguntur et pro consulibus sunt accusent invicem
clem: Quod si Demetrius et qui cum eo sunt artifices, habent adversus aliquem causam, conventus forenses aguntur, et proconsules sunt: accusent invicem.
tr: ει μεν ουν δημητριος και οι συν αυτω τεχνιται προς τινα λογον εχουσιν αγοραιοι αγονται και ανθυπατοι εισιν εγκαλειτωσαν αλληλοις
kjv: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.

vulg: si quid autem alterius rei quaeritis in legitima ecclesia poterit absolvi
clem: Si quid autem alterius rei quritis, in legitima ecclesia poterit absolvi.
tr: ει δε τι περι ετερων επιζητειτε εν τη εννομω εκκλησια επιλυθησεται
kjv: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.

vulg: nam et periclitamur argui seditionis hodiernae cum nullus obnoxius sit de quo non possimus reddere rationem concursus istius et cum haec dixisset dimisit ecclesiam
clem: Nam et periclitamur argui seditionis hodiern, cum nullus obnoxius sit de quo possimus reddere rationem concursus istius. Et cum hc dixisset, dimisit ecclesiam.
tr: και γαρ κινδυνευομεν εγκαλεισθαι στασεως περι της σημερον μηδενος αιτιου υπαρχοντος περι ου δυνησομεθα αποδουναι λογον της συστροφης ταυτης
kjv: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.

tr: και ταυτα ειπων απελυσεν την εκκλησιαν
kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

vulg: postquam autem cessavit tumultus vocatis Paulus discipulis et exhortatus eos valedixit et profectus est ut iret in Macedoniam
clem: Postquam autem cessavit tumultus, vocatis Paulus discipulis, et exhortatus eos, valedixit, et profectus est ut iret in Macedoniam.
tr: μετα δε το παυσασθαι τον θορυβον προσκαλεσαμενος ο παυλος τους μαθητας και ασπασαμενος εξηλθεν πορευθηναι εις την μακεδονιαν
kjv: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.

vulg: cum autem perambulasset partes illas et exhortatus eos fuisset multo sermone venit ad Graeciam
clem: Cum autem perambulasset partes illas, et exhortatus eos fuisset multo sermone, venit ad Grciam:
tr: διελθων δε τα μερη εκεινα και παρακαλεσας αυτους λογω πολλω ηλθεν εις την ελλαδα
kjv: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,

vulg: ubi cum fecisset menses tres factae sunt illi insidiae a Iudaeis navigaturo in Syriam habuitque consilium ut reverteretur per Macedoniam
clem: ubi cum fecisset menses tres, fact sunt illi insidi a Judis navigaturo in Syriam: habuitque consilium ut reverteretur per Macedoniam.
tr: ποιησας τε μηνας τρεις γενομενης αυτω επιβουλης υπο των ιουδαιων μελλοντι αναγεσθαι εις την συριαν εγενετο γνωμη του υποστρεφειν δια μακεδονιας
kjv: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.

vulg: comitatus est autem eum Sopater Pyrri Beroensis Thessalonicensium vero Aristarchus et Secundus et Gaius Derbeus et Timotheus Asiani vero Tychicus et Trophimus
clem: Comitatus est autem eum Sopater Pyrrhi Berensis, Thessalonicensium vero Aristarchus, et Secundus, et Gajus Derbeus, et Timotheus: Asiani vero Tychicus et Trophimus.
tr: συνειπετο δε αυτω αχρι της ασιας σωπατρος βεροιαιος θεσσαλονικεων δε αρισταρχος και σεκουνδος και γαιος δερβαιος και τιμοθεος ασιανοι δε τυχικος και τροφιμος
kjv: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

vulg: hii cum praecessissent sustinebant nos Troade
clem: Hi cum prcessissent, sustinuerunt nos Troade:
tr: ουτοι προελθοντες εμενον ημας εν τρωαδι
kjv: These going before tarried for us at Troas.

vulg: nos vero navigavimus post dies azymorum a Philippis et venimus ad eos Troadem in diebus quinque ubi demorati sumus diebus septem
clem: nos vero navigavimus post dies azymorum a Philippis, et venimus ad eos Troadem in diebus quinque, ubi demorati sumus diebus septem.
tr: ημεις δε εξεπλευσαμεν μετα τας ημερας των αζυμων απο φιλιππων και ηλθομεν προς αυτους εις την τρωαδα αχρις ημερων πεντε ου διετριψαμεν ημερας επτα
kjv: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.

vulg: in una autem sabbati cum convenissemus ad frangendum panem Paulus disputabat eis profecturus in crastinum protraxitque sermonem usque in mediam noctem
clem: Una autem sabbati cum convenissemus ad frangendum panem, Paulus disputabat cum eis profecturus in crastinum, protraxitque sermonem usque in mediam noctem.
tr: εν δε τη μια των σαββατων συνηγμενων των μαθητων του κλασαι αρτον ο παυλος διελεγετο αυτοις μελλων εξιεναι τη επαυριον παρετεινεν τε τον λογον μεχρι μεσονυκτιου
kjv: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.

vulg: erant autem lampades copiosae in cenaculo ubi eramus congregati
clem: Erant autem lampades copios in cnaculo, ubi eramus congregati.
tr: ησαν δε λαμπαδες ικαναι εν τω υπερωω ου ησαν συνηγμενοι
kjv: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.

vulg: sedens autem quidam adulescens nomine Eutychus super fenestram cum mergeretur somno gravi disputante diu Paulo eductus somno cecidit de tertio cenaculo deorsum et sublatus est mortuus
clem: Sedens autem quidam adolescens nomine Eutychus super fenestram, cum mergeretur somno gravi, disputante diu Paulo, ductus somno cecidit de tertio cnaculo deorsum, et sublatus est mortuus.
tr: καθημενος δε τις νεανιας ονοματι ευτυχος επι της θυριδος καταφερομενος υπνω βαθει διαλεγομενου του παυλου επι πλειον κατενεχθεις απο του υπνου επεσεν απο του τριστεγου κατω και ηρθη νεκρος
kjv: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.

vulg: ad quem cum descendisset Paulus incubuit super eum et conplexus dixit nolite turbari anima enim ipsius in eo est
clem: Ad quem cum descendisset Paulus, incubuit super eum: et complexus dixit: Nolite turbari, anima enim ipsius in ipso est.
tr: καταβας δε ο παυλος επεπεσεν αυτω και συμπεριλαβων ειπεν μη θορυβεισθε η γαρ ψυχη αυτου εν αυτω εστιν
kjv: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.

vulg: ascendens autem frangensque panem et gustans satisque adlocutus usque in lucem sic profectus est
clem: Ascendens autem, frangensque panem, et gustans, satisque allocutus usque in lucem, sic profectus est.
tr: αναβας δε και κλασας αρτον και γευσαμενος εφ ικανον τε ομιλησας αχρις αυγης ουτως εξηλθεν
kjv: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.

vulg: adduxerunt autem puerum viventem et consolati sunt non minime
clem: Adduxerunt autem puerum viventem, et consolati sunt non minime.
tr: ηγαγον δε τον παιδα ζωντα και παρεκληθησαν ου μετριως
kjv: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.

vulg: nos autem ascendentes navem enavigavimus in Asson inde suscepturi Paulum sic enim disposuerat ipse per terram iter facturus
clem: Nos autem ascendentes navem, navigavimus in Asson, inde suscepturi Paulum: sic enim disposuerat ipse per terram iter facturus.
tr: ημεις δε προελθοντες επι το πλοιον ανηχθημεν εις την ασσον εκειθεν μελλοντες αναλαμβανειν τον παυλον ουτως γαρ ην διατεταγμενος μελλων αυτος πεζευειν
kjv: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.

vulg: cum autem convenisset nos in Asson adsumpto eo venimus Mytilenen
clem: Cum autem convenisset nos in Asson, assumpto eo, venimus Mitylenen.
tr: ως δε συνεβαλεν ημιν εις την ασσον αναλαβοντες αυτον ηλθομεν εις μιτυληνην
kjv: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.

vulg: et inde navigantes sequenti die venimus contra Chium et alia adplicuimus Samum et sequenti venimus Miletum
clem: Et inde navigantes, sequenti die venimus contra Chium, et alia applicuimus Samum, et sequenti die venimus Miletum.
tr: κακειθεν αποπλευσαντες τη επιουση κατηντησαμεν αντικρυ χιου τη δε ετερα παρεβαλομεν εις σαμον και μειναντες εν τρωγυλλιω τη εχομενη ηλθομεν εις μιλητον
kjv: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.

vulg: proposuerat enim Paulus transnavigare Ephesum ne qua mora illi fieret in Asia festinabat enim si possibile sibi esset ut diem pentecosten faceret Hierosolymis
clem: Proposuerat enim Paulus transnavigare Ephesum, ne qua mora illi fieret in Asia. Festinabat enim, si possibile sibi esset, ut diem Pentecostes faceret Jerosolymis.
tr: εκρινεν γαρ ο παυλος παραπλευσαι την εφεσον οπως μη γενηται αυτω χρονοτριβησαι εν τη ασια εσπευδεν γαρ ει δυνατον ην αυτω την ημεραν της πεντηκοστης γενεσθαι εις ιεροσολυμα
kjv: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.

vulg: a Mileto autem mittens Ephesum vocavit maiores natu ecclesiae
clem: A Mileto autem mittens Ephesum, vocavit majores natu ecclesi.
tr: απο δε της μιλητου πεμψας εις εφεσον μετεκαλεσατο τους πρεσβυτερους της εκκλησιας
kjv: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.

vulg: qui cum venissent ad eum et simul essent dixit eis vos scitis a prima die qua ingressus sum in Asiam qualiter vobiscum per omne tempus fuerim
clem: Qui cum venissent ad eum, et simul essent, dixit eis: Vos scitis a prima die qua ingressus sum in Asiam, qualiter vobiscum per omne tempus fuerim,
tr: ως δε παρεγενοντο προς αυτον ειπεν αυτοις υμεις επιστασθε απο πρωτης ημερας αφ ης επεβην εις την ασιαν πως μεθ υμων τον παντα χρονον εγενομην
kjv: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,

vulg: serviens Domino cum omni humilitate et lacrimis et temptationibus quae mihi acciderunt ex insidiis Iudaeorum
clem: serviens Domino cum omni humilitate, et lacrimis, et tentationibus, qu mihi acciderunt ex insidiis Judorum:
tr: δουλευων τω κυριω μετα πασης ταπεινοφροσυνης και πολλων δακρυων και πειρασμων των συμβαντων μοι εν ταις επιβουλαις των ιουδαιων
kjv: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:

vulg: quomodo nihil subtraxerim utilium quo minus adnuntiarem vobis et docerem vos publice et per domos
clem: quomodo nihil subtraxerim utilium, quominus annuntiarem vobis et docerem vos, publice et per domos,
tr: ως ουδεν υπεστειλαμην των συμφεροντων του μη αναγγειλαι υμιν και διδαξαι υμας δημοσια και κατ οικους
kjv: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publicly, and from house to house,

vulg: testificans Iudaeis atque gentilibus in Deum paenitentiam et fidem in Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum
clem: testificans Judis atque gentilibus in Deum pnitentiam, et fidem in Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum.
tr: διαμαρτυρομενος ιουδαιοις τε και ελλησιν την εις τον θεον μετανοιαν και πιστιν την εις τον κυριον ημων ιησουν χριστον
kjv: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: et nunc ecce alligatus ego Spiritu vado in Hierusalem quae in ea eventura sint mihi ignorans
clem: Et nunc ecce alligatus ego spiritu, vado in Jerusalem: qu in ea ventura sint mihi, ignorans:
tr: και νυν ιδου εγω δεδεμενος τω πνευματι πορευομαι εις ιερουσαλημ τα εν αυτη συναντησοντα μοι μη ειδως
kjv: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:

vulg: nisi quod Spiritus Sanctus per omnes civitates protestatur mihi dicens quoniam vincula et tribulationes me manent
clem: nisi quod Spiritus Sanctus per omnes civitates mihi protestatur, dicens quoniam vincula et tribulationes Jerosolymis me manent.
tr: πλην οτι το πνευμα το αγιον κατα πολιν διαμαρτυρεται λεγον οτι δεσμα με και θλιψεις μενουσιν
kjv: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.

vulg: sed nihil horum vereor nec facio animam pretiosiorem quam me dummodo consummem cursum meum et ministerium quod accepi a Domino Iesu testificari evangelium gratiae Dei
clem: Sed nihil horum vereor: nec facio animam meam pretiosiorem quam me, dummodo consummem cursum meum, et ministerium verbi quod accepi a Domino Jesu, testificari Evangelium grati Dei.
tr: αλλ ουδενος λογον ποιουμαι ουδε εχω την ψυχην μου τιμιαν εμαυτω ως τελειωσαι τον δρομον μου μετα χαρας και την διακονιαν ην ελαβον παρα του κυριου ιησου διαμαρτυρασθαι το ευαγγελιον της χαριτος του θεου
kjv: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

vulg: et nunc ecce ego scio quia amplius non videbitis faciem meam vos omnes per quos transivi praedicans regnum Dei
clem: Et nunc ecce ego scio quia amplius non videbitis faciem meam vos omnes, per quos transivi prdicans regnum Dei.
tr: και νυν ιδου εγω οιδα οτι ουκετι οψεσθε το προσωπον μου υμεις παντες εν οις διηλθον κηρυσσων την βασιλειαν του θεου
kjv: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.

vulg: quapropter contestor vos hodierna die quia mundus sum a sanguine omnium
clem: Quapropter contestor vos hodierna die, quia mundus sum a sanguine omnium.
tr: διο μαρτυρομαι υμιν εν τη σημερον ημερα οτι καθαρος εγω απο του αιματος παντων
kjv: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.

vulg: non enim subterfugi quo minus adnuntiarem omne consilium Dei vobis
clem: Non enim subterfugi, quominus annuntiarem omne consilium Dei vobis.
tr: ου γαρ υπεστειλαμην του μη αναγγειλαι υμιν πασαν την βουλην του θεου
kjv: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.

vulg: adtendite vobis et universo gregi in quo vos Spiritus Sanctus posuit episcopos regere ecclesiam Dei quam adquisivit sanguine suo
clem: Attendite vobis, et universo gregi, in quo vos Spiritus Sanctus posuit episcopos regere ecclesiam Dei, quam acquisivit sanguine suo.
tr: προσεχετε ουν εαυτοις και παντι τω ποιμνιω εν ω υμας το πνευμα το αγιον εθετο επισκοπους ποιμαινειν την εκκλησιαν του θεου ην περιεποιησατο δια του ιδιου αιματος
kjv: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.

vulg: ego scio quoniam intrabunt post discessionem meam lupi graves in vos non parcentes gregi
clem: Ego scio quoniam intrabunt post discessionem meam lupi rapaces in vos, non parcentes gregi.
tr: εγω γαρ οιδα τουτο οτι εισελευσονται μετα την αφιξιν μου λυκοι βαρεις εις υμας μη φειδομενοι του ποιμνιου
kjv: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

vulg: et ex vobis ipsis exsurgent viri loquentes perversa ut abducant discipulos post se
clem: Et ex vobisipsis exsurgent viri loquentes perversa, ut abducant discipulos post se.
tr: και εξ υμων αυτων αναστησονται ανδρες λαλουντες διεστραμμενα του αποσπαν τους μαθητας οπισω αυτων
kjv: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.

vulg: propter quod vigilate memoria retinentes quoniam per triennium nocte et die non cessavi cum lacrimis monens unumquemque vestrum
clem: Propter quod vigilate, memoria retinentes quoniam per triennium nocte et die non cessavi, cum lacrimis monens unumquemque vestrum.
tr: διο γρηγορειτε μνημονευοντες οτι τριετιαν νυκτα και ημεραν ουκ επαυσαμην μετα δακρυων νουθετων ενα εκαστον
kjv: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.

vulg: et nunc commendo vos Deo et verbo gratiae ipsius qui potens est aedificare et dare hereditatem in sanctificatis omnibus
clem: Et nunc commendo vos Deo, et verbo grati ipsius, qui potens est dificare, et dare hreditatem in sanctificatis omnibus.
tr: και τανυν  τα νυν  παρατιθεμαι υμας αδελφοι τω θεω και τω λογω της χαριτος αυτου τω δυναμενω εποικοδομησαι και δουναι υμιν κληρονομιαν εν τοις ηγιασμενοις πασιν
kjv: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.

vulg: argentum aut aurum aut vestem nullius concupivi
clem: Argentum, et aurum, aut vestem nullius concupivi, sicut
tr: αργυριου η χρυσιου η ιματισμου ουδενος επεθυμησα
kjv: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.

vulg: ipsi scitis quoniam ad ea quae mihi opus erant et his qui mecum sunt ministraverunt manus istae
clem: ipsi scitis: quoniam ad ea qu mihi opus erant, et his qui mecum sunt, ministraverunt manus ist.
tr: αυτοι δε γινωσκετε οτι ταις χρειαις μου και τοις ουσιν μετ εμου υπηρετησαν αι χειρες αυται
kjv: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.

vulg: omnia ostendi vobis quoniam sic laborantes oportet suscipere infirmos ac meminisse verbi Domini Iesu quoniam ipse dixit beatius est magis dare quam accipere
clem: Omnia ostendi vobis, quoniam sic laborantes, oportet suscipere infirmos ac meminisse verbi Domini Jesu: quoniam ipse dixit: Beatius est magis dare, quam accipere.
tr: παντα υπεδειξα υμιν οτι ουτως κοπιωντας δει αντιλαμβανεσθαι των ασθενουντων μνημονευειν τε των λογων του κυριου ιησου οτι αυτος ειπεν μακαριον εστιν διδοναι μαλλον η λαμβανειν
kjv: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

vulg: et cum haec dixisset positis genibus suis cum omnibus illis oravit
clem: Et cum hc dixisset, positis genibus suis oravit cum omnibus illis.
tr: και ταυτα ειπων θεις τα γονατα αυτου συν πασιν αυτοις προσηυξατο
kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.

vulg: magnus autem fletus factus est omnium et procumbentes super collum Pauli osculabantur eum
clem: Magnus autem fletus factus est omnium: et procumbentes super collum Pauli, osculabantur eum,
tr: ικανος δε εγενετο κλαυθμος παντων και επιπεσοντες επι τον τραχηλον του παυλου κατεφιλουν αυτον
kjv: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,

vulg: dolentes maxime in verbo quo dixerat quoniam amplius faciem eius non essent visuri et deducebant eum ad navem
clem: dolentes maxime in verbo quod dixerat, quoniam amplius faciem ejus non essent visuri. Et deducebant eum ad navem.
tr: οδυνωμενοι μαλιστα επι τω λογω ω ειρηκει οτι ουκετι μελλουσιν το προσωπον αυτου θεωρειν προεπεμπον δε αυτον εις το πλοιον
kjv: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.

vulg: cum autem factum esset ut navigaremus abstracti ab eis recto cursu venimus Cho et sequenti die Rhodum et inde Patara
clem: Cum autem factum esset ut navigaremus abstracti ab eis, recto cursu venimus Coum, et sequenti die Rhodum, et inde Pataram.
tr: ως δε εγενετο αναχθηναι ημας αποσπασθεντας απ αυτων ευθυδρομησαντες ηλθομεν εις την κων τη δε εξης εις την ροδον κακειθεν εις παταρα
kjv: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:

vulg: et cum invenissemus navem transfretantem in Foenicen ascendentes navigavimus
clem: Et cum invenissemus navem transfretantem in Phnicen, ascendentes navigavimus.
tr: και ευροντες πλοιον διαπερων εις φοινικην επιβαντες ανηχθημεν
kjv: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.

vulg: cum paruissemus autem Cypro et relinquentes eam ad sinistram navigabamus in Syriam et venimus Tyrum ibi enim navis erat expositura onus
clem: Cum apparuissemus autem Cypro, relinquentes eam ad sinistram, navigavimus in Syriam, et venimus Tyrum: ibi enim navis expositura erat onus.
tr: αναφαναντες δε την κυπρον και καταλιποντες αυτην ευωνυμον επλεομεν εις συριαν και κατηχθημεν εις τυρον εκεισε γαρ ην το πλοιον αποφορτιζομενον τον γομον
kjv: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.

vulg: inventis autem discipulis mansimus ibi diebus septem qui Paulo dicebant per Spiritum ne ascenderet Hierosolymam
clem: Inventis autem discipulis, mansimus ibi diebus septem: qui Paulo dicebant per Spiritum ne ascenderet Jerosolymam.
tr: και ανευροντες τους   μαθητας επεμειναμεν αυτου ημερας επτα οιτινες τω παυλω ελεγον δια του πνευματος μη αναβαινειν εις ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

vulg: et explicitis diebus profecti ibamus deducentibus nos omnibus cum uxoribus et filiis usque foras civitatem et positis genibus in litore oravimus
clem: Et expletis diebus, profecti ibamus, deducentibus nos omnibus cum uxoribus et filiis usque foras civitatem: et positis genibus in littore, oravimus.
tr: οτε δε εγενετο ημας εξαρτισαι τας ημερας εξελθοντες επορευομεθα προπεμποντων ημας παντων συν γυναιξιν και τεκνοις εως εξω της πολεως και θεντες τα γονατα επι τον αιγιαλον προσηυξαμεθα
kjv: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.

vulg: et cum valefecissemus invicem ascendimus in navem illi autem redierunt in sua
clem: Et cum valefecissemus invicem, ascendimus navem: illi autem redierunt in sua.
tr: και ασπασαμενοι αλληλους επεβημεν εις το πλοιον εκεινοι δε υπεστρεψαν εις τα ιδια
kjv: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.

vulg: nos vero navigatione explicita a Tyro descendimus Ptolomaida et salutatis fratribus mansimus die una apud illos
clem: Nos vero navigatione expleta a Tyro descendimus Ptolemaidam: et salutatis fratribus, mansimus die una apud illos.
tr: ημεις δε τον πλουν διανυσαντες απο τυρου κατηντησαμεν εις πτολεμαιδα και ασπασαμενοι τους αδελφους εμειναμεν ημεραν μιαν παρ αυτοις
kjv: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.

vulg: alia autem die profecti venimus Caesaream et intrantes in domum Philippi evangelistae qui erat de septem mansimus apud eum
clem: Alia autem die profecti, venimus Csaream. Et intrantes domum Philippi evangelist, qui erat unus de septem, mansimus apud eum.
tr: τη δε επαυριον εξελθοντες οι περι τον παυλον ηλθον  ηλθομεν  εις καισαρειαν και εισελθοντες εις τον οικον φιλιππου του ευαγγελιστου του οντος εκ των επτα εμειναμεν παρ αυτω
kjv: And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.

vulg: huic autem erant filiae quattuor virgines prophetantes
clem: Huic autem erant quatuor fili virgines prophetantes.
tr: τουτω δε ησαν θυγατερες παρθενοι τεσσαρες προφητευουσαι
kjv: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.

vulg: et cum moraremur per dies aliquot supervenit quidam a Iudaea propheta nomine Agabus
clem: Et cum moraremur per dies aliquot, supervenit quidam a Juda propheta, nomine Agabus.
tr: επιμενοντων δε ημων ημερας πλειους κατηλθεν τις απο της ιουδαιας προφητης ονοματι αγαβος
kjv: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.

vulg: is cum venisset ad nos tulit zonam Pauli et alligans sibi pedes et manus dixit haec dicit Spiritus Sanctus virum cuius est zona haec sic alligabunt in Hierusalem Iudaei et tradent in manus gentium
clem: Is cum venisset ad nos, tulit zonam Pauli: et alligans sibi pedes et manus, dixit: Hc dicit Spiritus Sanctus: Virum, cujus est zona hc, sic alligabunt in Jerusalem Judi, et tradent in manus gentium.
tr: και ελθων προς ημας και αρας την ζωνην του παυλου δησας τε αυτου τας χειρας και τους ποδας ειπεν ταδε λεγει το πνευμα το αγιον τον ανδρα ου εστιν η ζωνη αυτη ουτως δησουσιν εν ιερουσαλημ οι ιουδαιοι και παραδωσουσιν εις χειρας εθνων
kjv: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.

vulg: quod cum audissemus rogabamus nos et qui loci illius erant ne ascenderet Hierosolymam
clem: Quod cum audissemus, rogabamus nos, et qui loci illius erant, ne ascenderet Jerosolymam.
tr: ως δε ηκουσαμεν ταυτα παρεκαλουμεν ημεις τε και οι εντοπιοι του μη αναβαινειν αυτον εις ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.

vulg: tunc respondit Paulus et dixit quid facitis flentes et adfligentes cor meum ego enim non solum alligari sed et mori in Hierusalem paratus sum propter nomen Domini Iesu
clem: Tunc respondit Paulus, et dixit: Quid facitis flentes, et affligentes cor meum? Ego enim non solum alligari, sed et mori in Jerusalem paratus sum propter nomen Domini Jesu.
tr: απεκριθη δε ο παυλος τι ποιειτε κλαιοντες και συνθρυπτοντες μου την καρδιαν εγω γαρ ου μονον δεθηναι αλλα και αποθανειν εις ιερουσαλημ ετοιμως εχω υπερ του ονοματος του κυριου ιησου
kjv: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

vulg: et cum ei suadere non possemus quievimus dicentes Domini voluntas fiat
clem: Et cum ei suadere non possemus, quievimus, dicentes: Domini voluntas fiat.
tr: μη πειθομενου δε αυτου ησυχασαμεν ειποντες το θελημα του κυριου γενεσθω
kjv: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.

vulg: post dies autem istos praeparati ascendebamus Hierusalem
clem: Post dies autem istos, prparati ascendebamus in Jerusalem.
tr: μετα δε τας ημερας ταυτας αποσκευασαμενοι ανεβαινομεν εις ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.

vulg: venerunt autem et ex discipulis a Caesarea nobiscum adducentes apud quem hospitaremur Mnasonem quendam Cyprium antiquum discipulum
clem: Venerunt autem et ex discipulis a Csarea nobiscum, adducentes secum apud quem hospitaremur Mnasonem quemdam Cyprium, antiquum discipulum.
tr: συνηλθον δε και των μαθητων απο καισαρειας συν ημιν αγοντες παρ ω ξενισθωμεν μνασωνι τινι κυπριω αρχαιω μαθητη
kjv: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.

vulg: et cum venissemus Hierosolymam libenter exceperunt nos fratres
clem: Et cum venissemus Jerosolymam, libenter exceperunt nos fratres.
tr: γενομενων δε ημων εις ιεροσολυμα ασμενως εδεξαντο ημας οι αδελφοι
kjv: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.

vulg: sequenti autem die introibat Paulus nobiscum ad Iacobum omnesque collecti sunt seniores
clem: Sequenti autem die introibat Paulus nobiscum ad Jacobum, omnesque collecti sunt seniores.
tr: τη δε επιουση εισηει ο παυλος συν ημιν προς ιακωβον παντες τε παρεγενοντο οι πρεσβυτεροι
kjv: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.

vulg: quos cum salutasset narrabat per singula quae fecisset Deus in gentibus per ministerium ipsius
clem: Quos cum salutasset, narrabat per singula qu Deus fecisset in gentibus per ministerium ipsius.
tr: και ασπασαμενος αυτους εξηγειτο καθ εν εκαστον ων εποιησεν ο θεος εν τοις εθνεσιν δια της διακονιας αυτου
kjv: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.

vulg: at illi cum audissent magnificabant Deum dixeruntque ei vides frater quot milia sint in Iudaeis qui crediderunt et omnes aemulatores sunt legis
clem: At illi cum audissent, magnificabant Deum, dixeruntque ei: Vides, frater, quot millia sunt in Judis qui crediderunt, et omnes mulatores sunt legis.
tr: οι δε ακουσαντες εδοξαζον τον κυριον ειπον τε αυτω θεωρεις αδελφε ποσαι μυριαδες εισιν ιουδαιων των πεπιστευκοτων και παντες ζηλωται του νομου υπαρχουσιν
kjv: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:

vulg: audierunt autem de te quia discessionem doceas a Mose eorum qui per gentes sunt Iudaeorum dicens non debere circumcidere eos filios suos neque secundum consuetudinem ingredi
clem: Audierunt autem de te quia discessionem doceas a Moyse eorum qui per gentes sunt Judorum, dicens non debere eos circumcidere filios suos, neque secundum consuetudinem ingredi.
tr: κατηχηθησαν δε περι σου οτι αποστασιαν διδασκεις απο μωσεως τους κατα τα εθνη παντας ιουδαιους λεγων μη περιτεμνειν αυτους τα τεκνα μηδε τοις εθεσιν περιπατειν
kjv: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.

vulg: quid ergo est utique oportet convenire multitudinem audient enim te supervenisse
clem: Quid ergo est? utique oportet convenire multitudinem: audient enim te supervenisse.
tr: τι ουν εστιν παντως δει πληθος συνελθειν ακουσονται γαρ οτι εληλυθας
kjv: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.

vulg: hoc ergo fac quod tibi dicimus sunt nobis viri quattuor votum habentes super se
clem: Hoc ergo fac quod tibi dicimus. Sunt nobis viri quatuor, votum habentes super se.
tr: τουτο ουν ποιησον ο σοι λεγομεν εισιν ημιν ανδρες τεσσαρες ευχην εχοντες εφ εαυτων
kjv: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;

vulg: his adsumptis sanctifica te cum illis et inpende in illis ut radant capita et scient omnes quia quae de te audierunt falsa sunt sed ambulas et ipse custodiens legem
clem: His assumptis, sanctifica te cum illis, et impende in illis ut radant capita: et scient omnes quia qu de te audierunt, falsa sunt, sed ambulas et ipse custodiens legem.
tr: τουτους παραλαβων αγνισθητι συν αυτοις και δαπανησον επ αυτοις ινα ξυρησωνται την κεφαλην και γνωσιν παντες οτι ων κατηχηνται περι σου ουδεν εστιν αλλα στοιχεις και αυτος τον νομον φυλασσων
kjv: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.

vulg: de his autem qui crediderunt ex gentibus nos scripsimus iudicantes ut abstineant se ab idolis immolato et sanguine et suffocato et fornicatione
clem: De his autem qui crediderunt ex gentibus, nos scripsimus judicantes ut abstineant se ab idolis immolato, et sanguine, et suffocato, et fornicatione.
tr: περι δε των πεπιστευκοτων εθνων ημεις επεστειλαμεν κριναντες μηδεν τοιουτον τηρειν αυτους ει μη φυλασσεσθαι αυτους το τε ειδωλοθυτον και το αιμα και πνικτον και πορνειαν
kjv: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.

vulg: tunc Paulus adsumptis viris postera die purificatus cum illis intravit in templum adnuntians expletionem dierum purificationis donec offerretur pro unoquoque eorum oblatio
clem: Tunc Paulus, assumptis viris, postera die purificatus cum illis intravit in templum, annuntians expletionem dierum purificationis, donec offerretur pro unoquoque eorum oblatio.
tr: τοτε ο παυλος παραλαβων τους ανδρας τη εχομενη ημερα συν αυτοις αγνισθεις εισηει εις το ιερον διαγγελλων την εκπληρωσιν των ημερων του αγνισμου εως ου προσηνεχθη υπερ ενος εκαστου αυτων η προσφορα
kjv: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.

vulg: dum autem septem dies consummarentur hii qui de Asia erant Iudaei cum vidissent eum in templo concitaverunt omnem populum et iniecerunt ei manus clamantes
clem: Dum autem septem dies consummarentur, hi qui de Asia erant Judi, cum vidissent eum in templo, concitaverunt omnem populum, et injecerunt ei manus, clamantes:
tr: ως δε εμελλον αι επτα ημεραι συντελεισθαι οι απο της ασιας ιουδαιοι θεασαμενοι αυτον εν τω ιερω συνεχεον παντα τον οχλον και επεβαλον τας χειρας επ αυτον
kjv: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,

vulg: viri israhelitae adiuvate hic est homo qui adversus populum et legem et locum hunc omnes ubique docens insuper et gentiles induxit in templum et violavit sanctum locum istum
clem: Viri Isralit, adjuvate: hic est homo qui adversus populum, et legem, et locum hunc, omnes ubique docens, insuper et gentiles induxit in templum, et violavit sanctum locum istum.
tr: κραζοντες ανδρες ισραηλιται βοηθειτε ουτος εστιν ο ανθρωπος ο κατα του λαου και του νομου και του τοπου τουτου παντας πανταχου διδασκων ετι τε και ελληνας εισηγαγεν εις το ιερον και κεκοινωκεν τον αγιον τοπον τουτον
kjv: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.

vulg: viderant enim Trophimum Ephesium in civitate cum ipso quem aestimaverunt quoniam in templum induxisset Paulus
clem: Viderant enim Trophimum Ephesium in civitate cum ipso, quem stimaverunt quoniam in templum introduxisset Paulus.
tr: ησαν γαρ προεωρακοτες τροφιμον τον εφεσιον εν τη πολει συν αυτω ον ενομιζον οτι εις το ιερον εισηγαγεν ο παυλος
kjv: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)

vulg: commotaque est civitas tota et facta est concursio populi et adprehendentes Paulum trahebant eum extra templum et statim clausae sunt ianuae
clem: Commotaque est civitas tota, et facta est concursio populi. Et apprehendentes Paulum, trahebant eum extra templum: et statim claus sunt janu.
tr: εκινηθη τε η πολις ολη και εγενετο συνδρομη του λαου και επιλαβομενοι του παυλου ειλκον αυτον εξω του ιερου και ευθεως εκλεισθησαν αι θυραι
kjv: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.

vulg: quaerentibus autem eum occidere nuntiatum est tribuno cohortis quia tota confunditur Hierusalem
clem: Qurentibus autem eum occidere, nuntiatum est tribuno cohortis quia tota confunditur Jerusalem.
tr: ζητουντων δε αυτον αποκτειναι ανεβη φασις τω χιλιαρχω της σπειρης οτι ολη συγκεχυται ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

vulg: qui statim adsumptis militibus et centurionibus decucurrit ad illos qui cum vidissent tribunum et milites cessaverunt percutere Paulum
clem: Qui statim, assumptis militibus et centurionibus, decurrit ad illos. Qui cum vidissent tribunum et milites, cessaverunt percutere Paulum.
tr: ος εξαυτης παραλαβων στρατιωτας και εκατονταρχους κατεδραμεν επ αυτους οι δε ιδοντες τον χιλιαρχον και τους στρατιωτας επαυσαντο τυπτοντες τον παυλον
kjv: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.

vulg: tunc accedens tribunus adprehendit eum et iussit alligari catenis duabus et interrogabat quis esset et quid fecisset
clem: Tunc accedens tribunus apprehendit eum, et jussit eum alligari catenis duabus: et interrogabat quis esset, et quid fecisset.
tr: τοτε εγγισας ο χιλιαρχος επελαβετο αυτου και εκελευσεν δεθηναι αλυσεσιν δυσιν και επυνθανετο τις αν ειη και τι εστιν πεποιηκως
kjv: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.

vulg: alii autem aliud clamabant in turba et cum non posset certum cognoscere prae tumultu iussit duci eum in castra
clem: Alii autem aliud clamabant in turba. Et cum non posset certum cognoscere pr tumultu, jussit duci eum in castra.
tr: αλλοι δε αλλο τι εβοων εν τω οχλω μη δυναμενος δε γνωναι το ασφαλες δια τον θορυβον εκελευσεν αγεσθαι αυτον εις την παρεμβολην
kjv: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.

vulg: et cum venisset ad gradus contigit ut portaretur a militibus propter vim populi
clem: Et cum venisset ad gradus, contigit ut portaretur a militibus propter vim populi.
tr: οτε δε εγενετο επι τους αναβαθμους συνεβη βασταζεσθαι αυτον υπο των στρατιωτων δια την βιαν του οχλου
kjv: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.

vulg: sequebatur enim multitudo populi clamans tolle eum
clem: Sequebatur enim multitudo populi, clamans: Tolle eum.
tr: ηκολουθει γαρ το πληθος του λαου κραζον αιρε αυτον
kjv: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.

vulg: et cum coepisset induci in castra Paulus dicit tribuno si licet mihi loqui aliquid ad te qui dixit graece nosti
clem: Et cum cpisset induci in castra Paulus, dicit tribuno: Si licet mihi loqui aliquid ad te? Qui dixit: Grce nosti?
tr: μελλων τε εισαγεσθαι εις την παρεμβολην ο παυλος λεγει τω χιλιαρχω ει εξεστιν μοι ειπειν τι προς σε ο δε εφη ελληνιστι γινωσκεις
kjv: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?

vulg: nonne tu es Aegyptius qui ante hos dies tumultum concitasti et eduxisti in desertum quattuor milia virorum sicariorum
clem: nonne tu es gyptius, qui ante hos dies tumultum concitasti, et eduxisti in desertum quatuor millia virorum sicariorum?
tr: ουκ αρα συ ει ο αιγυπτιος ο προ τουτων των ημερων αναστατωσας και εξαγαγων εις την ερημον τους τετρακισχιλιους ανδρας των σικαριων
kjv: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?

vulg: et dixit ad eum Paulus ego homo sum quidem iudaeus a Tarso Ciliciae non ignotae civitatis municeps rogo autem te permitte mihi loqui ad populum
clem: Et dixit ad eum Paulus: Ego homo sum quidem Judus a Tarso Cilici, non ignot civitatis municeps. Rogo autem te, permitte mihi loqui ad populum.
tr: ειπεν δε ο παυλος εγω ανθρωπος μεν ειμι ιουδαιος ταρσευς της κιλικιας ουκ ασημου πολεως πολιτης δεομαι δε σου επιτρεψον μοι λαλησαι προς τον λαον
kjv: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.

vulg: et cum ille permisisset Paulus stans in gradibus annuit manu ad plebem et magno silentio facto adlocutus est hebraea lingua dicens
clem: Et cum ille permisisset, Paulus stans in gradibus annuit manu ad plebem, et magno silentio facto, allocutus est lingua hebra, dicens:
tr: επιτρεψαντος δε αυτου ο παυλος εστως επι των αναβαθμων κατεσεισεν τη χειρι τω λαω πολλης δε σιγης γενομενης προσεφωνησεν τη εβραιδι διαλεκτω λεγων
kjv: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,

vulg: viri fratres et patres audite quam ad vos nunc reddo rationem
clem: Viri fratres, et patres, audite quam ad vos nunc reddo rationem.
tr: ανδρες αδελφοι και πατερες ακουσατε μου της προς υμας νυν απολογιας
kjv: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.

vulg: cum audissent autem quia hebraea lingua loquitur ad illos magis praestiterunt silentium
clem: Cum audissent autem quia hebra lingua loqueretur ad illos, magis prstiterunt silentium.
tr: ακουσαντες δε οτι τη εβραιδι διαλεκτω προσεφωνει αυτοις μαλλον παρεσχον ησυχιαν και φησιν
kjv: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)

vulg: et dixit ego sum vir iudaeus natus Tarso Ciliciae nutritus autem in ista civitate secus pedes Gamalihel eruditus iuxta veritatem paternae legis aemulator legis sicut et vos omnes estis hodie
clem: Et dicit: Ego sum vir Judus, natus in Tarso Cilici, nutritus autem in ista civitate, secus pedes Gamaliel eruditus juxta veritatem patern legis, mulator legis, sicut et vos omnes estis hodie:
tr: εγω μεν ειμι ανηρ ιουδαιος γεγεννημενος εν ταρσω της κιλικιας ανατεθραμμενος δε εν τη πολει ταυτη παρα τους ποδας γαμαλιηλ πεπαιδευμενος κατα ακριβειαν του πατρωου νομου ζηλωτης υπαρχων του θεου καθως παντες υμεις εστε σημερον
kjv: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.

vulg: qui hanc viam persecutus sum usque ad mortem alligans et tradens in custodias viros ac mulieres
clem: qui hanc viam persecutus sum usque ad mortem, alligans et tradens in custodias viros ac mulieres,
tr: ος ταυτην την οδον εδιωξα αχρι θανατου δεσμευων και παραδιδους εις φυλακας ανδρας τε και γυναικας
kjv: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

vulg: sicut princeps sacerdotum testimonium mihi reddit et omnes maiores natu a quibus et epistulas accipiens ad fratres Damascum pergebam ut adducerem inde vinctos in Hierusalem uti punirentur
clem: sicut princeps sacerdotum mihi testimonium reddit, et omnes majores natu: a quibus et epistolas accipiens, ad fratres Damascum pergebam, ut adducerem inde vinctos in Jerusalem ut punirentur.
tr: ως και ο αρχιερευς μαρτυρει μοι και παν το πρεσβυτεριον παρ ων και επιστολας δεξαμενος προς τους αδελφους εις δαμασκον επορευομην αξων και τους εκεισε οντας δεδεμενους εις ιερουσαλημ ινα τιμωρηθωσιν
kjv: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.

vulg: factum est autem eunte me et adpropinquante Damasco media die subito de caelo circumfulsit me lux copiosa
clem: Factum est autem, eunte me, et appropinquante Damasco media die, subito de clo circumfulsit me lux copiosa:
tr: εγενετο δε μοι πορευομενω και εγγιζοντι τη δαμασκω περι μεσημβριαν εξαιφνης εκ του ουρανου περιαστραψαι φως ικανον περι εμε
kjv: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.

vulg: et decidens in terram audivi vocem dicentem mihi Saule Saule quid me persequeris
clem: et decidens in terram, audivi vocem dicentem mihi: Saule, Saule, quid me persequeris?
tr: επεσον τε εις το εδαφος και ηκουσα φωνης λεγουσης μοι σαουλ σαουλ τι με διωκεις
kjv: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

vulg: ego autem respondi quis es Domine dixitque ad me ego sum Iesus Nazarenus quem tu persequeris
clem: Ego autem respondi: Quis es, domine? Dixitque ad me: Ego sum Jesus Nazarenus, quem tu persequeris.
tr: εγω δε απεκριθην τις ει κυριε ειπεν τε προς με εγω ειμι ιησους ο ναζωραιος ον συ διωκεις
kjv: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.

vulg: et qui mecum erant lumen quidem viderunt vocem autem non audierunt eius qui loquebatur mecum
clem: Et qui mecum erant, lumen quidem viderunt, vocem autem non audierunt ejus qui loquebatur mecum.
tr: οι δε συν εμοι οντες το μεν φως εθεασαντο και εμφοβοι εγενοντο την δε φωνην ουκ ηκουσαν του λαλουντος μοι
kjv: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.

vulg: et dixi quid faciam Domine Dominus autem dixit ad me surgens vade Damascum et ibi tibi dicetur de omnibus quae te oporteat facere
clem: Et dixi: Quid faciam, domine? Dominus autem dixit ad me: Surgens vade Damascum: et ibi tibi dicetur de omnibus qu te oporteat facere.
tr: ειπον δε τι ποιησω κυριε ο δε κυριος ειπεν προς με αναστας πορευου εις δαμασκον κακει σοι λαληθησεται περι παντων ων τετακται σοι ποιησαι
kjv: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.

vulg: et cum non viderem prae claritate luminis illius ad manum deductus a comitibus veni Damascum
clem: Et cum non viderem pr claritate luminis illius, ad manum deductus a comitibus, veni Damascum.
tr: ως δε ουκ ενεβλεπον απο της δοξης του φωτος εκεινου χειραγωγουμενος υπο των συνοντων μοι ηλθον εις δαμασκον
kjv: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.

vulg: Ananias autem quidam vir secundum legem testimonium habens ab omnibus habitantibus Iudaeis
clem: Ananias autem quidam vir secundum legem, testimonium habens ab omnibus cohabitantibus Judis,
tr: ανανιας δε τις ανηρ ευσεβης κατα τον νομον μαρτυρουμενος υπο παντων των κατοικουντων ιουδαιων
kjv: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,

vulg: veniens ad me et adstans dixit mihi Saule frater respice et ego eadem hora respexi in eum
clem: veniens ad me et astans, dixit mihi: Saule frater, respice. Et ego eadem hora respexi in eum.
tr: ελθων προς με και επιστας ειπεν μοι σαουλ αδελφε αναβλεψον καγω αυτη τη ωρα ανεβλεψα εις αυτον
kjv: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.

vulg: at ille dixit Deus patrum nostrorum praeordinavit te ut cognosceres voluntatem eius et videres Iustum et audires vocem ex ore eius
clem: At ille dixit: Deus patrum nostrorum prordinavit te, ut cognosceres voluntatem ejus, et videres justum, et audires vocem ex ore ejus:
tr: ο δε ειπεν ο θεος των πατερων ημων προεχειρισατο σε γνωναι το θελημα αυτου και ιδειν τον δικαιον και ακουσαι φωνην εκ του στοματος αυτου
kjv: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.

vulg: quia eris testis illius ad omnes homines eorum quae vidisti et audisti
clem: quia eris testis illius ad omnes homines eorum qu vidisti et audisti.
tr: οτι εση μαρτυς αυτω προς παντας ανθρωπους ων εωρακας και ηκουσας
kjv: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.

vulg: et nunc quid moraris exsurge baptizare et ablue peccata tua invocato nomine ipsius
clem: Et nunc quid moraris? Exsurge, et baptizare, et ablue peccata tua, invocato nomine ipsius.
tr: και νυν τι μελλεις αναστας βαπτισαι και απολουσαι τας αμαρτιας σου επικαλεσαμενος το ονομα του κυριου
kjv: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.

vulg: factum est autem revertenti mihi in Hierusalem et oranti in templo fieri me in stupore mentis
clem: Factum est autem revertenti mihi in Jerusalem, et oranti in templo, fieri me in stupore mentis,
tr: εγενετο δε μοι υποστρεψαντι εις ιερουσαλημ και προσευχομενου μου εν τω ιερω γενεσθαι με εν εκστασει
kjv: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;

vulg: et videre illum dicentem mihi festina et exi velociter ex Hierusalem quoniam non recipient testimonium tuum de me
clem: et videre illum dicentem mihi: Festina, et exi velociter ex Jerusalem: quoniam non recipient testimonium tuum de me.
tr: και ιδειν αυτον λεγοντα μοι σπευσον και εξελθε εν ταχει εξ ιερουσαλημ διοτι ου παραδεξονται σου την μαρτυριαν περι εμου
kjv: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.

vulg: et ego dixi Domine ipsi sciunt quia ego eram concludens in carcerem et caedens per synagogas eos qui credebant in te
clem: Et ego dixi: Domine, ipsi sciunt quia ego eram concludens in carcerem, et cdans per synagogas eos qui credebant in te:
tr: καγω ειπον κυριε αυτοι επιστανται οτι εγω ημην φυλακιζων και δερων κατα τας συναγωγας τους πιστευοντας επι σε
kjv: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:

vulg: et cum funderetur sanguis Stephani testis tui ego adstabam et consentiebam et custodiebam vestimenta interficientium illum
clem: et cum funderetur sanguis Stephani testis tui, ego astabam, et consentiebam, et custodiebam vestimenta interficientium illum.
tr: και οτε εξεχειτο το αιμα στεφανου του μαρτυρος σου και αυτος ημην εφεστως και συνευδοκων τη αναιρεσει αυτου και φυλασσων τα ιματια των αναιρουντων αυτον
kjv: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.

vulg: et dixit ad me vade quoniam ego in nationes longe mittam te
clem: Et dixit ad me: Vade, quoniam ego in nationes longe mittam te.
tr: και ειπεν προς με πορευου οτι εγω εις εθνη μακραν εξαποστελω σε
kjv: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.

vulg: audiebant autem eum usque ad hoc verbum et levaverunt vocem suam dicentes tolle de terra eiusmodi non enim fas est eum vivere
clem: Audiebant autem eum usque ad hoc verbum, et levaverunt vocem suam, dicentes: Tolle de terra hujusmodi: non enim fas est eum vivere.
tr: ηκουον δε αυτου αχρι τουτου του λογου και επηραν την φωνην αυτων λεγοντες αιρε απο της γης τον τοιουτον ου γαρ καθηκον αυτον ζην
kjv: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.

vulg: vociferantibus autem eis et proicientibus vestimenta sua et pulverem iactantibus in aerem
clem: Vociferantibus autem eis, et projicientibus vestimenta sua, et pulverem jactantibus in arem,
tr: κραυγαζοντων δε αυτων και ριπτουντων τα ιματια και κονιορτον βαλλοντων εις τον αερα
kjv: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,

vulg: iussit tribunus induci eum in castra et flagellis caedi et torqueri eum ut sciret propter quam causam sic adclamarent ei
clem: jussit tribunus induci eum in castra, et flagellis cdi, et torqueri eum, ut sciret propter quam causam sic acclamarent ei.
tr: εκελευσεν αυτον ο χιλιαρχος αγεσθαι εις την παρεμβολην ειπων μαστιξιν ανεταζεσθαι αυτον ινα επιγνω δι ην αιτιαν ουτως επεφωνουν αυτω
kjv: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.

vulg: et cum adstrinxissent eum loris dixit adstanti sibi centurioni Paulus si hominem romanum et indemnatum licet vobis flagellare
clem: Et cum astrinxissent eum loris, dicit astanti sibi centurioni Paulus: Si hominem Romanum et indemnatum licet vobis flagellare?
tr: ως δε προετεινεν  προετειναν  αυτον τοις ιμασιν ειπεν προς τον εστωτα εκατονταρχον ο παυλος ει ανθρωπον ρωμαιον και ακατακριτον εξεστιν υμιν μαστιζειν
kjv: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?

vulg: quo audito centurio accessit ad tribunum et nuntiavit dicens quid acturus es hic enim homo civis romanus est
clem: Quo audito, centurio accessit ad tribunum, et nuntiavit ei, dicens: Quid acturus es? hic enim homo civis Romanus est.
tr: ακουσας δε ο εκατονταρχος προσελθων απηγγειλεν τω χιλιαρχω λεγων ορα τι μελλεις ποιειν ο γαρ ανθρωπος ουτος ρωμαιος εστιν
kjv: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.

vulg: accedens autem tribunus dixit illi dic mihi tu Romanus es at ille dixit etiam
clem: Accedens autem tribunus, dixit illi: Dic mihi si tu Romanus es? At ille dixit: Etiam.
tr: προσελθων δε ο χιλιαρχος ειπεν αυτω λεγε μοι ει συ ρωμαιος ει ο δε εφη ναι
kjv: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.

vulg: et respondit tribunus ego multa summa civitatem hanc consecutus sum et Paulus ait ego autem et natus sum
clem: Et respondit tribunus: Ego multa summa civilitatem hanc consecutus sum. Et Paulus ait: Ego autem et natus sum.
tr: απεκριθη τε ο χιλιαρχος εγω πολλου κεφαλαιου την πολιτειαν ταυτην εκτησαμην ο δε παυλος εφη εγω δε και γεγεννημαι
kjv: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.

vulg: protinus ergo discesserunt ab illo qui eum torturi erant tribunus quoque timuit postquam rescivit quia civis romanus esset et quia alligasset eum
clem: Protinus ergo discesserunt ab illo qui eum torturi erant. Tribunus quoque timuit postquam rescivit, quia civis Romanus esset, et quia alligasset eum.
tr: ευθεως ουν απεστησαν απ αυτου οι μελλοντες αυτον ανεταζειν και ο χιλιαρχος δε εφοβηθη επιγνους οτι ρωμαιος εστιν και οτι ην αυτον δεδεκως
kjv: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.

vulg: postera autem die volens scire diligentius qua ex causa accusaretur a Iudaeis solvit eum et iussit sacerdotes convenire et omne concilium et producens Paulum statuit inter illos
clem: Postera autem die volens scire diligentius qua ex causa accusaretur a Judis, solvit eum, et jussit sacerdotes convenire, et omne concilium: et producens Paulum, statuit inter illos.
tr: τη δε επαυριον βουλομενος γνωναι το ασφαλες το τι κατηγορειται παρα των ιουδαιων ελυσεν αυτον απο των δεσμων και εκελευσεν ελθειν τους αρχιερεις και ολον το συνεδριον αυτων και καταγαγων τον παυλον εστησεν εις αυτους
kjv: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.

vulg: intendens autem concilium Paulus ait viri fratres ego omni conscientia bona conversatus sum ante Deum usque in hodiernum diem
clem: Intendens autem in concilium Paulus, ait: Viri fratres, ego omni conscientia bona conversatus sum ante Deum usque in hodiernum diem.
tr: ατενισας δε ο παυλος τω συνεδριω ειπεν ανδρες αδελφοι εγω παση συνειδησει αγαθη πεπολιτευμαι τω θεω αχρι ταυτης της ημερας
kjv: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.

vulg: princeps autem sacerdotum Ananias praecepit adstantibus sibi percutere os eius
clem: Princeps autem sacerdotum Ananias prcepit astantibus sibi percutere os ejus.
tr: ο δε αρχιερευς ανανιας επεταξεν τοις παρεστωσιν αυτω τυπτειν αυτου το στομα
kjv: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.

vulg: tunc Paulus ad eum dixit percutiet te Deus paries dealbate et tu sedens iudicas me secundum legem et contra legem iubes me percuti
clem: Tunc Paulus dixit ad eum: Percutiet te Deus, paries dealbate. Et tu sedens judicas me secundum legem, et contra legem jubes me percuti?
tr: τοτε ο παυλος προς αυτον ειπεν τυπτειν σε μελλει ο θεος τοιχε κεκονιαμενε και συ καθη κρινων με κατα τον νομον και παρανομων κελευεις με τυπτεσθαι
kjv: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?

vulg: et qui adstabant dixerunt summum sacerdotem Dei maledicis
clem: Et qui astabant dixerunt: Summum sacerdotem Dei maledicis.
tr: οι δε παρεστωτες ειπον τον αρχιερεα του θεου λοιδορεις
kjv: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?

vulg: dixit autem Paulus nesciebam fratres quia princeps est sacerdotum scriptum est enim principem populi tui non maledices
clem: Dixit autem Paulus: Nesciebam, fratres, quia princeps est sacerdotum. Scriptum est enim: Principem populi tui non maledices.
tr: εφη τε ο παυλος ουκ ηδειν αδελφοι οτι εστιν αρχιερευς γεγραπται γαρ αρχοντα του λαου σου ουκ ερεις κακως
kjv: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.

vulg: sciens autem Paulus quia una pars esset Sadducaeorum et altera Pharisaeorum exclamavit in concilio viri fratres ego Pharisaeus sum filius Pharisaeorum de spe et resurrectione mortuorum ego iudicor
clem: Sciens autem Paulus quia una pars esset sadducorum, et altera pharisorum, exclamavit in concilio: Viri fratres, ego pharisus sum, filius pharisorum: de spe et resurrectione mortuorum ego judicor.
tr: γνους δε ο παυλος οτι το εν μερος εστιν σαδδουκαιων το δε ετερον φαρισαιων εκραξεν εν τω συνεδριω ανδρες αδελφοι εγω φαρισαιος ειμι υιος φαρισαιου περι ελπιδος και αναστασεως νεκρων εγω κρινομαι
kjv: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.

vulg: et cum haec dixisset facta est dissensio inter Pharisaeos et Sadducaeos et soluta est multitudo
clem: Et cum hc dixisset, facta est dissensio inter pharisos et sadducos, et soluta est multitudo.
tr: τουτο δε αυτου λαλησαντος εγενετο στασις των φαρισαιων και των σαδδουκαιων και εσχισθη το πληθος
kjv: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.

vulg: Sadducaei enim dicunt non esse resurrectionem neque angelum neque spiritum Pharisaei autem utrumque confitentur
clem: Sadduci enim dicunt non esse resurrectionem, neque angelum, neque spiritum: pharisi autem utraque confitentur.
tr: σαδδουκαιοι μεν γαρ λεγουσιν μη ειναι αναστασιν μηδε αγγελον μητε πνευμα φαρισαιοι δε ομολογουσιν τα αμφοτερα
kjv: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.

vulg: factus est autem clamor magnus et surgentes quidam Pharisaeorum pugnabant dicentes nihil mali invenimus in homine isto quod si spiritus locutus est ei aut angelus
clem: Factus est autem clamor magnus. Et surgentes quidam pharisorum, pugnabant, dicentes: Nihil mali invenimus in homine isto: quid si spiritus locutus est ei, aut angelus?
tr: εγενετο δε κραυγη μεγαλη και ανασταντες οι γραμματεις του μερους των φαρισαιων διεμαχοντο λεγοντες ουδεν κακον ευρισκομεν εν τω ανθρωπω τουτω ει δε πνευμα ελαλησεν αυτω η αγγελος μη θεομαχωμεν
kjv: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.

vulg: et cum magna dissensio facta esset timens tribunus ne discerperetur Paulus ab ipsis iussit milites descendere et rapere eum de medio eorum ac deducere eum in castra
clem: Et cum magna dissensio facta esset, timens tribunus ne discerperetur Paulus ab ipsis, jussit milites descendere, et rapere eum de medio eorum, ac deducere eum in castra.
tr: πολλης δε γενομενης στασεως ευλαβηθεις ο χιλιαρχος μη διασπασθη ο παυλος υπ αυτων εκελευσεν το στρατευμα καταβαν αρπασαι αυτον εκ μεσου αυτων αγειν τε εις την παρεμβολην
kjv: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.

vulg: sequenti autem nocte adsistens ei Dominus ait constans esto sicut enim testificatus es de me Hierusalem sic te oportet et Romae testificari
clem: Sequenti autem nocte assistens ei Dominus, ait: Constans esto: sicut enim testificatus es de me in Jerusalem, sic te oportet et Rom testificari.
tr: τη δε επιουση νυκτι επιστας αυτω ο κυριος ειπεν θαρσει παυλε ως γαρ διεμαρτυρω τα περι εμου εις ιερουσαλημ ουτως σε δει και εις ρωμην μαρτυρησαι
kjv: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.

vulg: facta autem die collegerunt se quidam ex Iudaeis et devoverunt se dicentes neque manducaturos neque bibituros donec occiderent Paulum
clem: Facta autem die collegerunt se quidam ex Judis, et devoverunt, se dicentes neque manducaturos, neque bibaturos donec occiderent Paulum.
tr: γενομενης δε ημερας ποιησαντες τινες των ιουδαιων συστροφην ανεθεματισαν εαυτους λεγοντες μητε φαγειν μητε πιειν εως ου αποκτεινωσιν τον παυλον
kjv: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.

vulg: erant autem plus quam quadraginta qui hanc coniurationem fecerant
clem: Erant autem plus quam quadraginta viri qui hanc conjurationem fecerant:
tr: ησαν δε πλειους τεσσαρακοντα οι ταυτην την συνωμοσιαν πεποιηκοτες
kjv: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.

vulg: qui accesserunt ad principes sacerdotum et seniores et dixerunt devotione devovimus nos nihil gustaturos donec occidamus Paulum
clem: qui accesserunt ad principes sacerdotum et seniores, et dixerunt: Devotione devovimus nos nihil gustaturos, donec occidamus Paulum.
tr: οιτινες προσελθοντες τοις αρχιερευσιν και τοις πρεσβυτεροις ειπον αναθεματι ανεθεματισαμεν εαυτους μηδενος γευσασθαι εως ου αποκτεινωμεν τον παυλον
kjv: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.

vulg: nunc ergo vos notum facite tribuno cum concilio ut producat illum ad vos tamquam aliquid certius cognituri de eo nos vero priusquam adpropiet parati sumus interficere illum
clem: Nunc ergo vos notum facite tribuno cum concilio, ut producat illum ad vos, tamquam aliquid certius cognituri de eo. Nos vero priusquam appropiet, parati sumus interficere illum.
tr: νυν ουν υμεις εμφανισατε τω χιλιαρχω συν τω συνεδριω οπως αυριον αυτον καταγαγη προς υμας ως μελλοντας διαγινωσκειν ακριβεστερον τα περι αυτου ημεις δε προ του εγγισαι αυτον ετοιμοι εσμεν του ανελειν αυτον
